name: Sabha Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abravInmayaH pArthaM vAsudevasya saMnidhau |
prA~njaliH shlakShNayA vAchA pUjayitvA punaH punaH
shlokas.2:
asmAchcha kRRiShNAtsa~NkruddhAtpAvakAchcha didhakShataH |
tvayA trAto.asmi kaunteya brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.3:
arjuna uvAcha||
kRRitameva tvayA sarvaM svasti gachCha mahAsura |
prItimAnbhava me nityaM prItimanto vayaM cha te
shlokas.4:
maya uvAcha||
yuktametattvayi vibho yathAttha puruSharShabha |
prItipUrvamahaM ki~nchitkartumichChAmi bhArata
shlokas.5:
ahaM hi vishvakarmA vai dAnavAnAM mahAkaviH |
so.ahaM vai tvatkRRite ki~nchitkartumichChAmi pANDava
shlokas.6:
arjuna uvAcha||
prANakRRichChrAdvimuktaM tvamAtmAnaM manyase mayA |
evaM gate na shakShyAmi ki~nchitkArayituM tvayA
shlokas.7:
na chApi tava sa~NkalpaM moghamichChAmi dAnava |
kRRiShNasya kriyatAM ki~nchittathA pratikRRitaM mayi
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
chodito vAsudevastu mayena bharatarShabha |
muhUrtamiva sa.ndadhyau kimayaM chodyatAmiti
shlokas.9:
chodayAmAsa taM kRRiShNaH sabhA vai kriyatAmiti |
dharmarAjasya daiteya yAdRRishImiha manyase
shlokas.10:
yAM kRRitAM nAnukuryuste mAnavAH prekShya vismitAH |
manuShyaloke kRRitsne.asmi.nstAdRRishIM kuru vai sabhAm
shlokas.11:
yatra divyAnabhiprAyAnpashyema vihitA.nstvayA |
AsurAnmAnuShA.nshchaiva tAM sabhAM kuru vai maya
shlokas.12:
pratigRRihya tu tadvAkyaM samprahRRiShTo mayastadA |
vimAnapratimAM chakre pANDavasya sabhAM mudA
shlokas.13:
tataH kRRiShNashcha pArthashcha dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
sarvametadyathAvedya darshayAmAsaturmayam
shlokas.14:
tasmai yudhiShThiraH pUjAM yathArhamakarottadA |
sa tu tAM pratijagrAha mayaH satkRRitya satkRRitaH
shlokas.15:
sa pUrvadevacharitaM tatra tatra vishAM pate |
kathayAmAsa daiteyaH pANDuputreShu bhArata
shlokas.16:
sa kAlaM ka~nchidAshvasya vishvakarmA prachintya cha |
sabhAM prachakrame kartuM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.17:
abhiprAyeNa pArthAnAM kRRiShNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
puNye.ahani mahAtejAH kRRitakautukama~NgalaH
shlokas.18:
tarpayitvA dvijashreShThAnpAyasena sahasrashaH |
dhanaM bahuvidhaM dattvA tebhya eva cha vIryavAn
shlokas.19:
sarvartuguNasampannAM divyarUpAM manoramAm |
dashakiShkusahasrAM tAM mApayAmAsa sarvataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uShitvA khANDavaprasthe sukhavAsaM janArdanaH |
pArthaiH prItisamAyuktaiH pUjanArho.abhipUjitaH
shlokas.2:
gamanAya matiM chakre piturdarshanalAlasaH |
dharmarAjamathAmantrya pRRithAM cha pRRithulochanaH
shlokas.3:
vavande charaNau mUrdhnA jagadvandyaH pitRRiShvasuH |
sa tayA mUrdhnyupAghrAtaH pariShvaktashcha keshavaH
shlokas.4:
dadarshAnantaraM kRRiShNo bhaginIM svAM mahAyashAH |
tAmupetya hRRiShIkeshaH prItyA bAShpasamanvitaH
shlokas.5:
arthyaM tathyaM hitaM vAkyaM laghu yuktamanuttamam |
uvAcha bhagavAnbhadrAM subhadrAM bhadrabhAShiNIm
shlokas.6:
tayA svajanagAmIni shrAvito vachanAni saH |
sampUjitashchApyasakRRichChirasA chAbhivAditaH
shlokas.7:
tAmanuj~nApya vArShNeyaH pratinandya cha bhAminIm |
dadarshAnantaraM kRRiShNAM dhaumyaM chApi janArdanaH
shlokas.8:
vavande cha yathAnyAyaM dhaumyaM puruShasattamaH |
draupadIM sAntvayitvA cha Amantrya cha janArdanaH
shlokas.9:
bhrAtR^InabhyagamaddhImAnpArthena sahito balI |
bhrAtRRibhiH pa~nchabhiH kRRiShNo vRRitaH shakra ivAmaraiH
shlokas.10:
archayAmAsa devA.nshcha dvijA.nshcha yadupu~NgavaH |
mAlyajapyanamaskArairgandhairuchchAvachairapi
sa kRRitvA sarvakAryANi pratasthe tasthuShAM varaH
shlokas.11:
svasti vAchyArhato viprAndadhipAtraphalAkShataiH |
vasu pradAya cha tataH pradakShiNamavartata
shlokas.12:
kA~nchanaM rathamAsthAya tArkShyaketanamAshugam |
gadAchakrAsishAr~NgAdyairAyudhaishcha samanvitam
shlokas.13:
tithAvatha cha nakShatre muhUrte cha guNAnvite |
prayayau puNDarIkAkShaH sainyasugrIvavAhanaH
shlokas.14:
anvAruroha chApyenaM premNA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
apAsya chAsya yantAraM dArukaM yantRRisattamam
abhIShUnsamprajagrAha svayaM kurupatistadA
shlokas.15:
upAruhyArjunashchApi chAmaravyajanaM sitam |
rukmadaNDaM bRRihanmUrdhni dudhAvAbhipradakShiNam
shlokas.16:
tathaiva bhImaseno.api yamAbhyAM sahito vashI |
pRRiShThato.anuyayau kRRiShNamRRitvikpaurajanairvRRitaH
shlokas.17:
sa tathA bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM keshavaH paravIrahA |
anugamyamAnaH shushubhe shiShyairiva guruH priyaiH
shlokas.18:
pArthamAmantrya govindaH pariShvajya cha pIDitam |
yudhiShThiraM pUjayitvA bhImasenaM yamau tathA
shlokas.19:
pariShvakto bhRRishaM tAbhyAM yamAbhyAmabhivAditaH |
tatastaiH sa.nvidaM kRRitvA yathAvanmadhusUdanaH
shlokas.20:
nivartayitvA cha tadA pANDavAnsapadAnugAn |
svAM purIM prayayau kRRiShNaH pura.ndara ivAparaH
shlokas.21:
lochanairanujagmuste tamA dRRiShTipathAttadA |
manobhiranujagmuste kRRiShNaM prItisamanvayAt
shlokas.22:
atRRiptamanasAmeva teShAM keshavadarshane |
kShipramantardadhe shaurishchakShuShAM priyadarshanaH
shlokas.23:
akAmA iva pArthAste govindagatamAnasAH |
nivRRityopayayuH sarve svapuraM puruSharShabhAH
syandanenAtha kRRiShNo.api samaye dvArakAmagAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAbravInmayaH pArthamarjunaM jayatAM varam |
ApRRichChe tvAM gamiShyAmi kShiprameShyAmi chApyaham
shlokas.2:
uttareNa tu kailAsaM mainAkaM parvataM prati |
yakShyamANeShu sarveShu dAnaveShu tadA mayA
kRRitaM maNimayaM bhANDaM ramyaM bindusaraH prati
shlokas.3:
sabhAyAM satyasandhasya yadAsIdvRRiShaparvaNaH |
AgamiShyAmi tadgRRihya yadi tiShThati bhArata
shlokas.4:
tataH sabhAM kariShyAmi pANDavAya yashasvine |
manaHprahlAdinIM chitrAM sarvaratnavibhUShitAm
shlokas.5:
asti bindusarasyeva gadA shreShThA kurUdvaha |
nihitA yauvanAshvena rAj~nA hatvA raNe ripUn
suvarNabindubhishchitrA gurvI bhArasahA dRRiDhA
shlokas.6:
sA vai shatasahasrasya saMmitA sarvaghAtinI |
anurUpA cha bhImasya gANDIvaM bhavato yathA
shlokas.7:
vAruNashcha mahAsha~Nkho devadattaH sughoShavAn |
sarvametatpradAsyAmi bhavate nAtra sa.nshayaH
ityuktvA so.asuraH pArthaM prAgudIchImagAddisham
shlokas.8:
uttareNa tu kailAsaM mainAkaM parvataM prati |
hiraNyashRRi~Ngo bhagavAnmahAmaNimayo giriH
shlokas.9:
ramyaM bindusaro nAma yatra rAjA bhagIrathaH |
dRRiShTvA bhAgIrathIM ga~NgAmuvAsa bahulAH samAH
shlokas.10:
yatreShTvA sarvabhUtAnAmIshvareNa mahAtmanA |
AhRRitAH kratavo mukhyAH shataM bharatasattama
shlokas.11:
yatra yUpA maNimayAshchityAshchApi hiraNmayAH |
shobhArthaM vihitAstatra na tu dRRiShTAntataH kRRitAH
shlokas.12:
yatreShTvA sa gataH siddhiM sahasrAkShaH shachIpatiH |
yatra bhUtapatiH sRRiShTvA sarvalokAnsanAtanaH
upAsyate tigmatejA vRRito bhUtaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.13:
naranArAyaNau brahmA yamaH sthANushcha pa~nchamaH |
upAsate yatra satraM sahasrayugaparyaye
shlokas.14:
yatreShTaM vAsudevena satrairvarShasahasrakaiH |
shraddadhAnena satataM shiShTasampratipattaye
shlokas.15:
suvarNamAlino yUpAshchityAshchApyatibhAsvarAH |
dadau yatra sahasrANi prayutAni cha keshavaH
shlokas.16:
tatra gatvA sa jagrAha gadAM sha~NkhaM cha bhArata |
sphATikaM cha sabhAdravyaM yadAsIdvRRiShaparvaNaH
ki~NkaraiH saha rakShobhiragRRihNAtsarvameva tat
shlokas.17:
tadAhRRitya tu tAM chakre so.asuro.apratimAM sabhAm |
vishrutAM triShu lokeShu divyAM maNimayIM shubhAm
shlokas.18:
gadAM cha bhImasenAya pravarAM pradadau tadA |
devadattaM cha pArthAya dadau sha~Nkhamanuttamam
shlokas.19:
sabhA tu sA mahArAja shAtakumbhamayadrumA |
dasha kiShkusahasrANi samantAdAyatAbhavat
shlokas.20:
yathA vahneryathArkasya somasya cha yathaiva sA |
bhrAjamAnA tathA divyA babhAra paramaM vapuH
shlokas.21:
pratighnatIva prabhayA prabhAmarkasya bhAsvarAm |
prababhau jvalamAneva divyA divyena varchasA
shlokas.22:
nagameghapratIkAshA divamAvRRitya viShThitA |
AyatA vipulA shlakShNA vipApmA vigataklamA
shlokas.23:
uttamadravyasampannA maNiprAkAramAlinI |
bahuratnA bahudhanA sukRRitA vishvakarmaNA
shlokas.24:
na dAshArhI sudharmA vA brahmaNo vApi tAdRRishI |
AsIdrUpeNa sampannA yAM chakre.apratimAM mayaH
shlokas.25:
tAM sma tatra mayenoktA rakShanti cha vahanti cha |
sabhAmaShTau sahasrANi ki~NkarA nAma rAkShasAH
shlokas.26:
antarikShacharA ghorA mahAkAyA mahAbalAH |
raktAkShAH pi~NgalAkShAshcha shuktikarNAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.27:
tasyAM sabhAyAM nalinIM chakArApratimAM mayaH |
vaiDUryapatravitatAM maNinAlamayAmbujAm
shlokas.28:
padmasaugandhikavatIM nAnAdvijagaNAyutAm |
puShpitaiH pa~NkajaishchitrAM kUrmamatsyaishcha shobhitAm
shlokas.29:
sUpatIrthAmakaluShAM sarvartusalilAM shubhAm |
mArutenaiva choddhUtairmuktAbindubhirAchitAm
shlokas.30:
maNiratnachitAM tAM tu kechidabhyetya pArthivAH |
dRRiShTvApi nAbhyajAnanta te.aj~nAnAtprapatantyuta
shlokas.31:
tAM sabhAmabhito nityaM puShpavanto mahAdrumAH |
AsannAnAvidhA nIlAH shItachChAyA manoramAH
shlokas.32:
kAnanAni sugandhIni puShkariNyashcha sarvashaH |
ha.nsakAraNDavayutAshchakravAkopashobhitAH
shlokas.33:
jalajAnAM cha mAlyAnAM sthalajAnAM cha sarvashaH |
mAruto gandhamAdAya pANDavAnsma niShevate
shlokas.34:
IdRRishIM tAM sabhAM kRRitvA mAsaiH parichaturdashaiH |
niShThitAM dharmarAjAya mayo rAj~ne nyavedayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH praveshanaM chakre tasyAM rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
ayutaM bhojayAmAsa brAhmaNAnAM narAdhipaH
shlokas.2:
ghRRitapAyasena madhunA bhakShyairmUlaphalaistathA |
ahataishchaiva vAsobhirmAlyairuchchAvachairapi
shlokas.3:
dadau tebhyaH sahasrANi gavAM pratyekashaH prabhuH |
puNyAhaghoShastatrAsIddivaspRRigiva bhArata
shlokas.4:
vAditrairvividhairgItairgandhairuchchAvachairapi |
pUjayitvA kurushreShTho daivatAni niveshya cha
shlokas.5:
tatra mallA naTA jhallAH sUtA vaitAlikAstathA |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM saptarAtraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.6:
tathA sa kRRitvA pUjAM tAM bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaH |
tasyAM sabhAyAM ramyAyAM reme shakro yathA divi
shlokas.7:
sabhAyAmRRiShayastasyAM pANDavaiH saha Asate |
AsAM chakrurnarendrAshcha nAnAdeshasamAgatAH
shlokas.8:
asito devalaH satyaH sarpamAlI mahAshirAH |
arvAvasuH sumitrashcha maitreyaH shunako baliH
shlokas.9:
bako dAlbhyaH sthUlashirAH kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH shukaH |
sumanturjaiminiH pailo vyAsashiShyAstathA vayam
shlokas.10:
tittiriryAj~navalkyashcha sasuto lomaharShaNaH |
apsuhomyashcha dhaumyashcha ANImANDavyakaushikau
shlokas.11:
dAmoShNIShastraivaNishcha parNAdo ghaTajAnukaH |
mau~njAyano vAyubhakShaH pArAsharyashcha sArikau
shlokas.12:
balavAkaH shinIvAkaH sutyapAlaH kRRitashramaH |
jAtUkarNaH shikhAvA.nshcha subalaH pArijAtakaH
shlokas.13:
parvatashcha mahAbhAgo mArkaNDeyastathA muniH |
pavitrapANiH sAvarNirbhAlukirgAlavastathA
shlokas.14:
ja~NghAbandhushcha raibhyashcha kopavegashravA bhRRiguH |
haribabhrushcha kauNDinyo babhrumAlI sanAtanaH
shlokas.15:
kakShIvAnaushijashchaiva nAchiketo.atha gautamaH |
pai~Ngo varAhaH shunakaH shANDilyashcha mahAtapAH
karkaro veNuja~Nghashcha kalApaH kaTha eva cha
shlokas.16:
munayo dharmasahitA dhRRitAtmAno jitendriyAH |
ete chAnye cha bahavo vedavedA~NgapAragAH
shlokas.17:
upAsate mahAtmAnaM sabhAyAmRRiShisattamAH |
kathayantaH kathAH puNyA dharmaj~nAH shuchayo.amalAH
shlokas.18:
tathaiva kShatriyashreShThA dharmarAjamupAsate |
shrImAnmahAtmA dharmAtmA mu~njaketurvivardhanaH
shlokas.19:
sa~NgrAmajiddurmukhashcha ugrasenashcha vIryavAn |
kakShasenaH kShitipatiH kShemakashchAparAjitaH
kAmbojarAjaH kamalaH kampanashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.20:
satataM kampayAmAsa yavanAneka eva yaH |
yathAsurAnkAlakeyAndevo vajradharastathA
shlokas.21:
jaTAsuro madrakAntashcha rAjA; kuntiH kuNindashcha kirAtarAjaH |
tathA~Ngava~Ngau saha puNDrakeNa; pANDyoDrarAjau saha chAndhrakeNa
shlokas.22:
kirAtarAjaH sumanA yavanAdhipatistathA |
chANUro devarAtashcha bhojo bhImarathashcha yaH
shlokas.23:
shrutAyudhashcha kAli~Ngo jayatsenashcha mAgadhaH |
susharmA chekitAnashcha suratho.amitrakarShaNaH
shlokas.24:
ketumAnvasudAnashcha vaideho.atha kRRitakShaNaH |
sudharmA chAniruddhashcha shrutAyushcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.25:
anUparAjo durdharShaH kShemajichcha sudakShiNaH |
shishupAlaH sahasutaH karUShAdhipatistathA
shlokas.26:
vRRiShNInAM chaiva durdharShAH kumArA devarUpiNaH |
Ahuko vipRRithushchaiva gadaH sAraNa eva cha
shlokas.27:
akrUraH kRRitavarmA cha sAtyakishcha shineH sutaH |
bhIShmako.athAhRRitishchaiva dyumatsenashcha vIryavAn
kekayAshcha maheShvAsA yaj~nasenashcha saumakiH
shlokas.28:
arjunaM chApi sa.nshritya rAjaputrA mahAbalAH |
ashikShanta dhanurvedaM rauravAjinavAsasaH
shlokas.29:
tatraiva shikShitA rAjankumArA vRRiShNinandanAH |
raukmiNeyashcha sAmbashcha yuyudhAnashcha sAtyakiH
shlokas.30:
ete chAnye cha bahavo rAjAnaH pRRithivIpate |
dhana~njayasakhA chAtra nityamAste sma tumburuH
shlokas.31:
chitrasenaH sahAmAtyo gandharvApsarasastathA |
gItavAditrakushalAH shamyAtAlavishAradAH
shlokas.32:
pramANe.atha layasthAne kiMnarAH kRRitanishramAH |
sa~nchoditAstumburuNA gandharvAH sahitA jaguH
shlokas.33:
gAyanti divyatAnaiste yathAnyAyaM manasvinaH |
pANDuputrAnRRiShI.nshchaiva ramayanta upAsate
shlokas.34:
tasyAM sabhAyAmAsInAH suvratAH satyasa~NgarAH |
divIva devA brahmANaM yudhiShThiramupAsate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tatropaviShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
mahatsu chopaviShTeShu gandharveShu cha bhArata
shlokas.2:
lokAnanucharansarvAnAgamattAM sabhAmRRiShiH |
nAradaH sumahAtejA RRiShibhiH sahitastadA
shlokas.3:
pArijAtena rAjendra raivatena cha dhImatA |
sumukhena cha saumyena devarShiramitadyutiH
sabhAsthAnpANDavAndraShTuM prIyamANo manojavaH
shlokas.4:
tamAgatamRRiShiM dRRiShTvA nAradaM sarvadharmavit |
sahasA pANDavashreShThaH pratyutthAyAnujaiH saha
abhyavAdayata prItyA vinayAvanatastadA
shlokas.5:
tadarhamAsanaM tasmai sampradAya yathAvidhi |
archayAmAsa ratnaishcha sarvakAmaishcha dharmavit
shlokas.6:
so.architaH pANDavaiH sarvairmaharShirvedapAragaH |
dharmakAmArthasa.nyuktaM paprachChedaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.7:
nArada uvAcha||
kachchidarthAshcha kalpante dharme cha ramate manaH |
sukhAni chAnubhUyante manashcha na vihanyate
shlokas.8:
kachchidAcharitAM pUrvairnaradeva pitAmahaiH |
vartase vRRittimakShINAM dharmArthasahitAM nRRiShu
shlokas.9:
kachchidarthena vA dharmaM dharmeNArthamathApi vA |
ubhau vA prItisAreNa na kAmena prabAdhase
shlokas.10:
kachchidarthaM cha dharmaM cha kAmaM cha jayatAM vara |
vibhajya kAle kAlaj~na sadA varada sevase
shlokas.11:
kachchidrAjaguNaiH ShaDbhiH saptopAyA.nstathAnagha |
balAbalaM tathA samyakchaturdasha parIkShase
shlokas.12:
kachchidAtmAnamanvIkShya parA.nshcha jayatAM vara |
tathA sandhAya karmANi aShTau bhArata sevase
shlokas.13:
kachchitprakRRitayaH ShaTte na luptA bharatarShabha |
ADhyAstathAvyasaninaH svanuraktAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
kachchinna tarkairdUtairvA ye chApyaparisha~NkitAH |
tvatto vA tava vAmAtyairbhidyate jAtu mantritam
shlokas.15:
kachchitsandhiM yathAkAlaM vigrahaM chopasevase |
kachchidvRRittimudAsIne madhyame chAnuvartase
shlokas.16:
kachchidAtmasamA buddhyA shuchayo jIvitakShamAH |
kulInAshchAnuraktAshcha kRRitAste vIra mantriNaH
shlokas.17:
vijayo mantramUlo hi rAj~nAM bhavati bhArata |
susa.nvRRito mantradhanairamAtyaiH shAstrakovidaiH
shlokas.18:
kachchinnidrAvashaM naiShi kachchitkAle vibudhyase |
kachchichchApararAtreShu chintayasyarthamarthavit
shlokas.19:
kachchinmantrayase naikaH kachchinna bahubhiH saha |
kachchitte mantrito mantro na rAShTramanudhAvati
shlokas.20:
kachchidarthAnvinishchitya laghumUlAnmahodayAn |
kShipramArabhase kartuM na vighnayasi tAdRRishAn
shlokas.21:
kachchinna sarve karmAntAH parokShAste visha~NkitAH |
sarve vA punarutsRRiShTAH sa.nsRRiShTaM hyatra kAraNam
shlokas.22:
kachchidrAjankRRitAnyeva kRRitaprAyANi vA punaH |
viduste vIra karmANi nAnavAptAni kAnichit
shlokas.23:
kachchitkAraNikAH sarve sarvashAstreShu kovidAH |
kArayanti kumArA.nshcha yodhamukhyA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.24:
kachchitsahasrairmUrkhANAmekaM krINAsi paNDitam |
paNDito hyarthakRRichChreShu kuryAnniHshreyasaM param
shlokas.25:
kachchiddurgANi sarvANi dhanadhAnyAyudhodakaiH |
yantraishcha paripUrNAni tathA shilpidhanurdharaiH
shlokas.26:
eko.apyamAtyo medhAvI shUro dAnto vichakShaNaH |
rAjAnaM rAjaputraM vA prApayenmahatIM shriyam
shlokas.27:
kachchidaShTAdashAnyeShu svapakShe dasha pa~ncha cha |
tribhistribhiravij~nAtairvetsi tIrthAni chArakaiH
shlokas.28:
kachchiddviShAmaviditaH pratiyattashcha sarvadA |
nityayukto ripUnsarvAnvIkShase ripusUdana
shlokas.29:
kachchidvinayasampannaH kulaputro bahushrutaH |
anasUyuranupraShTA satkRRitaste purohitaH
shlokas.30:
kachchidagniShu te yukto vidhij~no matimAnRRijuH |
hutaM cha hoShyamANaM cha kAle vedayate sadA
shlokas.31:
kachchida~NgeShu niShNAto jyotiShAM pratipAdakaH |
utpAteShu cha sarveShu daivaj~naH kushalastava
shlokas.32:
kachchinmukhyA mahatsveva madhyameShu cha madhyamAH |
jaghanyAshcha jaghanyeShu bhRRityAH karmasu yojitAH
shlokas.33:
amAtyAnupadhAtItAnpitRRipaitAmahA~nshuchIn |
shreShThA~nshreShTheShu kachchittvaM niyojayasi karmasu
shlokas.34:
kachchinnogreNa daNDena bhRRishamudvejitaprajAH |
rAShTraM tavAnushAsanti mantriNo bharatarShabha
shlokas.35:
kachchittvAM nAvajAnanti yAjakAH patitaM yathA |
ugrapratigrahItAraM kAmayAnamiva striyaH
shlokas.36:
kachchiddhRRiShTashcha shUrashcha matimAndhRRitimA~nshuchiH |
kulInashchAnuraktashcha dakShaH senApatistava
shlokas.37:
kachchidbalasya te mukhyAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
dRRiShTApadAnA vikrAntAstvayA satkRRitya mAnitAH
shlokas.38:
kachchidbalasya bhaktaM cha vetanaM cha yathochitam |
samprAptakAlaM dAtavyaM dadAsi na vikarShasi
shlokas.39:
kAlAtikramaNAddhyete bhaktavetanayorbhRRitAH |
bhartuH kupyanti daurgatyAtso.anarthaH sumahAnsmRRitaH
shlokas.40:
kachchitsarve.anuraktAstvAM kulaputrAH pradhAnataH |
kachchitprANA.nstavArtheShu santyajanti sadA yudhi
shlokas.41:
kachchinnaiko bahUnarthAnsarvashaH sAmparAyikAn |
anushAssi yathAkAmaM kAmAtmA shAsanAtigaH
shlokas.42:
kachchitpuruShakAreNa puruShaH karma shobhayan |
labhate mAnamadhikaM bhUyo vA bhaktavetanam
shlokas.44:
kachchiddArAnmanuShyANAM tavArthe mRRityumeyuShAm |
vyasanaM chAbhyupetAnAM bibharShi bharatarShabha
shlokas.45:
kachchidbhayAdupanataM klIbaM vA ripumAgatam |
yuddhe vA vijitaM pArtha putravatparirakShasi
shlokas.46:
kachchittvameva sarvasyAH pRRithivyAH pRRithivIpate |
samashcha nAbhisha~Nkyashcha yathA mAtA yathA pitA
shlokas.47:
kachchidvyasaninaM shatruM nishamya bharatarShabha |
abhiyAsi javenaiva samIkShya trividhaM balam
shlokas.48:
pArShNimUlaM cha vij~nAya vyavasAyaM parAjayam |
balasya cha mahArAja dattvA vetanamagrataH
shlokas.49:
kachchichcha balamukhyebhyaH pararAShTre parantapa |
upachChannAni ratnAni prayachChasi yathArhataH
shlokas.50:
kachchidAtmAnamevAgre vijitya vijitendriyaH |
parA~njigIShase pArtha pramattAnajitendriyAn
shlokas.51:
kachchitte yAsyataH shatrUnpUrvaM yAnti svanuShThitAH |
sAma dAnaM cha bhedashcha daNDashcha vidhivadguNAH
shlokas.52:
kachchinmUlaM dRRiDhaM kRRitvA yAtrAM yAsi vishAM pate |
tA.nshcha vikramase jetuM jitvA cha parirakShasi
shlokas.53:
kachchidaShTA~Ngasa.nyuktA chaturvidhabalA chamUH |
balamukhyaiH sunItA te dviShatAM pratibAdhanI
shlokas.54:
kachchillavaM cha muShTiM cha pararAShTre parantapa |
avihAya mahArAja viha.nsi samare ripUn
shlokas.55:
kachchitsvapararAShTreShu bahavo.adhikRRitAstava |
arthAnsamanutiShThanti rakShanti cha parasparam
shlokas.56:
kachchidabhyavahAryANi gAtrasa.nsparshakAni cha |
ghreyANi cha mahArAja rakShantyanumatAstava
shlokas.57:
kachchitkoshaM cha koShThaM cha vAhanaM dvAramAyudham |
Ayashcha kRRitakalyANaistava bhaktairanuShThitaH
shlokas.58:
kachchidAbhyantarebhyashcha bAhyebhyashcha vishAM pate |
rakShasyAtmAnamevAgre tA.nshcha svebhyo mithashcha tAn
shlokas.59:
kachchinna pAne dyUte vA krIDAsu pramadAsu cha |
pratijAnanti pUrvAhNe vyayaM vyasanajaM tava
shlokas.60:
kachchidAyasya chArdhena chaturbhAgena vA punaH |
pAdabhAgaistribhirvApi vyayaH sa.nshodhyate tava
shlokas.61:
kachchijj~nAtIngurUnvRRiddhAnvaNijaH shilpinaH shritAn |
abhIkShNamanugRRihNAsi dhanadhAnyena durgatAn
shlokas.62:
kachchidAyavyaye yuktAH sarve gaNakalekhakAH |
anutiShThanti pUrvAhNe nityamAyavyayaM tava
shlokas.63:
kachchidartheShu samprauDhAnhitakAmAnanupriyAn |
nApakarShasi karmabhyaH pUrvamaprApya kilbiSham
shlokas.64:
kachchidviditvA puruShAnuttamAdhamamadhyamAn |
tvaM karmasvanurUpeShu niyojayasi bhArata
shlokas.65:
kachchinna lubdhAshchaurA vA vairiNo vA vishAM pate |
aprAptavyavahArA vA tava karmasvanuShThitAH
shlokas.66:
kachchinna lubdhaishchaurairvA kumAraiH strIbalena vA |
tvayA vA pIDyate rAShTraM kachchitpuShTAH kRRiShIvalAH
shlokas.67:
kachchidrAShTre taDAgAni pUrNAni cha mahAnti cha |
bhAgasho viniviShTAni na kRRiShirdevamAtRRikA
shlokas.68:
kachchidbIjaM cha bhaktaM cha karShakAyAvasIdate |
pratikaM cha shataM vRRiddhyA dadAsyRRiNamanugraham
shlokas.69:
kachchitsvanuShThitA tAta vArttA te sAdhubhirjanaiH |
vArttAyAM sa.nshritastAta loko.ayaM sukhamedhate
shlokas.70:
kachchichChuchikRRitaH prAj~nAH pa~ncha pa~ncha svanuShThitAH |
kShemaM kurvanti saMhatya rAja~njanapade tava
shlokas.71:
kachchinnagaraguptyarthaM grAmA nagaravatkRRitAH |
grAmavachcha kRRitA rakShA te cha sarve tadarpaNAH
shlokas.72:
kachchidbalenAnugatAH samAni viShamANi cha |
purANachaurAH sAdhyakShAshcharanti viShaye tava
shlokas.73:
kachchitstriyaH sAntvayasi kachchittAshcha surakShitAH |
kachchinna shraddadhAsyAsAM kachchidguhyaM na bhAShase
shlokas.74:
kachchichchArAnnishi shrutvA tatkAryamanuchintya cha |
priyANyanubhava~nsheShe viditvAbhyantaraM janam
shlokas.75:
kachchiddvau prathamau yAmau rAtryAM suptvA vishAM pate |
sa~nchintayasi dharmArthau yAma utthAya pashchime
shlokas.76:
kachchiddarshayase nityaM manuShyAnsamala~NkRRitAn |
utthAya kAle kAlaj~naH saha pANDava mantribhiH
shlokas.78:
kachchiddaNDyeShu yamavatpUjyeShu cha vishAM pate |
parIkShya vartase samyagapriyeShu priyeShu cha
shlokas.80:
kachchidvaidyAshchikitsAyAmaShTA~NgAyAM vishAradAH |
suhRRidashchAnuraktAshcha sharIre te hitAH sadA
shlokas.81:
kachchinna mAnAnmohAdvA kAmAdvApi vishAM pate |
arthipratyarthinaH prAptAnapAsyasi katha~nchana
shlokas.82:
kachchinna lobhAnmohAdvA vishrambhAtpraNayena vA |
AshritAnAM manuShyANAM vRRittiM tvaM sa.nruNatsi cha
shlokas.83:
kachchitpaurA na sahitA ye cha te rAShTravAsinaH |
tvayA saha virudhyante paraiH krItAH katha~nchana
shlokas.84:
kachchitte durbalaH shatrurbalenopanipIDitaH |
mantreNa balavAnkashchidubhAbhyAM vA yudhiShThira
shlokas.85:
kachchitsarve.anuraktAstvAM bhUmipAlAH pradhAnataH |
kachchitprANA.nstvadartheShu santyajanti tvayA hRRitAH
shlokas.86:
kachchitte sarvavidyAsu guNato.archA pravartate |
brAhmaNAnAM cha sAdhUnAM tava niHshreyase shubhA
shlokas.87:
kachchiddharme trayImUle pUrvairAcharite janaiH |
vartamAnastathA kartuM tasminkarmaNi vartase
shlokas.88:
kachchittava gRRihe.annAni svAdUnyashnanti vai dvijAH |
guNavanti guNopetAstavAdhyakShaM sadakShiNam
shlokas.89:
kachchitkratUnekachitto vAjapeyA.nshcha sarvashaH |
puNDarIkA.nshcha kArtsnyena yatase kartumAtmavAn
shlokas.91:
kachchideShA cha te buddhirvRRittireShA cha te.anagha |
AyuShyA cha yashasyA cha dharmakAmArthadarshinI
shlokas.92:
etayA vartamAnasya buddhyA rAShTraM na sIdati |
vijitya cha mahIM rAjA so.atyantaM sukhamedhate
shlokas.93:
kachchidAryo vishuddhAtmA kShAritashchaurakarmaNi |
adRRiShTashAstrakushalairna lobhAdvadhyate shuchiH
shlokas.94:
pRRiShTo gRRihItastatkArI tajj~nairdRRiShTaH sakAraNaH |
kachchinna muchyate steno dravyalobhAnnararShabha
shlokas.95:
vyutpanne kachchidADhyasya daridrasya cha bhArata |
arthAnna mithyA pashyanti tavAmAtyA hRRitA dhanaiH
shlokas.96:
nAstikyamanRRitaM krodhaM pramAdaM dIrghasUtratAm |
adarshanaM j~nAnavatAmAlasyaM kShiptachittatAm
shlokas.98:
ma~NgalyasyAprayogaM cha prasa~NgaM viShayeShu cha |
kachchittvaM varjayasyetAnrAjadoShA.nshchaturdasha
shlokas.99:
kachchitte saphalA vedAH kachchitte saphalaM dhanam |
kachchitte saphalA dArAH kachchitte saphalaM shrutam
shlokas.100:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM vai saphalA vedAH kathaM vai saphalaM dhanam |
kathaM vai saphalA dArAH kathaM vai saphalaM shrutam
shlokas.101:
nArada uvAcha||
agnihotraphalA vedA dattabhuktaphalaM dhanam |
ratiputraphalA dArAH shIlavRRittaphalaM shrutam
shlokas.102:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etadAkhyAya sa munirnAradaH sumahAtapAH |
paprachChAnantaramidaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.103:
nArada uvAcha||
kachchidabhyAgatA dUrAdvaNijo lAbhakAraNAt |
yathoktamavahAryante shulkaM shulkopajIvibhiH
shlokas.104:
kachchitte puruShA rAjanpure rAShTre cha mAnitAH |
upAnayanti paNyAni upadhAbhirava~nchitAH
shlokas.105:
kachchichChRRiNoShi vRRiddhAnAM dharmArthasahitA giraH |
nityamarthavidAM tAta tathA dharmAnudarshinAm
shlokas.106:
kachchitte kRRiShitantreShu goShu puShpaphaleShu cha |
dharmArthaM cha dvijAtibhyo dIyate madhusarpiShI
shlokas.107:
dravyopakaraNaM kachchitsarvadA sarvashilpinAm |
chAturmAsyAvaraM samya~NniyataM samprayachChasi
shlokas.108:
kachchitkRRitaM vijAnIShe kartAraM cha prasha.nsasi |
satAM madhye mahArAja satkaroShi cha pUjayan
shlokas.109:
kachchitsUtrANi sarvANi gRRihNAsi bharatarShabha |
hastisUtrAshvasUtrANi rathasUtrANi chAbhibho
shlokas.110:
kachchidabhyasyate shashvadgRRihe te bharatarShabha |
dhanurvedasya sUtraM cha yantrasUtraM cha nAgaram
shlokas.111:
kachchidastrANi sarvANi brahmadaNDashcha te.anagha |
viShayogAshcha te sarve viditAH shatrunAshanAH
shlokas.112:
kachchidagnibhayAchchaiva sarpavyAlabhayAttathA |
rogarakShobhayAchchaiva rAShTraM svaM parirakShasi
shlokas.113:
kachchidandhA.nshcha mUkA.nshcha pa~NgUnvya~NgAnabAndhavAn |
piteva pAsi dharmaj~na tathA pravrajitAnapi
shlokas.114:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAH kurUNAmRRiShabho mahAtmA; shrutvA giro brAhmaNasattamasya |
praNamya pAdAvabhivAdya hRRiShTo; rAjAbravInnAradaM devarUpam
shlokas.115:
evaM kariShyAmi yathA tvayoktaM; praj~nA hi me bhUya evAbhivRRiddhA |
uktvA tathA chaiva chakAra rAjA; lebhe mahIM sAgaramekhalAM cha
shlokas.116:
nArada uvAcha||
evaM yo vartate rAjA chAturvarNyasya rakShaNe |
sa vihRRityeha susukhI shakrasyaiti salokatAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sampUjyAthAbhyanuj~nAto maharShervachanAtparam |
pratyuvAchAnupUrvyeNa dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
bhagavannyAyyamAhaitaM yathAvaddharmanishchayam |
yathAshakti yathAnyAyaM kriyate.ayaM vidhirmayA
shlokas.3:
rAjabhiryadyathA kAryaM purA tattanna sa.nshayaH |
yathAnyAyopanItArthaM kRRitaM hetumadarthavat
shlokas.4:
vayaM tu satpathaM teShAM yAtumichChAmahe prabho |
na tu shakyaM tathA gantuM yathA tairniyatAtmabhiH
shlokas.5:
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA vAkyaM tadabhipUjya cha |
muhUrtAtprAptakAlaM cha dRRiShTvA lokacharaM munim
shlokas.6:
nAradaM svasthamAsInamupAsIno yudhiShThiraH |
apRRichChatpANDavastatra rAjamadhye mahAmatiH
shlokas.7:
bhavAnsa~ncharate lokAnsadA nAnAvidhAnbahUn |
brahmaNA nirmitAnpUrvaM prekShamANo manojavaH
shlokas.8:
IdRRishI bhavatA kAchiddRRiShTapUrvA sabhA kvachit |
ito vA shreyasI brahma.nstanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.9:
tachChrutvA nAradastasya dharmarAjasya bhAShitam |
pANDavaM pratyuvAchedaM smayanmadhurayA girA
shlokas.10:
mAnuSheShu na me tAta dRRiShTapUrvA na cha shrutA |
sabhA maNimayI rAjanyatheyaM tava bhArata
shlokas.11:
sabhAM tu pitRRirAjasya varuNasya cha dhImataH |
kathayiShye tathendrasya kailAsanilayasya cha
shlokas.12:
brahmaNashcha sabhAM divyAM kathayiShye gataklamAm |
yadi te shravaNe buddhirvartate bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
nAradenaivamuktastu dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
prA~njalirbhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM taishcha sarvairnRRipairvRRitaH
shlokas.14:
nAradaM pratyuvAchedaM dharmarAjo mahAmanAH |
sabhAH kathaya tAH sarvAH shrotumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.15:
ki.ndravyAstAH sabhA brahmanki.nvistArAH kimAyatAH |
pitAmahaM cha ke tasyAM sabhAyAM paryupAsate
shlokas.16:
vAsavaM devarAjaM cha yamaM vaivasvataM cha ke |
varuNaM cha kuberaM cha sabhAyAM paryupAsate
shlokas.17:
etatsarvaM yathAtattvaM devarShe vadatastava |
shrotumichChAma sahitAH paraM kautUhalaM hi naH
shlokas.18:
evamuktaH pANDavena nAradaH pratyuvAcha tam |
krameNa rAjandivyAstAH shrUyantAmiha naH sabhAH

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
shakrasya tu sabhA divyA bhAsvarA karmabhirjitA |
svayaM shakreNa kauravya nirmitArkasamaprabhA
shlokas.2:
vistIrNA yojanashataM shatamadhyardhamAyatA |
vaihAyasI kAmagamA pa~nchayojanamuchChritA
shlokas.3:
jarAshokaklamApetA nirAta~NkA shivA shubhA |
veshmAsanavatI ramyA divyapAdapashobhitA
shlokas.4:
tasyAM deveshvaraH pArtha sabhAyAM paramAsane |
Aste shachyA mahendrANyA shriyA lakShmyA cha bhArata
shlokas.5:
bibhradvapuranirdeshyaM kirITI lohitA~NgadaH |
virajombarashchitramAlyo hrIkIrtidyutibhiH saha
shlokas.6:
tasyAmupAsate nityaM mahAtmAnaM shatakratum |
marutaH sarvato rAjansarve cha gRRihamedhinaH
siddhA devarShayashchaiva sAdhyA devagaNAstathA
shlokas.7:
ete sAnucharAH sarve divyarUpAH svala~NkRRitAH |
upAsate mahAtmAnaM devarAjamari.ndamam
shlokas.8:
tathA devarShayaH sarve pArtha shakramupAsate |
amalA dhUtapApmAno dIpyamAnA ivAgnayaH
tejasvinaH somayujo vipApA vigataklamAH
shlokas.9:
parAsharaH parvatashcha tathA sAvarNigAlavau |
sha~Nkhashcha likhitashchaiva tathA gaurashirA muniH
shlokas.10:
durvAsAshcha dIrghatapA yAj~navalkyo.atha bhAlukiH |
uddAlakaH shvetaketustathA shATyAyanaH prabhuH
shlokas.11:
haviShmA.nshcha gaviShThashcha harishchandrashcha pArthivaH |
hRRidyashchodarashANDilyaH pArAsharyaH kRRiShIvalaH
shlokas.12:
vAtaskandho vishAkhashcha vidhAtA kAla eva cha |
anantadantastvaShTA cha vishvakarmA cha tumburuH
shlokas.13:
ayonijA yonijAshcha vAyubhakShA hutAshinaH |
IshAnaM sarvalokasya vajriNaM samupAsate
shlokas.14:
sahadevaH sunIthashcha vAlmIkishcha mahAtapAH |
samIkaH satyavA.nshchaiva prachetAH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.15:
medhAtithirvAmadevaH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
maruttashcha marIchishcha sthANushchAtrirmahAtapAH
shlokas.16:
kakShIvAngautamastArkShyastathA vaishvAnaro muniH |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIya AshrAvyo.atha hiraNyadaH
sa.nvarto devahavyashcha viShvaksenashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
divyA ApastathauShadhyaH shraddhA medhA sarasvatI |
artho dharmashcha kAmashcha vidyutashchApi pANDava
shlokas.18:
jalavAhAstathA meghA vAyavaH stanayitnavaH |
prAchI digyaj~navAhAshcha pAvakAH saptavi.nshatiH
shlokas.19:
agnIShomau tathendrAgnI mitro.atha savitAryamA |
bhago vishve cha sAdhyAshcha shukro manthI cha bhArata
shlokas.20:
yaj~nAshcha dakShiNAshchaiva grahAH stobhAshcha sarvashaH |
yaj~navAhAshcha ye mantrAH sarve tatra samAsate
shlokas.21:
tathaivApsaraso rAjangandharvAshcha manoramAH |
nRRityavAditragItaishcha hAsyaishcha vividhairapi
ramayanti sma nRRipate devarAjaM shatakratum
shlokas.22:
stutibhirma~Ngalaishchaiva stuvantaH karmabhistathA |
vikramaishcha mahAtmAnaM balavRRitraniShUdanam
shlokas.23:
brahmarAjarShayaH sarve sarve devarShayastathA |
vimAnairvividhairdivyairbhrAjamAnairivAgnibhiH
shlokas.24:
sragviNo bhUShitAshchAnye yAnti chAyAnti chApare |
bRRihaspatishcha shukrashcha tasyAmAyayatuH saha
shlokas.25:
ete chAnye cha bahavo yatAtmAno yatavratAH |
vimAnaishchandrasa~NkAshaiH somavatpriyadarshanAH
brahmaNo vachanAdrAjanbhRRiguH saptarShayastathA
shlokas.26:
eShA sabhA mayA rAjandRRiShTA puShkaramAlinI |
shatakratormahArAja yAmyAM shRRiNu mamAnagha

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
kathayiShye sabhAM divyAM yudhiShThira nibodha tAm |
vaivasvatasya yAmarthe vishvakarmA chakAra ha
shlokas.2:
taijasI sA sabhA rAjanbabhUva shatayojanA |
vistArAyAmasampannA bhUyasI chApi pANDava
shlokas.3:
arkaprakAshA bhrAjiShNuH sarvataH kAmachAriNI |
naivAtishItA nAtyuShNA manasashcha praharShiNI
shlokas.4:
na shoko na jarA tasyAM kShutpipAse na chApriyam |
na cha dainyaM klamo vApi pratikUlaM na chApyuta
shlokas.5:
sarve kAmAH sthitAstasyAM ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH |
rasavachcha prabhUtaM cha bhakShyabhojyamari.ndama
shlokas.6:
puNyagandhAH srajastatra nityapuShpaphaladrumAH |
rasavanti cha toyAni shItAnyuShNAni chaiva ha
shlokas.7:
tasyAM rAjarShayaH puNyAstathA brahmarShayo.amalAH |
yamaM vaivasvataM tAta prahRRiShTAH paryupAsate
shlokas.8:
yayAtirnahuShaH pUrurmAndhAtA somako nRRigaH |
trasadasyushcha turayaH kRRitavIryaH shrutashravAH
shlokas.9:
aripraNutsusiMhashcha kRRitavegaH kRRitirnimiH |
pratardanaH shibirmatsyaH pRRithvakSho.atha bRRihadrathaH
shlokas.10:
aiDo maruttaH kushikaH sA~NkAshyaH sA~NkRRitirbhavaH |
chaturashvaH sadashvormiH kArtavIryashcha pArthivaH
shlokas.11:
bharatastathA surathaH sunItho naiShadho nalaH |
divodAso.atha sumanA ambarISho bhagIrathaH
shlokas.12:
vyashvaH sadashvo vadhryashvaH pa~nchahastaH pRRithushravAH |
ruShadgurvRRiShasenashcha kShupashcha sumahAbalaH
shlokas.13:
ruShadashvo vasumanAH purukutso dhvajI rathI |
ArShTiSheNo dilIpashcha mahAtmA chApyushInaraH
shlokas.14:
aushInaraH puNDarIkaH sharyAtiH sharabhaH shuchiH |
a~Ngo.ariShTashcha venashcha duHShantaH sa~njayo jayaH
shlokas.15:
bhA~NgAsvariH sunIthashcha niShadho.atha tviShIrathaH |
karandhamo bAhlikashcha sudyumno balavAnmadhuH
shlokas.16:
kapotaromA tRRiNakaH sahadevArjunau tathA |
rAmo dAsharathishchaiva lakShmaNo.atha pratardanaH
shlokas.17:
alarkaH kakShasenashcha gayo gaurAshva eva cha |
jAmadagnyo.atha rAmo.atra nAbhAgasagarau tathA
shlokas.18:
bhUridyumno mahAshvashcha pRRithvashvo janakastathA |
vainyo rAjA vAriSheNaH purujo janamejayaH
shlokas.19:
brahmadattastrigartashcha rAjoparicharastathA |
indradyumno bhImajAnurgayaH pRRiShTho nayo.anaghaH
shlokas.20:
padmo.atha muchukundashcha bhUridyumnaH prasenajit |
ariShTanemiH pradyumnaH pRRithagashvo.ajakastathA
shlokas.21:
shataM matsyA nRRipatayaH shataM nIpAH shataM hayAH |
dhRRitarAShTrAshchaikashatamashItirjanamejayAH
shlokas.22:
shataM cha brahmadattAnAmIriNAM vairiNAM shatam |
shantanushchaiva rAjarShiH pANDushchaiva pitA tava
shlokas.23:
ushadgavaH shataratho devarAjo jayadrathaH |
vRRiShAdarbhishcha rAjarShirdhAmnA saha samantriNA
shlokas.24:
athApare sahasrANi ye gatAH shashabindavaH |
iShTvAshvamedhairbahubhirmahadbhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.25:
ete rAjarShayaH puNyAH kIrtimanto bahushrutAH |
tasyAM sabhAyAM rAjarShe vaivasvatamupAsate
shlokas.26:
agastyo.atha mata~Ngashcha kAlo mRRityustathaiva cha |
yajvAnashchaiva siddhAshcha ye cha yogasharIriNaH
shlokas.27:
agniShvAttAshcha pitaraH phenapAshchoShmapAshcha ye |
svadhAvanto barhiShado mUrtimantastathApare
shlokas.28:
kAlachakraM cha sAkShAchcha bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
narA duShkRRitakarmANo dakShiNAyanamRRityavaH
shlokas.29:
kAlasya nayane yuktA yamasya puruShAshcha ye |
tasyAM shi.nshapapAlAshAstathA kAshakushAdayaH
upAsate dharmarAjaM mUrtimanto nirAmayAH
shlokas.30:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH pitRRirAjasabhAsadaH |
ashakyAH parisa~NkhyAtuM nAmabhiH karmabhistathA
shlokas.31:
asambAdhA hi sA pArtha ramyA kAmagamA sabhA |
dIrghakAlaM tapastaptvA nirmitA vishvakarmaNA
shlokas.32:
prabhAsantI jvalantIva tejasA svena bhArata |
tAmugratapaso yAnti suvratAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.33:
shAntAH saMnyAsinaH siddhAH pUtAH puNyena karmaNA |
sarve bhAsvaradehAshcha sarve cha virajombarAH
shlokas.34:
chitrA~NgadAshchitramAlyAH sarve jvalitakuNDalAH |
sukRRitaiH karmabhiH puNyaiH paribarhairvibhUShitAH
shlokas.35:
gandharvAshcha mahAtmAnaH shatashashchApsarogaNAH |
vAditraM nRRittagItaM cha hAsyaM lAsyaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.36:
puNyAshcha gandhAH shabdAshcha tasyAM pArtha samantataH |
divyAni mAlyAni cha tAmupatiShThanti sarvashaH
shlokas.37:
shataM shatasahasrANi dharmiNAM taM prajeshvaram |
upAsate mahAtmAnaM rUpayuktA manasvinaH
shlokas.38:
IdRRishI sA sabhA rAjanpitRRirAj~no mahAtmanaH |
varuNasyApi vakShyAmi sabhAM puShkaramAlinIm

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
yudhiShThira sabhA divyA varuNasya sitaprabhA |
pramANena yathA yAmyA shubhaprAkAratoraNA
shlokas.2:
antaHsalilamAsthAya vihitA vishvakarmaNA |
divyaratnamayairvRRikShaiH phalapuShpapradairyutA
shlokas.3:
nIlapItAsitashyAmaiH sitairlohitakairapi |
avatAnaistathA gulmaiH puShpama~njaridhAribhiH
shlokas.4:
tathA shakunayastasyAM nAnArUpA mRRidusvarAH |
anirdeshyA vapuShmantaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
sA sabhA sukhasa.nsparshA na shItA na cha gharmadA |
veshmAsanavatI ramyA sitA varuNapAlitA
shlokas.6:
yasyAmAste sa varuNo vAruNyA saha bhArata |
divyaratnAmbaradharo bhUShaNairupashobhitaH
shlokas.7:
sragviNo bhUShitAshchApi divyamAlyAnukarShiNaH |
AdityAstatra varuNaM jaleshvaramupAsate
shlokas.8:
vAsukistakShakashchaiva nAgashchairAvatastathA |
kRRiShNashcha lohitashchaiva padmashchitrashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.9:
kambalAshvatarau nAgau dhRRitarAShTrabalAhakau |
maNimAnkuNDaladharaH karkoTakadhana~njayau
shlokas.10:
prahlAdo mUShikAdashcha tathaiva janamejayaH |
patAkino maNDalinaH phaNavantashcha sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH sarpAstasyAM yudhiShThira |
upAsate mahAtmAnaM varuNaM vigataklamAH
shlokas.12:
balirvairochano rAjA narakaH pRRithivI~njayaH |
prahlAdo viprachittishcha kAlakha~njAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
suhanurdurmukhaH sha~NkhaH sumanAH sumatiH svanaH |
ghaTodaro mahApArshvaH krathanaH piTharastathA
shlokas.14:
vishvarUpaH surUpashcha virUpo.atha mahAshirAH |
dashagrIvashcha vAlI cha meghavAsA dashAvaraH
shlokas.15:
kaiTabho viTaTUtashcha saMhrAdashchendratApanaH |
daityadAnavasa~NghAshcha sarve ruchirakuNDalAH
shlokas.16:
sragviNo maulinaH sarve tathA divyaparichChadAH |
sarve labdhavarAH shUrAH sarve vigatamRRityavaH
shlokas.17:
te tasyAM varuNaM devaM dharmapAshasthitAH sadA |
upAsate mahAtmAnaM sarve sucharitavratAH
shlokas.18:
tathA samudrAshchatvAro nadI bhAgIrathI cha yA |
kAlindI vidishA veNNA narmadA vegavAhinI
shlokas.19:
vipAshA cha shatadrushcha chandrabhAgA sarasvatI |
irAvatI vitastA cha sindhurdevanadastathA
shlokas.20:
godAvarI kRRiShNaveNNA kAverI cha saridvarA |
etAshchAnyAshcha saritastIrthAni cha sarA.nsi cha
shlokas.21:
kUpAshcha saprasravaNA dehavanto yudhiShThira |
palvalAni taDAgAni dehavantyatha bhArata
shlokas.22:
dishastathA mahI chaiva tathA sarve mahIdharAH |
upAsate mahAtmAnaM sarve jalacharAstathA
shlokas.23:
gItavAditravantashcha gandharvApsarasAM gaNAH |
stuvanto varuNaM tasyAM sarva eva samAsate
shlokas.24:
mahIdharA ratnavanto rasA yeShu pratiShThitAH |
sarve vigrahavantaste tamIshvaramupAsate
shlokas.25:
eShA mayA sampatatA vAruNI bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTapUrvA sabhA ramyA kuberasya sabhAM shRRiNu

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
sabhA vaishravaNI rAja~nshatayojanamAyatA |
vistIrNA saptatishchaiva yojanAni sitaprabhA
shlokas.2:
tapasA nirmitA rAjansvayaM vaishravaNena sA |
shashiprabhA khecharINAM kailAsashikharopamA
shlokas.3:
guhyakairuhyamAnA sA khe viShakteva dRRishyate |
divyA hemamayairuchchaiH pAdapairupashobhitA
shlokas.4:
rashmivatI bhAsvarA cha divyagandhA manoramA |
sitAbhrashikharAkArA plavamAneva dRRishyate
shlokas.5:
tasyAM vaishravaNo rAjA vichitrAbharaNAmbaraH |
strIsahasrAvRRitaH shrImAnAste jvalitakuNDalaH
shlokas.6:
divAkaranibhe puNye divyAstaraNasa.nvRRite |
divyapAdopadhAne cha niShaNNaH paramAsane
shlokas.7:
mandArANAmudArANAM vanAni surabhINi cha |
saugandhikAnAM chAdAya gandhAngandhavahaH shuchiH
shlokas.8:
nalinyAshchAlakAkhyAyAshchandanAnAM vanasya cha |
manohRRidayasaMhlAdI vAyustamupasevate
shlokas.9:
tatra devAH sagandharvA gaNairapsarasAM vRRitAH |
divyatAnena gItAni gAnti divyAni bhArata
shlokas.10:
mishrakeshI cha rambhA cha chitrasenA shuchismitA |
chArunetrA ghRRitAchI cha menakA pu~njikasthalA
shlokas.11:
vishvAchI sahajanyA cha pramlochA urvashI irA |
vargA cha saurabheyI cha samIchI budbudA latA
shlokas.12:
etAH sahasrashashchAnyA nRRittagItavishAradAH |
upatiShThanti dhanadaM pANDavApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.13:
anishaM divyavAditrairnRRittairgItaishcha sA sabhA |
ashUnyA ruchirA bhAti gandharvApsarasAM gaNaiH
shlokas.14:
kiMnarA nAma gandharvA narA nAma tathApare |
maNibhadro.atha dhanadaH shvetabhadrashcha guhyakaH
shlokas.15:
kasherako gaNDakaNDuH pradyotashcha mahAbalaH |
kustumburuH pishAchashcha gajakarNo vishAlakaH
shlokas.16:
varAhakarNaH sAndroShThaH phalabhakShaH phalodakaH |
a~NgachUDaH shikhAvarto hemanetro vibhIShaNaH
shlokas.17:
puShpAnanaH pi~NgalakaH shoNitodaH pravAlakaH |
vRRikShavAsyaniketashcha chIravAsAshcha bhArata
shlokas.18:
ete chAnye cha bahavo yakShAH shatasahasrashaH |
sadA bhagavatI cha shrIstathaiva nalakUbaraH
shlokas.19:
ahaM cha bahushastasyAM bhavantyanye cha madvidhAH |
AchAryAshchAbhava.nstatra tathA devarShayo.apare
shlokas.20:
bhagavAnbhUtasa~Nghaishcha vRRitaH shatasahasrashaH |
umApatiH pashupatiH shUladhRRigbhaganetrahA
shlokas.21:
tryambako rAjashArdUla devI cha vigataklamA |
vAmanairvikaTaiH kubjaiH kShatajAkShairmanojavaiH
shlokas.22:
mA.nsamedovasAhArairugrashravaNadarshanaiH |
nAnApraharaNairghorairvAtairiva mahAjavaiH
vRRitaH sakhAyamanvAste sadaiva dhanadaM nRRipa
shlokas.23:
sA sabhA tAdRRishI rAjanmayA dRRiShTAntarikShagA |
pitAmahasabhAM rAjankathayiShye gataklamAm

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
purA devayuge rAjannAdityo bhagavAndivaH |
AgachChanmAnuShaM lokaM didRRikShurvigataklamaH
shlokas.2:
charanmAnuSharUpeNa sabhAM dRRiShTvA svayambhuvaH |
sabhAmakathayanmahyaM brAhmIM tattvena pANDava
shlokas.3:
aprameyaprabhAM divyAM mAnasIM bharatarShabha |
anirdeshyAM prabhAvena sarvabhUtamanoramAm
shlokas.4:
shrutvA guNAnahaM tasyAH sabhAyAH pANDunandana |
darshanepsustathA rAjannAdityamahamabruvam
shlokas.5:
bhagavandraShTumichChAmi pitAmahasabhAmaham |
yena sA tapasA shakyA karmaNA vApi gopate
shlokas.6:
auShadhairvA tathA yuktairuta vA mAyayA yayA |
tanmamAchakShva bhagavanpashyeyaM tAM sabhAM katham
shlokas.7:
tataH sa bhagavAnsUryo mAmupAdAya vIryavAn |
agachChattAM sabhAM brAhmIM vipApAM vigataklamAm
shlokas.8:
eva.nrUpeti sA shakyA na nirdeShTuM janAdhipa |
kShaNena hi bibhartyanyadanirdeshyaM vapustathA
shlokas.9:
na veda parimANaM vA sa.nsthAnaM vApi bhArata |
na cha rUpaM mayA tAdRRigdRRiShTapUrvaM kadAchana
shlokas.10:
susukhA sA sabhA rAjanna shItA na cha gharmadA |
na kShutpipAse na glAniM prApya tAM prApnuvantyuta
shlokas.11:
nAnArUpairiva kRRitA suvichitraiH subhAsvaraiH |
stambhairna cha dhRRitA sA tu shAshvatI na cha sA kSharA
shlokas.12:
ati chandraM cha sUryaM cha shikhinaM cha svayamprabhA |
dIpyate nAkapRRiShThasthA bhAsayantIva bhAskaram
shlokas.13:
tasyAM sa bhagavAnAste vidadhaddevamAyayA |
svayameko.anishaM rAja.NllokA.NllokapitAmahaH
shlokas.14:
upatiShThanti chApyenaM prajAnAM patayaH prabhum |
dakShaH prachetAH pulaho marIchiH kashyapastathA
shlokas.15:
bhRRiguratrirvasiShThashcha gautamashcha tathA~NgirAH |
mano.antarikShaM vidyAshcha vAyustejo jalaM mahI
shlokas.16:
shabdaH sparshastathA rUpaM raso gandhashcha bhArata |
prakRRitishcha vikArashcha yachchAnyatkAraNaM bhuvaH
shlokas.17:
chandramAH saha nakShatrairAdityashcha gabhastimAn |
vAyavaH kratavashchaiva sa~NkalpaH prANa eva cha
shlokas.18:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH svayambhuvamupasthitAH |
artho dharmashcha kAmashcha harSho dveShastapo damaH
shlokas.19:
AyAnti tasyAM sahitA gandharvApsarasastathA |
vi.nshatiH sapta chaivAnye lokapAlAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.20:
shukro bRRihaspatishchaiva budho.a~NgAraka eva cha |
shanaishcharashcha rAhushcha grahAH sarve tathaiva cha
shlokas.21:
mantro rathantarashchaiva harimAnvasumAnapi |
AdityAH sAdhirAjAno nAnAdva.ndvairudAhRRitAH
shlokas.22:
maruto vishvakarmA cha vasavashchaiva bhArata |
tathA pitRRigaNAH sarve sarvANi cha havIMShyatha
shlokas.23:
RRigvedaH sAmavedashcha yajurvedashcha pANDava |
atharvavedashcha tathA parvANi cha vishAM pate
shlokas.24:
itihAsopavedAshcha vedA~NgAni cha sarvashaH |
grahA yaj~nAshcha somashcha daivatAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.25:
sAvitrI durgataraNI vANI saptavidhA tathA |
medhA dhRRitiH shrutishchaiva praj~nA buddhiryashaH kShamA
shlokas.26:
sAmAni stutishastrANi gAthAshcha vividhAstathA |
bhAShyANi tarkayuktAni dehavanti vishAM pate
shlokas.27:
kShaNA lavA muhUrtAshcha divA rAtristathaiva cha |
ardhamAsAshcha mAsAshcha RRitavaH ShaTcha bhArata
shlokas.28:
sa.nvatsarAH pa~nchayugamahorAtrAshchaturvidhAH |
kAlachakraM cha yaddivyaM nityamakShayamavyayam
shlokas.29:
aditirditirdanushchaiva surasA vinatA irA |
kAlakA surabhirdevI saramA chAtha gautamI
shlokas.30:
AdityA vasavo rudrA marutashchAshvinAvapi |
vishvedevAshcha sAdhyAshcha pitarashcha manojavAH
shlokas.31:
rAkShasAshcha pishAchAshcha dAnavA guhyakAstathA |
suparNanAgapashavaH pitAmahamupAsate
shlokas.32:
devo nArAyaNastasyAM tathA devarShayashcha ye |
RRiShayo vAlakhilyAshcha yonijAyonijAstathA
shlokas.33:
yachcha ki~nchittriloke.asmindRRishyate sthANuja~Ngamam |
sarvaM tasyAM mayA dRRiShTaM tadviddhi manujAdhipa
shlokas.34:
aShTAshItisahasrANi yatInAmUrdhvaretasAm |
prajAvatAM cha pa~nchAshadRRiShINAmapi pANDava
shlokas.35:
te sma tatra yathAkAmaM dRRiShTvA sarve divaukasaH |
praNamya shirasA tasmai pratiyAnti yathAgatam
shlokas.36:
atithInAgatAndevAndaityAnnAgAnmunI.nstathA |
yakShAnsuparNAnkAleyAngandharvApsarasastathA
shlokas.37:
mahAbhAgAnamitadhIrbrahmA lokapitAmahaH |
dayAvAnsarvabhUteShu yathArhaM pratipadyate
shlokas.38:
pratigRRihya cha vishvAtmA svayambhUramitaprabhaH |
sAntvamAnArthasambhogairyunakti manujAdhipa
shlokas.39:
tathA tairupayAtaishcha pratiyAtaishcha bhArata |
AkulA sA sabhA tAta bhavati sma sukhapradA
shlokas.40:
sarvatejomayI divyA brahmarShigaNasevitA |
brAhmyA shriyA dIpyamAnA shushubhe vigataklamA
shlokas.41:
sA sabhA tAdRRishI dRRiShTA sarvalokeShu durlabhA |
sabheyaM rAjashArdUla manuShyeShu yathA tava
shlokas.42:
etA mayA dRRiShTapUrvAH sabhA deveShu pANDava |
taveyaM mAnuShe loke sarvashreShThatamA sabhA
shlokas.43:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
prAyasho rAjalokaste kathito vadatAM vara |
vaivasvatasabhAyAM tu yathA vadasi vai prabho
shlokas.44:
varuNasya sabhAyAM tu nAgAste kathitA vibho |
daityendrAshchaiva bhUyiShThAH saritaH sAgarAstathA
shlokas.45:
tathA dhanapateryakShA guhyakA rAkShasAstathA |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva bhagavA.nshcha vRRiShadhvajaH
shlokas.46:
pitAmahasabhAyAM tu kathitAste maharShayaH |
sarvadevanikAyAshcha sarvashAstrANi chaiva hi
shlokas.47:
shatakratusabhAyAM tu devAH sa~NkIrtitA mune |
uddeshatashcha gandharvA vividhAshcha maharShayaH
shlokas.48:
eka eva tu rAjarShirharishchandro mahAmune |
kathitaste sabhAnityo devendrasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.49:
kiM karma tenAcharitaM tapo vA niyatavratam |
yenAsau saha shakreNa spardhate sma mahAyashAH
shlokas.50:
pitRRilokagatashchApi tvayA vipra pitA mama |
dRRiShTaH pANDurmahAbhAgaH kathaM chAsi samAgataH
shlokas.51:
kimuktavA.nshcha bhagavannetadichChAmi veditum |
tvattaH shrotumahaM sarvaM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.52:
nArada uvAcha||
yanmAM pRRichChasi rAjendra harishchandraM prati prabho |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi mAhAtmyaM tasya dhImataH
shlokas.53:
sa rAjA balavAnAsItsamrATsarvamahIkShitAm |
tasya sarve mahIpAlAH shAsanAvanatAH sthitAH
shlokas.54:
tenaikaM rathamAsthAya jaitraM hemavibhUShitam |
shastrapratApena jitA dvIpAH sapta nareshvara
shlokas.55:
sa vijitya mahIM sarvAM sashailavanakAnanAm |
AjahAra mahArAja rAjasUyaM mahAkratum
shlokas.56:
tasya sarve mahIpAlA dhanAnyAjahrurAj~nayA |
dvijAnAM pariveShTArastasminyaj~ne cha te.abhavan
shlokas.57:
prAdAchcha draviNaM prItyA yAjakAnAM nareshvaraH |
yathoktaM tatra taistasmi.nstataH pa~nchaguNAdhikam
shlokas.58:
atarpayachcha vividhairvasubhirbrAhmaNA.nstathA |
prAsarpakAle samprApte nAnAdigbhyaH samAgatAn
shlokas.59:
bhakShyairbhojyaishcha vividhairyathAkAmapuraskRRitaiH |
ratnaughatarpitaistuShTairdvijaishcha samudAhRRitam
tejasvI cha yashasvI cha nRRipebhyo.abhyadhiko.abhavat
shlokas.60:
etasmAtkAraNAtpArtha harishchandro virAjate |
tebhyo rAjasahasrebhyastadviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.61:
samApya cha harishchandro mahAyaj~naM pratApavAn |
abhiShiktaH sa shushubhe sAmrAjyena narAdhipa
shlokas.62:
ye chAnye.api mahIpAlA rAjasUyaM mahAkratum |
yajante te mahendreNa modante saha bhArata
shlokas.63:
ye chApi nidhanaM prAptAH sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH |
te tatsadaH samAsAdya modante bharatarShabha
shlokas.64:
tapasA ye cha tIvreNa tyajantIha kalevaram |
te.api tatsthAnamAsAdya shrImanto bhAnti nityashaH
shlokas.65:
pitA cha tvAha kaunteya pANDuH kauravanandanaH |
harishchandre shriyaM dRRiShTvA nRRipatau jAtavismayaH
shlokas.66:
samartho.asi mahIM jetuM bhrAtaraste vashe sthitAH |
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThamAharasveti bhArata
shlokas.67:
tasya tvaM puruShavyAghra sa~NkalpaM kuru pANDava |
gantAraste mahendrasya pUrvaiH saha salokatAm
shlokas.68:
bahuvighnashcha nRRipate kratureSha smRRito mahAn |
ChidrANyatra hi vA~nChanti yaj~naghnA brahmarAkShasAH
shlokas.69:
yuddhaM cha pRRiShThagamanaM pRRithivIkShayakArakam |
ki~nchideva nimittaM cha bhavatyatra kShayAvaham
shlokas.70:
etatsa~nchintya rAjendra yatkShamaM tatsamAchara |
apramattotthito nityaM chAturvarNyasya rakShaNe
bhava edhasva modasva dAnaistarpaya cha dvijAn
shlokas.71:
etatte vistareNoktaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
ApRRichChe tvAM gamiShyAmi dAshArhanagarIM prati
shlokas.72:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAkhyAya pArthebhyo nArado janamejaya |
jagAma tairvRRito rAjannRRiShibhiryaiH samAgataH
shlokas.73:
gate tu nArade pArtho bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaurava |
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThaM chintayAmAsa bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
RRiShestadvachanaM shrutvA nishashvAsa yudhiShThiraH |
chintayanrAjasUyAptiM na lebhe sharma bhArata
shlokas.2:
rAjarShINAM hi taM shrutvA mahimAnaM mahAtmanAm |
yajvanAM karmabhiH puNyairlokaprAptiM samIkShya cha
shlokas.3:
harishchandraM cha rAjarShiM rochamAnaM visheShataH |
yajvAnaM yaj~namAhartuM rAjasUyamiyeSha saH
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThirastataH sarvAnarchayitvA sabhAsadaH |
pratyarchitashcha taiH sarvairyaj~nAyaiva mano dadhe
shlokas.5:
sa rAjasUyaM rAjendra kurUNAmRRiShabhaH kratum |
AhartuM pravaNaM chakre manaH sa~nchintya so.asakRRit
shlokas.6:
bhUyashchAdbhutavIryaujA dharmamevAnupAlayan |
kiM hitaM sarvalokAnAM bhavediti mano dadhe
shlokas.7:
anugRRihNanprajAH sarvAH sarvadharmavidAM varaH |
avisheSheNa sarveShAM hitaM chakre yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.8:
evaM gate tatastasminpitarIvAshvasa~njanAH |
na tasya vidyate dveShTA tato.asyAjAtashatrutA
shlokas.9:
sa mantriNaH samAnAyya bhrAtR^I.nshcha vadatAM varaH |
rAjasUyaM prati tadA punaH punarapRRichChata
shlokas.10:
te pRRichChyamAnAH sahitA vacho.arthyaM mantriNastadA |
yudhiShThiraM mahAprAj~naM yiyakShumidamabruvan
shlokas.11:
yenAbhiShikto nRRipatirvAruNaM guNamRRichChati |
tena rAjApi sankRRitsnaM samrADguNamabhIpsati
shlokas.12:
tasya samrADguNArhasya bhavataH kurunandana |
rAjasUyasya samayaM manyante suhRRidastava
shlokas.13:
tasya yaj~nasya samayaH svAdhInaH kShatrasampadA |
sAmnA ShaDagnayo yasmi.nshchIyante sa.nshitavrataiH
shlokas.14:
darvIhomAnupAdAya sarvAnyaH prApnute kratUn |
abhiShekaM cha yaj~nAnte sarvajittena chochyate
shlokas.15:
samartho.asi mahAbAho sarve te vashagA vayam |
avichArya mahArAja rAjasUye manaH kuru
shlokas.16:
ityevaM suhRRidaH sarve pRRithakcha saha chAbruvan |
sa dharmyaM pANDavasteShAM vachaH shrutvA vishAM pate
dhRRiShTamiShTaM variShThaM cha jagrAha manasArihA
shlokas.17:
shrutvA suhRRidvachastachcha jAna.nshchApyAtmanaH kShamam |
punaH punarmano dadhre rAjasUyAya bhArata
shlokas.18:
sa bhrAtRRibhiH punardhImAnRRitvigbhishcha mahAtmabhiH |
dhaumyadvaipAyanAdyaishcha mantrayAmAsa mantribhiH
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
iyaM yA rAjasUyasya samrADarhasya sukratoH |
shraddadhAnasya vadataH spRRihA me sA kathaM bhavet
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktAstu te tena rAj~nA rAjIvalochana |
idamUchurvachaH kAle dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
arhastvamasi dharmaj~na rAjasUyaM mahAkratum
shlokas.21:
athaivamukte nRRipatAvRRitvigbhirRRiShibhistathA |
mantriNo bhrAtarashchAsya tadvachaH pratyapUjayan
shlokas.22:
sa tu rAjA mahAprAj~naH punarevAtmanAtmavAn |
bhUyo vimamRRishe pArtho lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.23:
sAmarthyayogaM samprekShya deshakAlau vyayAgamau |
vimRRishya samyakcha dhiyA kurvanprAj~no na sIdati
shlokas.24:
na hi yaj~nasamArambhaH kevalAtmavipattaye |
bhavatIti samAj~nAya yatnataH kAryamudvahan
shlokas.25:
sa nishchayArthaM kAryasya kRRiShNameva janArdanam |
sarvalokAtparaM matvA jagAma manasA harim
shlokas.26:
aprameyaM mahAbAhuM kAmAjjAtamajaM nRRiShu |
pANDavastarkayAmAsa karmabhirdevasaMmitaiH
shlokas.27:
nAsya ki~nchidavij~nAtaM nAsya ki~nchidakarmajam |
na sa ki~nchinna viShahediti kRRiShNamamanyata
shlokas.28:
sa tu tAM naiShThikIM buddhiM kRRitvA pArtho yudhiShThiraH |
guruvadbhUtagurave prAhiNoddUtama~njasA
shlokas.29:
shIghragena rathenAshu sa dUtaH prApya yAdavAn |
dvArakAvAsinaM kRRiShNaM dvAravatyAM samAsadat
shlokas.30:
darshanAkA~NkShiNaM pArthaM darshanAkA~NkShayAchyutaH |
indrasenena sahita indraprasthaM yayau tadA
shlokas.31:
vyatItya vividhAndeshA.nstvarAvAnkShipravAhanaH |
indraprasthagataM pArthamabhyagachChajjanArdanaH
shlokas.32:
sa gRRihe bhrAtRRivadbhrAtrA dharmarAjena pUjitaH |
bhImena cha tato.apashyatsvasAraM prItimAnpituH
shlokas.33:
prItaH priyeNa suhRRidA reme sa sahitastadA |
arjunena yamAbhyAM cha guruvatparyupasthitaH
shlokas.34:
taM vishrAntaM shubhe deshe kShaNinaM kalyamachyutam |
dharmarAjaH samAgamya j~nApayatsvaM prayojanam
shlokas.35:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
prArthito rAjasUyo me na chAsau kevalepsayA |
prApyate yena tatte ha viditaM kRRiShNa sarvashaH
shlokas.36:
yasminsarvaM sambhavati yashcha sarvatra pUjyate |
yashcha sarveshvaro rAjA rAjasUyaM sa vindati
shlokas.37:
taM rAjasUyaM suhRRidaH kAryamAhuH sametya me |
tatra me nishchitatamaM tava kRRiShNa girA bhavet
shlokas.38:
kechiddhi sauhRRidAdeva doShaM na parichakShate |
arthahetostathaivAnye priyameva vadantyuta
shlokas.39:
priyameva parIpsante kechidAtmani yaddhitam |
evamprAyAshcha dRRishyante janavAdAH prayojane
shlokas.40:
tvaM tu hetUnatItyaitAnkAmakrodhau vyatItya cha |
paramaM naH kShamaM loke yathAvadvaktumarhasi

shlokas.1:
shrIkRRiShNa uvAcha||
sarvairguNairmahArAja rAjasUyaM tvamarhasi |
jAnatastveva te sarvaM ki~nchidvakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.2:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa kShatraM yadavasheShitam |
tasmAdavarajaM loke yadidaM kShatrasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.3:
kRRito.ayaM kulasa~NkalpaH kShatriyairvasudhAdhipa |
nideshavAgbhistatte ha viditaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
ailasyekShvAkuva.nshasya prakRRitiM parichakShate |
rAjAnaH shreNibaddhAshcha tato.anye kShatriyA bhuvi
shlokas.5:
ailava.nshyAstu ye rAja.nstathaivekShvAkavo nRRipAH |
tAni chaikashataM viddhi kulAni bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
yayAtestveva bhojAnAM vistaro.atiguNo mahAn |
bhajate cha mahArAja vistaraH sa chaturdisham
shlokas.7:
teShAM tathaiva tAM lakShmIM sarvakShatramupAsate |
so.avanIM madhyamAM bhuktvA mithobhedeShvamanyata
shlokas.8:
chaturyustvaparo rAjA yasminnekashato.abhavat |
sa sAmrAjyaM jarAsandhaH prApto bhavati yonitaH
shlokas.9:
taM sa rAjA mahAprAj~na sa.nshritya kila sarvashaH |
rAjansenApatirjAtaH shishupAlaH pratApavAn
shlokas.10:
tameva cha mahArAja shiShyavatsamupasthitaH |
vakraH karUShAdhipatirmAyAyodhI mahAbalaH
shlokas.11:
aparau cha mahAvIryau mahAtmAnau samAshritau |
jarAsandhaM mahAvIryaM tau ha.nsaDibhakAvubhau
shlokas.12:
dantavakraH karUShashcha kalabho meghavAhanaH |
mUrdhnA divyaM maNiM bibhradyaM taM bhUtamaNiM viduH
shlokas.13:
muraM cha narakaM chaiva shAsti yo yavanAdhipau |
aparyantabalo rAjA pratIchyAM varuNo yathA
shlokas.14:
bhagadatto mahArAja vRRiddhastava pituH sakhA |
sa vAchA praNatastasya karmaNA chaiva bhArata
shlokas.15:
snehabaddhastu pitRRivanmanasA bhaktimA.nstvayi |
pratIchyAM dakShiNaM chAntaM pRRithivyAH pAti yo nRRipaH
shlokas.16:
mAtulo bhavataH shUraH purujitkuntivardhanaH |
sa te saMnatimAnekaH snehataH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.17:
jarAsandhaM gatastvevaM purA yo na mayA hataH |
puruShottamavij~nAto yo.asau chediShu durmatiH
shlokas.18:
AtmAnaM pratijAnAti loke.asminpuruShottamam |
Adatte satataM mohAdyaH sa chihnaM cha mAmakam
shlokas.19:
va~NgapuNDrakirAteShu rAjA balasamanvitaH |
pauNDrako vAsudeveti yo.asau lokeShu vishrutaH
shlokas.20:
chaturyuH sa mahArAja bhoja indrasakho balI |
vidyAbalAdyo vyajayatpANDyakrathakakaishikAn
shlokas.21:
bhrAtA yasyAhRRitiH shUro jAmadagnyasamo yudhi |
sa bhakto mAgadhaM rAjA bhIShmakaH paravIrahA
shlokas.22:
priyANyAcharataH prahvAnsadA sambandhinaH sataH |
bhajato na bhajatyasmAnapriyeShu vyavasthitaH
shlokas.23:
na kulaM na balaM rAjannabhijAna.nstathAtmanaH |
pashyamAno yasho dIptaM jarAsandhamupAshritaH
shlokas.24:
udIchyabhojAshcha tathA kulAnyaShTAdashAbhibho |
jarAsandhabhayAdeva pratIchIM dishamAshritAH
shlokas.25:
shUrasenA bhadrakArA bodhAH shAlvAH paTachcharAH |
sustharAshcha sukuTTAshcha kuNindAH kuntibhiH saha
shlokas.26:
shAlveyAnAM cha rAjAnaH sodaryAnucharaiH saha |
dakShiNA ye cha pA~nchAlAH pUrvAH kuntiShu koshalAH
shlokas.27:
tathottarAM dishaM chApi parityajya bhayArditAH |
matsyAH saMnyastapAdAshcha dakShiNAM dishamAshritAH
shlokas.28:
tathaiva sarvapA~nchAlA jarAsandhabhayArditAH |
svarAShTraM samparityajya vidrutAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.29:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya ka.nso nirmathya bAndhavAn |
bArhadrathasute devyAvupAgachChadvRRithAmatiH
shlokas.30:
astiH prAptishcha nAmnA te sahadevAnuje.abale |
balena tena sa j~nAtInabhibhUya vRRithAmatiH
shlokas.31:
shraiShThyaM prAptaH sa tasyAsIdatIvApanayo mahAn |
bhojarAjanyavRRiddhaistu pIDyamAnairdurAtmanA
shlokas.32:
j~nAtitrANamabhIpsadbhirasmatsambhAvanA kRRitA |
dattvAkrUrAya sutanuM tAmAhukasutAM tadA
shlokas.33:
sa~NkarShaNadvitIyena j~nAtikAryaM mayA kRRitam |
hatau ka.nsasunAmAnau mayA rAmeNa chApyuta
shlokas.34:
bhaye tu samupakrAnte jarAsandhe samudyate |
mantro.ayaM mantrito rAjankulairaShTAdashAvaraiH
shlokas.35:
anAramanto nighnanto mahAstraiH shataghAtibhiH |
na hanyAma vayaM tasya tribhirvarShashatairbalam
shlokas.36:
tasya hyamarasa~NkAshau balena balinAM varau |
nAmabhyAM ha.nsaDibhakAvityAstAM yodhasattamau
shlokas.37:
tAvubhau sahitau vIrau jarAsandhashcha vIryavAn |
trayastrayANAM lokAnAM paryAptA iti me matiH
shlokas.38:
na hi kevalamasmAkaM yAvanto.anye cha pArthivAH |
tathaiva teShAmAsIchcha buddhirbuddhimatAM vara
shlokas.39:
atha ha.nsa iti khyAtaH kashchidAsInmahAnnRRipaH |
sa chAnyaiH sahito rAjansa~NgrAme.aShTAdashAvaraiH
shlokas.40:
hato ha.nsa iti proktamatha kenApi bhArata |
tachChrutvA Dibhako rAjanyamunAmbhasyamajjata
shlokas.41:
vinA ha.nsena loke.asminnAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
ityetAM matimAsthAya Dibhako nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.42:
tathA tu DibhakaM shrutvA ha.nsaH parapura~njayaH |
prapede yamunAmeva so.api tasyAM nyamajjata
shlokas.43:
tau sa rAjA jarAsandhaH shrutvApsu nidhanaM gatau |
svapuraM shUrasenAnAM prayayau bharatarShabha
shlokas.44:
tato vayamamitraghna tasminpratigate nRRipe |
punarAnanditAH sarve mathurAyAM vasAmahe
shlokas.45:
yadA tvabhyetya pitaraM sA vai rAjIvalochanA |
ka.nsabhAryA jarAsandhaM duhitA mAgadhaM nRRipam
shlokas.46:
chodayatyeva rAjendra pativyasanaduHkhitA |
patighnaM me jahItyevaM punaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.47:
tato vayaM mahArAja taM mantraM pUrvamantritam |
sa.nsmaranto vimanaso vyapayAtA narAdhipa
shlokas.48:
pRRithaktvena drutA rAjansa~NkShipya mahatIM shriyam |
prapatAmo bhayAttasya sadhanaj~nAtibAndhavAH
shlokas.49:
iti sa~nchintya sarve sma pratIchIM dishamAshritAH |
kushasthalIM purIM ramyAM raivatenopashobhitAm
shlokas.50:
punarniveshanaM tasyAM kRRitavanto vayaM nRRipa |
tathaiva durgasa.nskAraM devairapi durAsadam
shlokas.51:
striyo.api yasyAM yudhyeyuH kiM punarvRRiShNipu~NgavAH |
tasyAM vayamamitraghna nivasAmo.akutobhayAH
shlokas.52:
Alokya girimukhyaM taM mAdhavItIrthameva cha |
mAdhavAH kurushArdUla parAM mudamavApnuvan
shlokas.53:
evaM vayaM jarAsandhAdAditaH kRRitakilbiShAH |
sAmarthyavantaH sambandhAdbhavantaM samupAshritAH
shlokas.54:
triyojanAyataM sadma triskandhaM yojanAdadhi |
yojanAnte shatadvAraM vikramakramatoraNam
aShTAdashAvarairnaddhaM kShatriyairyuddhadurmadaiH
shlokas.55:
aShTAdasha sahasrANi vrAtAnAM santi naH kule |
Ahukasya shataM putrA ekaikastrishatAvaraH
shlokas.56:
chArudeShNaH saha bhrAtrA chakradevo.atha sAtyakiH |
ahaM cha rauhiNeyashcha sAmbaH shaurisamo yudhi
shlokas.57:
evamete rathAH sapta rAjannanyAnnibodha me |
kRRitavarmA anAdhRRiShTiH samIkaH samiti~njayaH
shlokas.58:
kahvaH sha~NkurnidAntashcha saptaivaite mahArathAH |
putrau chAndhakabhojasya vRRiddho rAjA cha te dasha
shlokas.59:
lokasaMhananA vIrA vIryavanto mahAbalAH |
smaranto madhyamaM deshaM vRRiShNimadhye gatavyathAH
shlokas.60:
sa tvaM samrADguNairyuktaH sadA bharatasattama |
kShatre samrAjamAtmAnaM kartumarhasi bhArata
shlokas.61:
na tu shakyaM jarAsandhe jIvamAne mahAbale |
rAjasUyastvayA prAptumeShA rAjanmatirmama
shlokas.62:
tena ruddhA hi rAjAnaH sarve jitvA girivraje |
kandarAyAM girIndrasya siMheneva mahAdvipAH
shlokas.63:
so.api rAjA jarAsandho yiyakShurvasudhAdhipaiH |
ArAdhya hi mahAdevaM nirjitAstena pArthivAH
shlokas.64:
sa hi nirjitya nirjitya pArthivAnpRRitanAgatAn |
puramAnIya baddhvA cha chakAra puruShavrajam
shlokas.65:
vayaM chaiva mahArAja jarAsandhabhayAttadA |
mathurAM samparityajya gatA dvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.66:
yadi tvenaM mahArAja yaj~naM prAptumihechChasi |
yatasva teShAM mokShAya jarAsandhavadhAya cha
shlokas.67:
samArambho hi shakyo.ayaM nAnyathA kurunandana |
rAjasUyasya kArtsnyena kartuM matimatAM vara
shlokas.68:
ityeShA me matI rAjanyathA vA manyase.anagha |
evaM gate mamAchakShva svayaM nishchitya hetubhiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktaM tvayA buddhimatA yannAnyo vaktumarhati |
sa.nshayAnAM hi nirmoktA tvannAnyo vidyate bhuvi
shlokas.2:
gRRihe gRRihe hi rAjAnaH svasya svasya priya~NkarAH |
na cha sAmrAjyamAptAste samrATshabdo hi kRRitsnabhAk
shlokas.3:
kathaM parAnubhAvaj~naH svaM prasha.nsitumarhati |
pareNa samavetastu yaH prashastaH sa pUjyate
shlokas.4:
vishAlA bahulA bhUmirbahuratnasamAchitA |
dUraM gatvA vijAnAti shreyo vRRiShNikulodvaha
shlokas.5:
shamameva paraM manye na tu mokShAdbhavechChamaH |
Arambhe pArameShThyaM tu na prApyamiti me matiH
shlokas.6:
evamevAbhijAnanti kule jAtA manasvinaH |
kashchitkadAchideteShAM bhavechChreShTho janArdana
shlokas.7:
bhIma uvAcha||
anArambhaparo rAjA valmIka iva sIdati |
durbalashchAnupAyena balinaM yo.adhitiShThati
shlokas.8:
atandritastu prAyeNa durbalo balinaM ripum |
jayetsamya~Nnayo rAjannItyArthAnAtmano hitAn
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNe nayo mayi balaM jayaH pArthe dhana~njaye |
mAgadhaM sAdhayiShyAmo vayaM traya ivAgnayaH
shlokas.10:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
Adatte.arthaparo bAlo nAnubandhamavekShate |
tasmAdariM na mRRiShyanti bAlamarthaparAyaNam
shlokas.11:
hitvA karAnyauvanAshvaH pAlanAchcha bhagIrathaH |
kArtavIryastapoyogAdbalAttu bharato vibhuH
RRiddhyA maruttastAnpa~ncha samrAja iti shushrumaH
shlokas.12:
nigrAhyalakShaNaM prApto dharmArthanayalakShaNaiH |
bArhadratho jarAsandhastadviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
na chainamanurudhyante kulAnyekashataM nRRipAH |
tasmAdetadbalAdeva sAmrAjyaM kurute.adya saH
shlokas.14:
ratnabhAjo hi rAjAno jarAsandhamupAsate |
na cha tuShyati tenApi bAlyAdanayamAsthitaH
shlokas.15:
mUrdhAbhiShiktaM nRRipatiM pradhAnapuruShaM balAt |
Adatte na cha no dRRiShTo.abhAgaH puruShataH kvachit
shlokas.16:
evaM sarvAnvashe chakre jarAsandhaH shatAvarAn |
taM durbalataro rAjA kathaM pArtha upaiShyati
shlokas.17:
prokShitAnAM pramRRiShTAnAM rAj~nAM pashupatergRRihe |
pashUnAmiva kA prItirjIvite bharatarShabha
shlokas.18:
kShatriyaH shastramaraNo yadA bhavati satkRRitaH |
nanu sma mAgadhaM sarve pratibAdhema yadvayam
shlokas.19:
ShaDashItiH samAnItAH sheShA rAja.nshchaturdasha |
jarAsandhena rAjAnastataH krUraM prapatsyate
shlokas.20:
prApnuyAtsa yasho dIptaM tatra yo vighnamAcharet |
jayedyashcha jarAsandhaM sa samrANniyataM bhavet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
samrADguNamabhIpsanvai yuShmAnsvArthaparAyaNaH |
kathaM prahiNuyAM bhImaM balAtkevalasAhasAt
shlokas.2:
bhImArjunAvubhau netre mano manye janArdanam |
manashchakShurvihInasya kIdRRishaM jIvitaM bhavet
shlokas.3:
jarAsandhabalaM prApya duShpAraM bhImavikramam |
shramo hi vaH parAjayyAtkimu tatra vicheShTitam
shlokas.4:
asminnarthAntare yuktamanarthaH pratipadyate |
yathAhaM vimRRishAmyekastattAvachChrUyatAM mama
shlokas.5:
saMnyAsaM rochaye sAdhu kAryasyAsya janArdana |
pratihanti mano me.adya rAjasUyo durAsadaH
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pArthaH prApya dhanuHshreShThamakShayyau cha maheShudhI |
rathaM dhvajaM sabhAM chaiva yudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.7:
dhanurastraM sharA vIryaM pakSho bhUmiryasho balam |
prAptametanmayA rAjanduShprApaM yadabhIpsitam
shlokas.8:
kule janma prasha.nsanti vaidyAH sAdhu suniShThitAH |
balena sadRRishaM nAsti vIryaM tu mama rochate
shlokas.9:
kRRitavIryakule jAto nirvIryaH kiM kariShyati |
kShatriyaH sarvasho rAjanyasya vRRittiH parAjaye
shlokas.10:
sarvairapi guNairhIno vIryavAnhi taredripUn |
sarvairapi guNairyukto nirvIryaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.11:
dravyabhUtA guNAH sarve tiShThanti hi parAkrame |
jayasya hetuH siddhirhi karma daivaM cha sa.nshritam
shlokas.12:
sa.nyukto hi balaiH kashchitpramAdAnnopayujyate |
tena dvAreNa shatrubhyaH kShIyate sabalo ripuH
shlokas.13:
dainyaM yathAbalavati tathA moho balAnvite |
tAvubhau nAshakau hetU rAj~nA tyAjyau jayArthinA
shlokas.14:
jarAsandhavinAshaM cha rAj~nAM cha parimokShaNam |
yadi kuryAma yaj~nArthaM kiM tataH paramaM bhavet
shlokas.15:
anArambhe tu niyato bhavedaguNanishchayaH |
guNAnniHsa.nshayAdrAjannairguNyaM manyase katham
shlokas.16:
kAShAyaM sulabhaM pashchAnmunInAM shamamichChatAm |
sAmrAjyaM tu tavechChanto vayaM yotsyAmahe paraiH

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
jAtasya bhArate va.nshe tathA kuntyAH sutasya cha |
yA vai yuktA matiH seyamarjunena pradarshitA
shlokas.2:
na mRRityoH samayaM vidma rAtrau vA yadi vA divA |
na chApi ka~nchidamaramayuddhenApi shushrumaH
shlokas.3:
etAvadeva puruShaiH kAryaM hRRidayatoShaNam |
nayena vidhidRRiShTena yadupakramate parAn
shlokas.4:
sunayasyAnapAyasya sa.nyuge paramaH kramaH |
sa.nshayo jAyate sAmye sAmyaM cha na bhaveddvayoH
shlokas.5:
te vayaM nayamAsthAya shatrudehasamIpagAH |
kathamantaM na gachChema vRRikShasyeva nadIrayAH
pararandhre parAkrAntAH svarandhrAvaraNe sthitAH
shlokas.6:
vyUDhAnIkairanubalairnopeyAdbalavattaram |
iti buddhimatAM nItistanmamApIha rochate
shlokas.7:
anavadyA hyasambuddhAH praviShTAH shatrusadma tat |
shatrudehamupAkramya taM kAmaM prApnuyAmahe
shlokas.8:
eko hyeva shriyaM nityaM bibharti puruSharShabha |
antarAtmeva bhUtAnAM tatkShaye vai balakShayaH
shlokas.9:
atha chettaM nihatyAjau sheSheNAbhisamAgatAH |
prApnuyAma tataH svargaM j~nAtitrANaparAyaNAH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kRRiShNa ko.ayaM jarAsandhaH ki.nvIryaH kimparAkramaH |
yastvAM spRRiShTvAgnisadRRishaM na dagdhaH shalabho yathA
shlokas.11:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAja~njarAsandho yadvIryo yatparAkramaH |
yathA chopekShito.asmAbhirbahushaH kRRitavipriyaH
shlokas.12:
akShauhiNInAM tisRRiNAmAsItsamaradarpitaH |
rAjA bRRihadratho nAma magadhAdhipatiH patiH
shlokas.13:
rUpavAnvIryasampannaH shrImAnatulavikramaH |
nityaM dIkShAkRRishatanuH shatakraturivAparaH
shlokas.14:
tejasA sUryasadRRishaH kShamayA pRRithivIsamaH |
yamAntakasamaH kope shriyA vaishravaNopamaH
shlokas.15:
tasyAbhijanasa.nyuktairguNairbharatasattama |
vyApteyaM pRRithivI sarvA sUryasyeva gabhastibhiH
shlokas.16:
sa kAshirAjasya sute yamaje bharatarShabha |
upayeme mahAvIryo rUpadraviNasaMmate
shlokas.17:
tayoshchakAra samayaM mithaH sa puruSharShabhaH |
nAtivartiShya ityevaM patnIbhyAM saMnidhau tadA
shlokas.18:
sa tAbhyAM shushubhe rAjA patnIbhyAM manujAdhipa |
priyAbhyAmanurUpAbhyAM kareNubhyAmiva dvipaH
shlokas.19:
tayormadhyagatashchApi rarAja vasudhAdhipaH |
ga~NgAyamunayormadhye mUrtimAniva sAgaraH
shlokas.20:
viShayeShu nimagnasya tasya yauvanamatyagAt |
na cha va.nshakaraH putrastasyAjAyata kashchana
shlokas.21:
ma~NgalairbahubhirhomaiH putrakAmAbhiriShTibhiH |
nAsasAda nRRipashreShThaH putraM kulavivardhanam
shlokas.22:
atha kAkShIvataH putraM gautamasya mahAtmanaH |
shushrAva tapasi shrAntamudAraM chaNDakaushikam
shlokas.23:
yadRRichChayAgataM taM tu vRRikShamUlamupAshritam |
patnIbhyAM sahito rAjA sarvaratnairatoShayat
shlokas.24:
tamabravItsatyadhRRitiH satyavAgRRiShisattamaH |
parituShTo.asmi te rAjanvaraM varaya suvrata
shlokas.25:
tataH sabhAryaH praNatastamuvAcha bRRihadrathaH |
putradarshananairAshyAdbAShpagadgadayA girA
shlokas.26:
bRRihadratha uvAcha||
bhagavanrAjyamutsRRijya prasthitasya tapovanam |
kiM vareNAlpabhAgyasya kiM rAjyenAprajasya me
shlokas.27:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
etachChrutvA munirdhyAnamagamatkShubhitendriyaH |
tasyaiva chAmravRRikShasya ChAyAyAM samupAvishat
shlokas.28:
tasyopaviShTasya munerutsa~Nge nipapAta ha |
avAtamashukAdaShTamekamAmraphalaM kila
shlokas.29:
tatpragRRihya munishreShTho hRRidayenAbhimantrya cha |
rAj~ne dadAvapratimaM putrasamprAptikArakam
shlokas.30:
uvAcha cha mahAprAj~nastaM rAjAnaM mahAmuniH |
gachCha rAjankRRitArtho.asi nivarta manujAdhipa
shlokas.31:
yathAsamayamAj~nAya tadA sa nRRipasattamaH |
dvAbhyAmekaM phalaM prAdAtpatnIbhyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.32:
te tadAmraM dvidhA kRRitvA bhakShayAmAsatuH shubhe |
bhAvitvAdapi chArthasya satyavAkyAttathA muneH
shlokas.33:
tayoH samabhavadgarbhaH phalaprAshanasambhavaH |
te cha dRRiShTvA narapatiH parAM mudamavApa ha
shlokas.34:
atha kAle mahAprAj~na yathAsamayamAgate |
prajAyetAmubhe rAja~nsharIrashakale tadA
shlokas.35:
ekAkShibAhucharaNe ardhodaramukhasphije |
dRRiShTvA sharIrashakale pravepAte ubhe bhRRisham
shlokas.36:
udvigne saha saMmantrya te bhaginyau tadAbale |
sajIve prANishakale tatyajAte suduHkhite
shlokas.37:
tayordhAtryau susa.nvIte kRRitvA te garbhasamplave |
nirgamyAntaHpuradvArAtsamutsRRijyAshu jagmatuH
shlokas.38:
te chatuShpathanikShipte jarA nAmAtha rAkShasI |
jagrAha manujavyAghra mA.nsashoNitabhojanA
shlokas.39:
kartukAmA sukhavahe shakale sA tu rAkShasI |
sa~NghaTTayAmAsa tadA vidhAnabalachoditA
shlokas.40:
te samAnItamAtre tu shakale puruSharShabha |
ekamUrtikRRite vIraH kumAraH samapadyata
shlokas.41:
tataH sA rAkShasI rAjanvismayotphullalochanA |
na shashAka samudvoDhuM vajrasAramayaM shishum
shlokas.42:
bAlastAmratalaM muShTiM kRRitvA chAsye nidhAya saH |
prAkroshadatisa.nrambhAtsatoya iva toyadaH
shlokas.43:
tena shabdena sambhrAntaH sahasAntaHpure janaH |
nirjagAma naravyAghra rAj~nA saha parantapa
shlokas.44:
te chAbale pariglAne payaHpUrNapayodhare |
nirAshe putralAbhAya sahasaivAbhyagachChatAm
shlokas.45:
atha dRRiShTvA tathAbhUte rAjAnaM cheShTasantatim |
taM cha bAlaM subalinaM chintayAmAsa rAkShasI
shlokas.46:
nArhAmi viShaye rAj~no vasantI putragRRiddhinaH |
bAlaM putramupAdAtuM meghalekheva bhAskaram
shlokas.47:
sA kRRitvA mAnuShaM rUpamuvAcha manujAdhipam |
bRRihadratha sutaste.ayaM maddattaH pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.48:
tava patnIdvaye jAto dvijAtivarashAsanAt |
dhAtrIjanaparityakto mayAyaM parirakShitaH
shlokas.49:
tataste bharatashreShTha kAshirAjasute shubhe |
taM bAlamabhipatyAshu prasnavairabhiShi~nchatAm
shlokas.50:
tataH sa rAjA saMhRRiShTaH sarvaM tadupalabhya cha |
apRRichChannavahemAbhAM rAkShasIM tAmarAkShasIm
shlokas.51:
kA tvaM kamalagarbhAbhe mama putrapradAyinI |
kAmayA brUhi kalyANi devatA pratibhAsi me

shlokas.1:
rAkShasyuvAcha||
jarA nAmAsmi bhadraM te rAkShasI kAmarUpiNI |
tava veshmani rAjendra pUjitA nyavasaM sukham
shlokas.2:
sAhaM pratyupakArArthaM chintayantyanishaM nRRipa |
taveme putrashakale dRRiShTavatyasmi dhArmika
shlokas.3:
sa.nshleShite mayA daivAtkumAraH samapadyata |
tava bhAgyairmahArAja hetumAtramahaM tviha
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu sA rAja.nstatraivAntaradhIyata |
sa gRRihya cha kumAraM taM prAvishatsvagRRihaM nRRipaH
shlokas.5:
tasya bAlasya yatkRRityaM tachchakAra nRRipastadA |
Aj~nApayachcha rAkShasyA mAgadheShu mahotsavam
shlokas.6:
tasya nAmAkarottatra prajApatisamaH pitA |
jarayA sandhito yasmAjjarAsandhastato.abhavat
shlokas.7:
so.avardhata mahAtejA magadhAdhipateH sutaH |
pramANabalasampanno hutAhutirivAnalaH
shlokas.8:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya punareva mahAtapAH |
magadhAnupachakrAma bhagavA.nshchaNDakaushikaH
shlokas.9:
tasyAgamanasaMhRRiShTaH sAmAtyaH sapuraHsaraH |
sabhAryaH saha putreNa nirjagAma bRRihadrathaH
shlokas.10:
pAdyArghyAchamanIyaistamarchayAmAsa bhArata |
sa nRRipo rAjyasahitaM putraM chAsmai nyavedayat
shlokas.11:
pratigRRihya tu tAM pUjAM pArthivAdbhagavAnRRiShiH |
uvAcha mAgadhaM rAjanprahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.12:
sarvametanmayA rAjanvij~nAtaM j~nAnachakShuShA |
putrastu shRRiNu rAjendra yAdRRisho.ayaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
asya vIryavato vIryaM nAnuyAsyanti pArthivAH |
devairapi visRRiShTAni shastrANyasya mahIpate
na rujaM janayiShyanti gireriva nadIrayAH
shlokas.14:
sarvamUrdhAbhiShiktAnAmeSha mUrdhni jvaliShyati |
sarveShAM niShprabhakaro jyotiShAmiva bhAskaraH
shlokas.15:
enamAsAdya rAjAnaH samRRiddhabalavAhanAH |
vinAshamupayAsyanti shalabhA iva pAvakam
shlokas.16:
eSha shriyaM samuditAM sarvarAj~nAM grahIShyati |
varShAsvivoddhatajalA nadIrnadanadIpatiH
shlokas.17:
eSha dhArayitA samyakchAturvarNyaM mahAbalaH |
shubhAshubhamiva sphItA sarvasasyadharA dharA
shlokas.18:
asyAj~nAvashagAH sarve bhaviShyanti narAdhipAH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya vAyoriva sharIriNaH
shlokas.19:
eSha rudraM mahAdevaM tripurAntakaraM haram |
sarvalokeShvatibalaH svayaM drakShyati mAgadhaH
shlokas.20:
evaM bruvanneva muniH svakAryArthaM vichintayan |
visarjayAmAsa nRRipaM bRRihadrathamathArihan
shlokas.21:
pravishya nagaraM chaiva j~nAtisambandhibhirvRRitaH |
abhiShichya jarAsandhaM magadhAdhipatistadA
bRRihadratho narapatiH parAM nirvRRitimAyayau
shlokas.22:
abhiShikte jarAsandhe tadA rAjA bRRihadrathaH |
patnIdvayenAnugatastapovanarato.abhavat
shlokas.23:
tapovanasthe pitari mAtRRibhyAM saha bhArata |
jarAsandhaH svavIryeNa pArthivAnakarodvashe
shlokas.24:
atha dIrghasya kAlasya tapovanagato nRRipaH |
sabhAryaH svargamagamattapastaptvA bRRihadrathaH
shlokas.25:
tasyAstAM ha.nsaDibhakAvashastranidhanAvubhau |
mantre matimatAM shreShThau yuddhashAstravishAradau
shlokas.26:
yau tau mayA te kathitau pUrvameva mahAbalau |
trayastrayANAM lokAnAM paryAptA iti me matiH
shlokas.27:
evameSha tadA vIra balibhiH kukurAndhakaiH |
vRRiShNibhishcha mahArAja nItihetorupekShitaH

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
patitau ha.nsaDibhakau ka.nsAmAtyau nipAtitau |
jarAsandhasya nidhane kAlo.ayaM samupAgataH
shlokas.2:
na sa shakyo raNe jetuM sarvairapi surAsuraiH |
prANayuddhena jetavyaH sa ityupalabhAmahe
shlokas.3:
mayi nItirbalaM bhIme rakShitA chAvayorjunaH |
sAdhayiShyAma taM rAjanvayaM traya ivAgnayaH
shlokas.4:
tribhirAsAdito.asmAbhirvijane sa narAdhipaH |
na sa.ndeho yathA yuddhamekenAbhyupayAsyati
shlokas.5:
avamAnAchcha lokasya vyAyatatvAchcha dharShitaH |
bhImasenena yuddhAya dhruvamabhyupayAsyati
shlokas.6:
alaM tasya mahAbAhurbhImaseno mahAbalaH |
lokasya samudIrNasya nidhanAyAntako yathA
shlokas.7:
yadi te hRRidayaM vetti yadi te pratyayo mayi |
bhImasenArjunau shIghraM nyAsabhUtau prayachCha me
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto bhagavatA pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiraH |
bhImapArthau samAlokya samprahRRiShTamukhau sthitau
shlokas.9:
achyutAchyuta mA maivaM vyAharAmitrakarShaNa |
pANDavAnAM bhavAnnAtho bhavantaM chAshritA vayam
shlokas.10:
yathA vadasi govinda sarvaM tadupapadyate |
na hi tvamagratasteShAM yeShAM lakShmIH parA~NmukhI
shlokas.11:
nihatashcha jarAsandho mokShitAshcha mahIkShitaH |
rAjasUyashcha me labdho nideshe tava tiShThataH
shlokas.12:
kShiprakArinyathA tvetatkAryaM samupapadyate |
mama kAryaM jagatkAryaM tathA kuru narottama
shlokas.13:
tribhirbhavadbhirhi vinA nAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
dharmakAmArtharahito rogArta iva durgataH
shlokas.14:
na shauriNA vinA pArtho na shauriH pANDavaM vinA |
nAjeyo.astyanayorloke kRRiShNayoriti me matiH
shlokas.15:
ayaM cha balinAM shreShThaH shrImAnapi vRRikodaraH |
yuvAbhyAM sahito vIraH kiM na kuryAnmahAyashAH
shlokas.16:
supraNIto balaugho hi kurute kAryamuttamam |
andhaM jaDaM balaM prAhuH praNetavyaM vichakShaNaiH
shlokas.17:
yato hi nimnaM bhavati nayantIha tato jalam |
yatashChidraM tatashchApi nayante dhIdhanA balam
shlokas.18:
tasmAnnayavidhAnaj~naM puruShaM lokavishrutam |
vayamAshritya govindaM yatAmaH kAryasiddhaye
shlokas.19:
evaM praj~nAnayabalaM kriyopAyasamanvitam |
puraskurvIta kAryeShu kRRiShNa kAryArthasiddhaye
shlokas.20:
evameva yadushreShThaM pArthaH kAryArthasiddhaye |
arjunaH kRRiShNamanvetu bhImo.anvetu dhana~njayam
nayo jayo balaM chaiva vikrame siddhimeShyati
shlokas.21:
evamuktAstataH sarve bhrAtaro vipulaujasaH |
vArShNeyaH pANDaveyau cha pratasthurmAgadhaM prati
shlokas.22:
varchasvinAM brAhmaNAnAM snAtakAnAM parichChadAn |
AchChAdya suhRRidAM vAkyairmanoj~nairabhinanditAH
shlokas.23:
amarShAdabhitaptAnAM j~nAtyarthaM mukhyavAsasAm |
ravisomAgnivapuShAM bhImamAsIttadA vapuH
shlokas.24:
hataM mene jarAsandhaM dRRiShTvA bhImapurogamau |
ekakAryasamudyuktau kRRiShNau yuddhe.aparAjitau
shlokas.25:
Ishau hi tau mahAtmAnau sarvakAryapravartane |
dharmArthakAmakAryANAM kAryANAmiva nigrahe
shlokas.26:
kurubhyaH prasthitAste tu madhyena kurujA~Ngalam |
ramyaM padmasaro gatvA kAlakUTamatItya cha
shlokas.27:
gaNDakIyAM tathA shoNaM sadAnIrAM tathaiva cha |
ekaparvatake nadyaH krameNaitya vrajanti te
shlokas.28:
santIrya sarayUM ramyAM dRRiShTvA pUrvA.nshcha kosalAn |
atItya jagmurmithilAM mAlAM charmaNvatIM nadIm
shlokas.29:
uttIrya ga~NgAM shoNaM cha sarve te prA~NmukhAstrayaH |
kuravorashChadaM jagmurmAgadhaM kShetramachyutAH
shlokas.30:
te shashvadgodhanAkIrNamambumantaM shubhadrumam |
gorathaM girimAsAdya dadRRishurmAgadhaM puram

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
eSha pArtha mahAnsvAduH pashumAnnityamambumAn |
nirAmayaH suveshmADhyo nivesho mAgadhaH shubhaH
shlokas.2:
vaihAro vipulaH shailo varAho vRRiShabhastathA |
tathaivarShigiristAta shubhAshchaityakapa~nchamAH
shlokas.3:
ete pa~ncha mahAshRRi~NgAH parvatAH shItaladrumAH |
rakShantIvAbhisaMhatya saMhatA~NgA girivrajam
shlokas.4:
puShpaveShTitashAkhAgrairgandhavadbhirmanoramaiH |
nigUDhA iva lodhrANAM vanaiH kAmijanapriyaiH
shlokas.5:
shUdrAyAM gautamo yatra mahAtmA sa.nshitavrataH |
aushInaryAmajanayatkAkShIvAdInsutAnRRiShiH
shlokas.6:
gautamaH kShayaNAdasmAdathAsau tatra veshmani |
bhajate mAgadhaM va.nshaM sa nRRipANAmanugrahAt
shlokas.7:
a~Ngava~NgAdayashchaiva rAjAnaH sumahAbalAH |
gautamakShayamabhyetya ramante sma purArjuna
shlokas.8:
vanarAjIstu pashyemAH priyAlAnAM manoramAH |
lodhrANAM cha shubhAH pArtha gautamaukaHsamIpajAH
shlokas.9:
arbudaH shakravApI cha pannagau shatrutApanau |
svastikasyAlayashchAtra maNinAgasya chottamaH
shlokas.10:
aparihAryA meghAnAM mAgadheyaM maNeH kRRite |
kaushiko maNimA.nshchaiva vavRRidhAte hyanugraham
shlokas.11:
arthasiddhiM tvanapagAM jarAsandho.abhimanyate |
vayamAsAdane tasya darpamadya nihanma hi
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tataH sarve bhrAtaro vipulaujasaH |
vArShNeyaH pANDaveyau cha pratasthurmAgadhaM puram
shlokas.13:
tuShTapuShTajanopetaM chAturvarNyajanAkulam |
sphItotsavamanAdhRRiShyamAsedushcha girivrajam
shlokas.14:
te.atha dvAramanAsAdya purasya girimuchChritam |
bArhadrathaiH pUjyamAnaM tathA nagaravAsibhiH
shlokas.15:
yatra mAShAdamRRiShabhamAsasAda bRRihadrathaH |
taM hatvA mAShanAlAshcha tisro bherIrakArayat
shlokas.16:
Anahya charmaNA tena sthApayAmAsa sve pure |
yatra tAH prANadanbheryo divyapuShpAvachUrNitAH
shlokas.17:
mAgadhAnAM suruchiraM chaityakAntaM samAdravan |
shirasIva jighA.nsanto jarAsandhajighA.nsavaH
shlokas.18:
sthiraM suvipulaM shRRi~NgaM sumahAntaM purAtanam |
architaM mAlyadAmaishcha satataM supratiShThitam
shlokas.19:
vipulairbAhubhirvIrAste.abhihatyAbhyapAtayan |
tataste mAgadhaM dRRiShTvA puraM pravivishustadA
shlokas.20:
etasminneva kAle tu jarAsandhaM samarchayan |
paryagni kurva.nshcha nRRipaM dviradasthaM purohitAH
shlokas.21:
snAtakavratinaste tu bAhushastrA nirAyudhAH |
yuyutsavaH pravivishurjarAsandhena bhArata
shlokas.22:
bhakShyamAlyApaNAnAM cha dadRRishuH shriyamuttamAm |
sphItAM sarvaguNopetAM sarvakAmasamRRiddhinIm
shlokas.23:
tAM tu dRRiShTvA samRRiddhiM te vIthyAM tasyAM narottamAH |
rAjamArgeNa gachChantaH kRRiShNabhImadhana~njayAH
shlokas.24:
balAdgRRihItvA mAlyAni mAlAkArAnmahAbalAH |
virAgavasanAH sarve sragviNo mRRiShTakuNDalAH
shlokas.25:
niveshanamathAjagmurjarAsandhasya dhImataH |
govAsamiva vIkShantaH siMhA haimavatA yathA
shlokas.26:
shailastambhanibhAsteShAM chandanAgurubhUShitAH |
ashobhanta mahArAja bAhavo bAhushAlinAm
shlokas.27:
tAndRRiShTvA dviradaprakhyA~nshAlaskandhAnivodgatAn |
vyUDhoraskAnmAgadhAnAM vismayaH samajAyata
shlokas.28:
te tvatItya janAkIrNAstisraH kakShyA nararShabhAH |
aha~NkAreNa rAjAnamupatasthurmahAbalAH
shlokas.29:
tAnpAdyamadhuparkArhAnmAnArhAnsatkRRitiM gatAn |
pratyutthAya jarAsandha upatasthe yathAvidhi
shlokas.30:
uvAcha chaitAnrAjAsau svAgataM vo.astviti prabhuH |
tasya hyetadvrataM rAjanbabhUva bhuvi vishrutam
shlokas.31:
snAtakAnbrAhmaNAnprAptA~nshrutvA sa samiti~njayaH |
apyardharAtre nRRipatiH pratyudgachChati bhArata
shlokas.32:
tA.nstvapUrveNa veSheNa dRRiShTvA nRRipatisattamaH |
upatasthe jarAsandho vismitashchAbhavattadA
shlokas.33:
te tu dRRiShTvaiva rAjAnaM jarAsandhaM nararShabhAH |
idamUchuramitraghnAH sarve bharatasattama
shlokas.34:
svastyastu kushalaM rAjanniti sarve vyavasthitAH |
taM nRRipaM nRRipashArdUla vipraikShanta parasparam
shlokas.35:
tAnabravIjjarAsandhastadA yAdavapANDavAn |
AsyatAmiti rAjendra brAhmaNachChadmasa.nvRRitAn
shlokas.36:
athopavivishuH sarve trayaste puruSharShabhAH |
sampradIptAstrayo lakShmyA mahAdhvara ivAgnayaH
shlokas.37:
tAnuvAcha jarAsandhaH satyasandho narAdhipaH |
vigarhamANaH kauravya veShagrahaNakAraNAt
shlokas.38:
na snAtakavratA viprA bahirmAlyAnulepanAH |
bhavantIti nRRiloke.asminviditaM mama sarvashaH
shlokas.39:
te yUyaM puShpavantashcha bhujairjyAghAtalakShaNaiH |
bibhrataH kShAtramojashcha brAhmaNyaM pratijAnatha
shlokas.40:
evaM virAgavasanA bahirmAlyAnulepanAH |
satyaM vadata ke yUyaM satyaM rAjasu shobhate
shlokas.41:
