chaityakaM cha gireH shRRi~NgaM bhittvA kimiva sadma naH |
advAreNa praviShTAH stha nirbhayA rAjakilbiShAt
shlokas.42:
karma chaitadvili~Ngasya kiM vAdya prasamIkShitam |
vadadhvaM vAchi vIryaM cha brAhmaNasya visheShataH
shlokas.43:
evaM cha mAmupasthAya kasmAchcha vidhinArhaNAm |
praNItAM no na gRRihNIta kAryaM kiM chAsmadAgame
shlokas.44:
evamuktastataH kRRiShNaH pratyuvAcha mahAmanAH |
snigdhagambhIrayA vAchA vAkyaM vAkyavishAradaH
shlokas.45:
snAtakavratino rAjanbrAhmaNAH kShatriyA vishaH |
visheShaniyamAshchaiShAmavisheShAshcha santyuta
shlokas.46:
visheShavA.nshcha satataM kShatriyaH shriyamarChati |
puShpavatsu dhruvA shrIshcha puShpavantastato vayam
shlokas.47:
kShatriyo bAhuvIryastu na tathA vAkyavIryavAn |
apragalbhaM vachastasya tasmAdbArhadrathe smRRitam
shlokas.48:
svavIryaM kShatriyANAM cha bAhvordhAtA nyaveshayat |
taddidRRikShasi chedrAjandraShTAsyadya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.49:
advAreNa riporgehaM dvAreNa suhRRido gRRiham |
pravishanti sadA santo dvAraM no varjitaM tataH
shlokas.50:
kAryavanto gRRihAnetya shatruto nArhaNAM vayam |
pratigRRihNIma tadviddhi etannaH shAshvataM vratam

shlokas.1:
jarAsandha uvAcha||
na smareyaM kadA vairaM kRRitaM yuShmAbhirityuta |
chintaya.nshcha na pashyAmi bhavatAM prati vaikRRitam
shlokas.2:
vaikRRite chAsati kathaM manyadhvaM mAmanAgasam |
ariM vibrUta tadviprAH satAM samaya eSha hi
shlokas.3:
atha dharmopaghAtAddhi manaH samupatapyate |
yo.anAgasi prasRRijati kShatriyo.api na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
ato.anyathAchara.Nlloke dharmaj~naH sanmahAvrataH |
vRRijinAM gatimApnoti shreyaso.apyupahanti cha
shlokas.5:
trailokye kShatradharmAddhi shreyA.nsaM sAdhuchAriNAm |
anAgasaM prajAnAnAH pramAdAdiva jalpatha
shlokas.6:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
kulakAryaM mahArAja kashchidekaH kulodvahaH |
vahate tanniyogAdvai vayamabhyutthitAstrayaH
shlokas.7:
tvayA chopahRRitA rAjankShatriyA lokavAsinaH |
tadAgaH krUramutpAdya manyase kiM tvanAgasam
shlokas.8:
rAjA rAj~naH kathaM sAdhUnhi.nsyAnnRRipatisattama |
tadrAj~naH saMnigRRihya tvaM rudrAyopajihIrShasi
shlokas.9:
asmA.nstadeno gachCheta tvayA bArhadrathe kRRitam |
vayaM hi shaktA dharmasya rakShaNe dharmachAriNaH
shlokas.10:
manuShyANAM samAlambho na cha dRRiShTaH kadAchana |
sa kathaM mAnuShairdevaM yaShTumichChasi sha~Nkaram
shlokas.11:
savarNo hi savarNAnAM pashusa~nj~nAM kariShyati |
ko.anya evaM yathA hi tvaM jarAsandha vRRithAmatiH
shlokas.12:
te tvAM j~nAtikShayakaraM vayamArtAnusAriNaH |
j~nAtivRRiddhinimittArthaM viniyantumihAgatAH
shlokas.13:
nAsti loke pumAnanyaH kShatriyeShviti chaiva yat |
manyase sa cha te rAjansumahAnbuddhiviplavaH
shlokas.14:
ko hi jAnannabhijanamAtmanaH kShatriyo nRRipa |
nAvishetsvargamatulaM raNAnantaramavyayam
shlokas.15:
svargaM hyeva samAsthAya raNayaj~neShu dIkShitAH |
yajante kShatriyA lokA.nstadviddhi magadhAdhipa
shlokas.16:
svargayonirjayo rAjansvargayonirmahadyashaH |
svargayonistapo yuddhe mArgaH so.avyabhichAravAn
shlokas.17:
eSha hyaindro vaijayanto guNo nityaM samAhitaH |
yenAsurAnparAjitya jagatpAti shatakratuH
shlokas.18:
svargamAsthAya kasya syAdvigrahitvaM yathA tava |
mAgadhairvipulaiH sainyairbAhulyabaladarpitaiH
shlokas.19:
mAvama.nsthAH parAnrAjannAsti vIryaM nare nare |
samaM tejastvayA chaiva kevalaM manujeshvara
shlokas.20:
yAvadeva na sambuddhaM tAvadeva bhavettava |
viShahyametadasmAkamato rAjanbravImi te
shlokas.21:
jahi tvaM sadRRisheShveva mAnaM darpaM cha mAgadha |
mA gamaH sasutAmAtyaH sabalashcha yamakShayam
shlokas.22:
dambhodbhavaH kArtavIrya uttarashcha bRRihadrathaH |
shreyaso hyavamanyeha vineshuH sabalA nRRipAH
shlokas.23:
mumukShamANAstvattashcha na vayaM brAhmaNabruvAH |
shaurirasmi hRRiShIkesho nRRivIrau pANDavAvimau
shlokas.24:
tvAmAhvayAmahe rAjansthiro yudhyasva mAgadha |
mu~ncha vA nRRipatInsarvAnmA gamastvaM yamakShayam
shlokas.25:
jarAsandha uvAcha||
nAjitAnvai narapatInahamAdadmi kA.nshchana |
jitaH kaH paryavasthAtA ko.atra yo na mayA jitaH
shlokas.26:
kShatriyasyaitadevAhurdharmyaM kRRiShNopajIvanam |
vikramya vashamAnIya kAmato yatsamAcharet
shlokas.27:
devatArthamupAkRRitya rAj~naH kRRiShNa kathaM bhayAt |
ahamadya vimu~ncheyaM kShAtraM vratamanusmaran
shlokas.28:
sainyaM sainyena vyUDhena eka ekena vA punaH |
dvAbhyAM tribhirvA yotsye.ahaM yugapatpRRithageva vA
shlokas.29:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA jarAsandhaH sahadevAbhiShechanam |
Aj~nApayattadA rAjA yuyutsurbhImakarmabhiH
shlokas.30:
sa tu senApatI rAjA sasmAra bharatarShabha |
kaushikaM chitrasenaM cha tasminyuddha upasthite
shlokas.31:
yayoste nAmanI loke ha.nseti Dibhaketi cha |
pUrvaM sa~Nkathite pumbhirnRRiloke lokasatkRRite
shlokas.32:
taM tu rAjanvibhuH shaurI rAjAnaM balinAM varam |
smRRitvA puruShashArdUla shArdUlasamavikramam
shlokas.33:
satyasandho jarAsandhaM bhuvi bhImaparAkramam |
bhAgamanyasya nirdiShTaM vadhyaM bhUmibhRRidachyutaH
shlokas.34:
nAtmanAtmavatAM mukhya iyeSha madhusUdanaH |
brahmaNo.a.aj~nAM puraskRRitya hantuM haladharAnujaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastaM nishchitAtmAnaM yuddhAya yadunandanaH |
uvAcha vAgmI rAjAnaM jarAsandhamadhokShajaH
shlokas.2:
trayANAM kena te rAjanyoddhuM vitarate manaH |
asmadanyatameneha sajjIbhavatu ko yudhi
shlokas.3:
evamuktaH sa kRRiShNena yuddhaM vavre mahAdyutiH |
jarAsandhastato rAjanbhImasenena mAgadhaH
shlokas.4:
dhArayannagadAnmukhyAnnirvRRitIrvedanAni cha |
upatasthe jarAsandhaM yuyutsuM vai purohitaH
shlokas.5:
kRRitasvastyayano vidvAnbrAhmaNena yashasvinA |
samanahyajjarAsandhaH kShatradharmamanuvrataH
shlokas.6:
avamuchya kirITaM sa keshAnsamanumRRijya cha |
udatiShThajjarAsandho velAtiga ivArNavaH
shlokas.7:
uvAcha matimAnrAjA bhImaM bhImaparAkramam |
bhIma yotsye tvayA sArdhaM shreyasA nirjitaM varam
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA jarAsandho bhImasenamari.ndamaH |
pratyudyayau mahAtejAH shakraM balirivAsuraH
shlokas.9:
tataH saMmantrya kRRiShNena kRRitasvastyayano balI |
bhImaseno jarAsandhamAsasAda yuyutsayA
shlokas.10:
tatastau narashArdUlau bAhushastrau samIyatuH |
vIrau paramasaMhRRiShTAvanyonyajayakA~NkShiNau
shlokas.11:
tayoratha bhujAghAtAnnigrahapragrahAttathA |
AsItsubhImasaMhrAdo vajraparvatayoriva
shlokas.12:
ubhau paramasaMhRRiShTau balenAtibalAvubhau |
anyonyasyAntaraM prepsU parasparajayaiShiNau
shlokas.13:
tadbhImamutsArya janaM yuddhamAsIdupahvare |
balinoH sa.nyuge rAjanvRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.14:
prakarShaNAkarShaNAbhyAmabhyAkarShavikarShaNaiH |
AkarShetAM tathAnyonyaM jAnubhishchAbhijaghnatuH
shlokas.15:
tataH shabdena mahatA bhartsayantau parasparam |
pAShANasa~NghAtanibhaiH prahArairabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.16:
vyUDhoraskau dIrghabhujau niyuddhakushalAvubhau |
bAhubhiH samasajjetAmAyasaiH parighairiva
shlokas.17:
kArttikasya tu mAsasya pravRRittaM prathame.ahani |
anArataM divArAtramavishrAntamavartata
shlokas.18:
tadvRRittaM tu trayodashyAM samavetaM mahAtmanoH |
chaturdashyAM nishAyAM tu nivRRitto mAgadhaH klamAt
shlokas.19:
taM rAjAnaM tathA klAntaM dRRiShTvA rAja~njanArdanaH |
uvAcha bhImakarmANaM bhImaM sambodhayanniva
shlokas.20:
klAntaH shatrurna kaunteya labhyaH pIDayituM raNe |
pIDyamAno hi kArtsnyena jahyAjjIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.21:
tasmAtte naiva kaunteya pIDanIyo narAdhipaH |
samametena yudhyasva bAhubhyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
evamuktaH sa kRRiShNena pANDavaH paravIrahA |
jarAsandhasya tadrandhraM j~nAtvA chakre matiM vadhe
shlokas.23:
tatastamajitaM jetuM jarAsandhaM vRRikodaraH |
sa.nrabhya balinAM mukhyo jagrAha kurunandanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhImasenastataH kRRiShNamuvAcha yadunandanam |
buddhimAsthAya vipulAM jarAsandhajighA.nsayA
shlokas.2:
nAyaM pApo mayA kRRiShNa yuktaH syAdanurodhitum |
prANena yadushArdUla baddhava~NkShaNavAsasA
shlokas.3:
evamuktastataH kRRiShNaH pratyuvAcha vRRikodaram |
tvarayanpuruShavyAghro jarAsandhavadhepsayA
shlokas.4:
yatte daivaM paraM sattvaM yachcha te mAtarishvanaH |
balaM bhIma jarAsandhe darshayAshu tadadya naH
shlokas.5:
evamuktastadA bhImo jarAsandhamari.ndamaH |
utkShipya bhrAmayadrAjanbalavantaM mahAbalaH
shlokas.6:
bhrAmayitvA shataguNaM bhujAbhyAM bharatarShabha |
babha~nja pRRiShThe sa~NkShipya niShpiShya vinanAda cha
shlokas.7:
tasya niShpiShyamANasya pANDavasya cha garjataH |
abhavattumulo nAdaH sarvaprANibhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.8:
vitresurmAgadhAH sarve strINAM garbhAshcha susruvuH |
bhImasenasya nAdena jarAsandhasya chaiva ha
shlokas.9:
kiM nu sviddhimavAnbhinnaH kiM nu sviddIryate mahI |
iti sma mAgadhA jaj~nurbhImasenasya nisvanAt
shlokas.10:
tato rAjakuladvAri prasuptamiva taM nRRipam |
rAtrau parAsumutsRRijya nishchakramurari.ndamAH
shlokas.11:
jarAsandharathaM kRRiShNo yojayitvA patAkinam |
Aropya bhrAtarau chaiva mokShayAmAsa bAndhavAn
shlokas.12:
te vai ratnabhujaM kRRiShNaM ratnArhaM pRRithivIshvarAH |
rAjAnashchakrurAsAdya mokShitA mahato bhayAt
shlokas.13:
akShataH shastrasampanno jitAriH saha rAjabhiH |
rathamAsthAya taM divyaM nirjagAma girivrajAt
shlokas.14:
yaH sa sodaryavAnnAma dviyodhaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
abhyAsaghAtI sa.ndRRishyo durjayaH sarvarAjabhiH
shlokas.15:
bhImArjunAbhyAM yodhAbhyAmAsthitaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
shushubhe rathavaryo.asau durjayaH sarvadhanvibhiH
shlokas.16:
shakraviShNU hi sa~NgrAme cheratustArakAmaye |
rathena tena taM kRRiShNa upAruhya yayau tadA
shlokas.17:
taptachAmIkarAbheNa ki~NkiNIjAlamAlinA |
meghanirghoShanAdena jaitreNAmitraghAtinA
shlokas.18:
yena shakro dAnavAnAM jaghAna navatIrnava |
taM prApya samahRRiShyanta rathaM te puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.19:
tataH kRRiShNaM mahAbAhuM bhrAtRRibhyAM sahitaM tadA |
rathasthaM mAgadhA dRRiShTvA samapadyanta vismitAH
shlokas.20:
hayairdivyaiH samAyukto ratho vAyusamo jave |
adhiShThitaH sa shushubhe kRRiShNenAtIva bhArata
shlokas.21:
asa~NgI devavihitastasminrathavare dhvajaH |
yojanAddadRRishe shrImAnindrAyudhasamaprabhaH
shlokas.22:
chintayAmAsa kRRiShNo.atha garutmantaM sa chAbhyayAt |
kShaNe tasminsa tenAsIchchaityayUpa ivochChritaH
shlokas.23:
vyAditAsyairmahAnAdaiH saha bhUtairdhvajAlayaiH |
tasthau rathavare tasmingarutmAnpannagAshanaH
shlokas.24:
durnirIkShyo hi bhUtAnAM tejasAbhyadhikaM babhau |
Aditya iva madhyAhne sahasrakiraNAvRRitaH
shlokas.25:
na sa sajjati vRRikSheShu shastraishchApi na riShyate |
divyo dhvajavaro rAjandRRishyate devamAnuShaiH
shlokas.26:
tamAsthAya rathaM divyaM parjanyasamanisvanam |
niryayau puruShavyAghraH pANDavAbhyAM sahAchyutaH
shlokas.27:
yaM lebhe vAsavAdrAjA vasustasmAdbRRihadrathaH |
bRRihadrathAtkrameNaiva prApto bArhadrathaM nRRipam
shlokas.28:
sa niryayau mahAbAhuH puNDarIkekShaNastataH |
girivrajAdbahistasthau same deshe mahAyashAH
shlokas.29:
tatrainaM nAgarAH sarve satkAreNAbhyayustadA |
brAhmaNapramukhA rAjanvidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.30:
bandhanAdvipramuktAshcha rAjAno madhusUdanam |
pUjayAmAsurUchushcha sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.31:
naitachchitraM mahAbAho tvayi devakinandana |
bhImArjunabalopete dharmasya paripAlanam
shlokas.32:
jarAsandhahrade ghore duHkhapa~Nke nimajjatAm |
rAj~nAM samabhyuddharaNaM yadidaM kRRitamadya te
shlokas.33:
viShNo samavasannAnAM giridurge sudAruNe |
diShTyA mokShAdyasho dIptamAptaM te puruShottama
shlokas.34:
kiM kurmaH puruShavyAghra bravIhi puruSharShabha |
kRRitamityeva tajj~neyaM nRRipairyadyapi duShkaram
shlokas.35:
tAnuvAcha hRRiShIkeshaH samAshvAsya mahAmanAH |
yudhiShThiro rAjasUyaM kratumAhartumichChati
shlokas.36:
tasya dharmapravRRittasya pArthivatvaM chikIrShataH |
sarvairbhavadbhiryaj~nArthe sAhAyyaM dIyatAmiti
shlokas.37:
tataH pratItamanasaste nRRipA bharatarShabha |
tathetyevAbruvansarve pratijaj~nushcha tAM giram
shlokas.38:
ratnabhAjaM cha dAshArhaM chakruste pRRithivIshvarAH |
kRRichChrAjjagrAha govindasteShAM tadanukampayA
shlokas.39:
jarAsandhAtmajashchaiva sahadevo mahArathaH |
niryayau sajanAmAtyaH puraskRRitya purohitam
shlokas.40:
sa nIchaiH prashrito bhUtvA bahuratnapurogamaH |
sahadevo nRRiNAM devaM vAsudevamupasthitaH
shlokas.41:
bhayArtAya tatastasmai kRRiShNo dattvAbhayaM tadA |
abhyaShi~nchata tatraiva jarAsandhAtmajaM tadA
shlokas.42:
gatvaikatvaM cha kRRiShNena pArthAbhyAM chaiva satkRRitaH |
vivesha rAjA matimAnpunarbArhadrathaM puram
shlokas.43:
kRRiShNastu saha pArthAbhyAM shriyA paramayA jvalan |
ratnAnyAdAya bhUrINi prayayau puShkarekShaNaH
shlokas.44:
indraprasthamupAgamya pANDavAbhyAM sahAchyutaH |
sametya dharmarAjAnaM prIyamANo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.45:
diShTyA bhImena balavA~njarAsandho nipAtitaH |
rAjAno mokShitAshcheme bandhanAnnRRipasattama
shlokas.46:
diShTyA kushalinau chemau bhImasenadhana~njayau |
punaH svanagaraM prAptAvakShatAviti bhArata
shlokas.47:
tato yudhiShThiraH kRRiShNaM pUjayitvA yathArhataH |
bhImasenArjunau chaiva prahRRiShTaH pariShasvaje
shlokas.48:
tataH kShINe jarAsandhe bhrAtRRibhyAM vihitaM jayam |
ajAtashatrurAsAdya mumude bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.49:
yathAvayaH samAgamya rAjabhistaishcha pANDavaH |
satkRRitya pUjayitvA cha visasarja narAdhipAn
shlokas.50:
yudhiShThirAbhyanuj~nAtAste nRRipA hRRiShTamAnasAH |
jagmuH svadeshA.nstvaritA yAnairuchchAvachaistataH
shlokas.51:
evaM puruShashArdUlo mahAbuddhirjanArdanaH |
pANDavairghAtayAmAsa jarAsandhamariM tadA
shlokas.52:
ghAtayitvA jarAsandhaM buddhipUrvamari.ndamaH |
dharmarAjamanuj~nApya pRRithAM kRRiShNAM cha bhArata
shlokas.53:
subhadrAM bhImasenaM cha phalgunaM yamajau tathA |
dhaumyamAmantrayitvA cha prayayau svAM purIM prati
shlokas.55:
tato yudhiShThiramukhAH pANDavA bharatarShabha |
pradakShiNamakurvanta kRRiShNamakliShTakAriNam
shlokas.56:
tato gate bhagavati kRRiShNe devakinandane |
jayaM labdhvA suvipulaM rAj~nAmabhayadAstadA
shlokas.57:
sa.nvardhitaujaso bhUyaH karmaNA tena bhArata |
draupadyAH pANDavA rAjanparAM prItimavardhayan
shlokas.58:
tasminkAle tu yadyuktaM dharmakAmArthasaMhitam |
tadrAjA dharmatashchakre rAjyapAlanakIrtimAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pArthaH prApya dhanuHshreShThamakShayyau cha maheShudhI |
rathaM dhvajaM sabhAM chaiva yudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.2:
dhanurastraM sharA vIryaM pakSho bhUmiryasho balam |
prAptametanmayA rAjanduShprApaM yadabhIpsitam
shlokas.3:
tatra kRRityamahaM manye koshasyAsya vivardhanam |
karamAhArayiShyAmi rAj~naH sarvAnnRRipottama
shlokas.4:
vijayAya prayAsyAmi dishaM dhanadarakShitAm |
tithAvatha muhUrte cha nakShatre cha tathA shive
shlokas.5:
dhana~njayavachaH shrutvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
snigdhagambhIranAdinyA taM girA pratyabhAShata
shlokas.6:
svasti vAchyArhato viprAnprayAhi bharatarShabha |
durhRRidAmapraharShAya suhRRidAM nandanAya cha
vijayaste dhruvaM pArtha priyaM kAmamavApnuhi
shlokas.7:
ityuktaH prayayau pArthaH sainyena mahatA vRRitaH |
agnidattena divyena rathenAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.8:
tathaiva bhImaseno.api yamau cha puruSharShabhau |
sasainyAH prayayuH sarve dharmarAjAbhipUjitAH
shlokas.9:
dishaM dhanapateriShTAmajayatpAkashAsaniH |
bhImasenastathA prAchIM sahadevastu dakShiNAm
shlokas.10:
pratIchIM nakulo rAjandishaM vyajayadastravit |
khANDavaprasthamadhyAste dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.11:
janamejaya uvAcha||
dishAmabhijayaM brahmanvistareNAnukIrtaya |
na hi tRRipyAmi pUrveShAM shRRiNvAnashcharitaM mahat
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhana~njayasya vakShyAmi vijayaM pUrvameva te |
yaugapadyena pArthairhi vijiteyaM vasundharA
shlokas.13:
pUrvaM kuNindaviShaye vashe chakre mahIpatIn |
dhana~njayo mahAbAhurnAtitIvreNa karmaNA
shlokas.14:
AnartAnkAlakUTA.nshcha kuNindA.nshcha vijitya saH |
sumaNDalaM pApajitaM kRRitavAnanusainikam
shlokas.15:
sa tena sahito rAjansavyasAchI parantapaH |
vijigye sakalaM dvIpaM prativindhyaM cha pArthivam
shlokas.16:
sakaladvIpavAsA.nshcha saptadvIpe cha ye nRRipAH |
arjunasya cha sainyAnAM vigrahastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.17:
sa tAnapi maheShvAso vijitya bharatarShabha |
taireva sahitaH sarvaiH prAgjyotiShamupAdravat
shlokas.18:
tatra rAjA mahAnAsIdbhagadatto vishAM pate |
tenAsItsumahadyuddhaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
sa kirAtaishcha chInaishcha vRRitaH prAgjyotiSho.abhavat |
anyaishcha bahubhiryodhaiH sAgarAnUpavAsibhiH
shlokas.20:
tataH sa divasAnaShTau yodhayitvA dhana~njayam |
prahasannabravIdrAjA sa~NgrAme vigataklamaH
shlokas.21:
upapannaM mahAbAho tvayi pANDavanandana |
pAkashAsanadAyAde vIryamAhavashobhini
shlokas.22:
ahaM sakhA surendrasya shakrAdanavamo raNe |
na cha shaknomi te tAta sthAtuM pramukhato yudhi
shlokas.23:
kimIpsitaM pANDaveya brUhi kiM karavANi te |
yadvakShyasi mahAbAho tatkariShyAmi putraka
shlokas.24:
arjuna uvAcha||
kurUNAmRRiShabho rAjA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
tasya pArthivatAmIpse karastasmai pradIyatAm
shlokas.25:
bhavAnpitRRisakhA chaiva prIyamANo mayApi cha |
tato nAj~nApayAmi tvAM prItipUrvaM pradIyatAm
shlokas.26:
bhagadatta uvAcha||
kuntImAtaryathA me tvaM tathA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
sarvametatkariShyAmi kiM chAnyatkaravANi te

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM vijitya mahAbAhuH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
prayayAvuttarAM tasmAddishaM dhanadapAlitAm
shlokas.2:
antargiriM cha kaunteyastathaiva cha bahirgirim |
tathoparigiriM chaiva vijigye puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.3:
vijitya parvatAnsarvAnye cha tatra narAdhipAH |
tAnvashe sthApayitvA sa ratnAnyAdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
taireva sahitaH sarvairanurajya cha tAnnRRipAn |
kulUtavAsinaM rAjanbRRihantamupajagmivAn
shlokas.5:
mRRida~NgavaranAdena rathanemisvanena cha |
hastinAM cha ninAdena kampayanvasudhAmimAm
shlokas.6:
tato bRRihantastaruNo balena chatura~NgiNA |
niShkramya nagarAttasmAdyodhayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.7:
sumahAnsaMnipAto.abhUddhana~njayabRRihantayoH |
na shashAka bRRihantastu soDhuM pANDavavikramam
shlokas.8:
so.aviShahyatamaM j~nAtvA kaunteyaM parvateshvaraH |
upAvartata durmedhA ratnAnyAdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
sa tadrAjyamavasthApya kulUtasahito yayau |
senAbindumatho rAjanrAjyAdAshu samAkShipat
shlokas.10:
modApuraM vAmadevaM sudAmAnaM susa~Nkulam |
kulUtAnuttarA.nshchaiva tA.nshcha rAj~naH samAnayat
shlokas.11:
tatrasthaH puruShaireva dharmarAjasya shAsanAt |
vyajayaddhana~njayo rAjandeshAnpa~ncha pramANataH
shlokas.12:
sa divaHprasthamAsAdya senAbindoH puraM mahat |
balena chatura~NgeNa niveshamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.13:
sa taiH parivRRitaH sarvairviShvagashvaM narAdhipam |
abhyagachChanmahAtejAH pauravaM puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.14:
vijitya chAhave shUrAnpArvatIyAnmahArathAn |
dhvajinyA vyajayadrAjanpuraM pauravarakShitam
shlokas.15:
pauravaM tu vinirjitya dasyUnparvatavAsinaH |
gaNAnutsavasa~NketAnajayatsapta pANDavaH
shlokas.16:
tataH kAshmIrakAnvIrAnkShatriyAnkShatriyarShabhaH |
vyajayallohitaM chaiva maNDalairdashabhiH saha
shlokas.17:
tatastrigartAnkaunteyo dArvAnkokanadAshcha ye |
kShatriyA bahavo rAjannupAvartanta sarvashaH
shlokas.18:
abhisArIM tato ramyAM vijigye kurunandanaH |
urashAvAsinaM chaiva rochamAnaM raNe.ajayat
shlokas.19:
tataH siMhapuraM ramyaM chitrAyudhasurakShitam |
prAmathadbalamAsthAya pAkashAsanirAhave
shlokas.20:
tataH suhmA.nshcha cholA.nshcha kirITI pANDavarShabhaH |
sahitaH sarvasainyena prAmathatkurunandanaH
shlokas.21:
tataH paramavikrAnto bAhlIkAnkurunandanaH |
mahatA parimardena vashe chakre durAsadAn
shlokas.22:
gRRihItvA tu balaM sAraM phalgu chotsRRijya pANDavaH |
daradAnsaha kAmbojairajayatpAkashAsaniH
shlokas.23:
prAguttarAM dishaM ye cha vasantyAshritya dasyavaH |
nivasanti vane ye cha tAnsarvAnajayatprabhuH
shlokas.24:
lohAnparamakAmbojAnRRiShikAnuttarAnapi |
sahitA.nstAnmahArAja vyajayatpAkashAsaniH
shlokas.25:
RRiShikeShu tu sa~NgrAmo babhUvAtibhaya~NkaraH |
tArakAmayasa~NkAshaH paramarShikapArthayoH
shlokas.26:
sa vijitya tato rAjannRRiShikAnraNamUrdhani |
shukodarasamaprakhyAnhayAnaShTau samAnayat
mayUrasadRRishAnanyAnubhayAneva chAparAn
shlokas.27:
sa vinirjitya sa~NgrAme himavantaM saniShkuTam |
shvetaparvatamAsAdya nyavasatpuruSharShabhaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa shvetaparvataM vIraH samatikramya bhArata |
deshaM kimpuruShAvAsaM drumaputreNa rakShitam
shlokas.2:
mahatA saMnipAtena kShatriyAntakareNa ha |
vyajayatpANDavashreShThaH kare chaiva nyaveshayat
shlokas.3:
taM jitvA hATakaM nAma deshaM guhyakarakShitam |
pAkashAsaniravyagraH sahasainyaH samAsadat
shlokas.4:
tA.nstu sAntvena nirjitya mAnasaM sara uttamam |
RRiShikulyAshcha tAH sarvA dadarsha kurunandanaH
shlokas.5:
saro mAnasamAsAdya hATakAnabhitaH prabhuH |
gandharvarakShitaM deshaM vyajayatpANDavastataH
shlokas.6:
tatra tittirikalmAShAnmaNDUkAkShAnhayottamAn |
lebhe sa karamatyantaM gandharvanagarAttadA
shlokas.7:
uttaraM harivarShaM tu samAsAdya sa pANDavaH |
iyeSha jetuM taM deshaM pAkashAsananandanaH
shlokas.8:
tata enaM mahAkAyA mahAvIryA mahAbalAH |
dvArapAlAH samAsAdya hRRiShTA vachanamabruvan
shlokas.9:
pArtha nedaM tvayA shakyaM puraM jetuM katha~nchana |
upAvartasva kalyANa paryAptamidamachyuta
shlokas.10:
idaM puraM yaH pravisheddhruvaM sa na bhavennaraH |
prIyAmahe tvayA vIra paryApto vijayastava
shlokas.11:
na chApi ki~nchijjetavyamarjunAtra pradRRishyate |
uttarAH kuravo hyete nAtra yuddhaM pravartate
shlokas.12:
praviShTashchApi kaunteya neha drakShyasi ki~nchana |
na hi mAnuShadehena shakyamatrAbhivIkShitum
shlokas.13:
atheha puruShavyAghra ki~nchidanyachchikIrShasi |
tadbravIhi kariShyAmo vachanAttava bhArata
shlokas.14:
tatastAnabravIdrAjannarjunaH pAkashAsaniH |
pArthivatvaM chikIrShAmi dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.15:
na pravekShyAmi vo deshaM bAdhyatvaM yadi mAnuShaiH |
yudhiShThirAya yatki~nchitkaravannaH pradIyatAm
shlokas.16:
tato divyAni vastrANi divyAnyAbharaNAni cha |
mokAjinAni divyAni tasmai te pradaduH karam
shlokas.17:
evaM sa puruShavyAghro vijigye dishamuttarAm |
sa~NgrAmAnsubahUnkRRitvA kShatriyairdasyubhistathA
shlokas.18:
sa vinirjitya rAj~nastAnkare cha viniveshya ha |
dhanAnyAdAya sarvebhyo ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.19:
hayA.nstittirikalmAShA~nshukapatranibhAnapi |
mayUrasadRRishA.nshchAnyAnsarvAnanilaraMhasaH
shlokas.20:
vRRitaH sumahatA rAjanbalena chatura~NgiNA |
AjagAma punarvIraH shakraprasthaM purottamam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu bhImaseno.api vIryavAn |
dharmarAjamanuj~nApya yayau prAchIM dishaM prati
shlokas.2:
mahatA balachakreNa pararAShTrAvamardinA |
vRRito bharatashArdUlo dviShachChokavivardhanaH
shlokas.3:
sa gatvA rAjashArdUlaH pA~nchAlAnAM puraM mahat |
pA~nchAlAnvividhopAyaiH sAntvayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.4:
tataH sa gaNDakIM shUro videhA.nshcha nararShabhaH |
vijityAlpena kAlena dashArNAnagamatprabhuH
shlokas.5:
tatra dAshArNako rAjA sudharmA lomaharShaNam |
kRRitavAnkarma bhImena mahadyuddhaM nirAyudham
shlokas.6:
bhImasenastu taddRRiShTvA tasya karma parantapaH |
adhisenApatiM chakre sudharmANaM mahAbalam
shlokas.7:
tataH prAchIM dishaM bhImo yayau bhImaparAkramaH |
sainyena mahatA rAjankampayanniva medinIm
shlokas.8:
so.ashvamedheshvaraM rAjanrochamAnaM sahAnujam |
jigAya samare vIro balena balinAM varaH
shlokas.9:
sa taM nirjitya kaunteyo nAtitIvreNa karmaNA |
pUrvadeshaM mahAvIryo vijigye kurunandanaH
shlokas.10:
tato dakShiNamAgamya pulindanagaraM mahat |
sukumAraM vashe chakre sumitraM cha narAdhipam
shlokas.11:
tatastu dharmarAjasya shAsanAdbharatarShabhaH |
shishupAlaM mahAvIryamabhyayAjjanamejaya
shlokas.12:
chedirAjo.api tachChrutvA pANDavasya chikIrShitam |
upaniShkramya nagarAtpratyagRRihNAtparantapaH
shlokas.13:
tau sametya mahArAja kuruchedivRRiShau tadA |
ubhayorAtmakulayoH kaushalyaM paryapRRichChatAm
shlokas.14:
tato nivedya tadrAShTraM chedirAjo vishAM pate |
uvAcha bhImaM prahasankimidaM kuruShe.anagha
shlokas.15:
tasya bhImastadAchakhyau dharmarAjachikIrShitam |
sa cha tatpratigRRihyaiva tathA chakre narAdhipaH
shlokas.16:
tato bhImastatra rAjannuShitvA tridashAH kShapAH |
satkRRitaH shishupAlena yayau sabalavAhanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kumAraviShaye shreNimantamathAjayat |
kosalAdhipatiM chaiva bRRihadbalamari.ndamaH
shlokas.2:
ayodhyAyAM tu dharmaj~naM dIrghapraj~naM mahAbalam |
ajayatpANDavashreShTho nAtitIvreNa karmaNA
shlokas.3:
tato gopAlakachChaM cha sottamAnapi chottarAn |
mallAnAmadhipaM chaiva pArthivaM vyajayatprabhuH
shlokas.4:
tato himavataH pArshve samabhyetya jaradgavam |
sarvamalpena kAlena deshaM chakre vashe balI
shlokas.5:
evaM bahuvidhAndeshAnvijitya puruSharShabhaH |
unnATamabhito jigye kukShimantaM cha parvatam
pANDavaH sumahAvIryo balena balinAM varaH
shlokas.6:
sa kAshirAjaM samare subandhumanivartinam |
vashe chakre mahAbAhurbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.7:
tataH supArshvamabhitastathA rAjapatiM kratham |
yudhyamAnaM balAtsa~Nkhye vijigye pANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.8:
tato matsyAnmahAtejA malayA.nshcha mahAbalAn |
anavadyAngayA.nshchaiva pashubhUmiM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
nivRRitya cha mahAbAhurmadarvIkaM mahIdharam |
sopadeshaM vinirjitya prayayAvuttarAmukhaH
vatsabhUmiM cha kaunteyo vijigye balavAnbalAt
shlokas.10:
bhargANAmadhipaM chaiva niShAdAdhipatiM tathA |
vijigye bhUmipAlA.nshcha maNimatpramukhAnbahUn
shlokas.11:
tato dakShiNamallA.nshcha bhogavantaM cha pANDavaH |
tarasaivAjayadbhImo nAtitIvreNa karmaNA
shlokas.12:
sharmakAnvarmakA.nshchaiva sAntvenaivAjayatprabhuH |
vaidehakaM cha rAjAnaM janakaM jagatIpatim
vijigye puruShavyAghro nAtitIvreNa karmaNA
shlokas.13:
vaidehasthastu kaunteya indraparvatamantikAt |
kirAtAnAmadhipatInvyajayatsapta pANDavaH
shlokas.14:
tataH suhmAnprAchyasuhmAnsamakShA.nshchaiva vIryavAn |
vijitya yudhi kaunteyo mAgadhAnupayAdbalI
shlokas.15:
daNDaM cha daNDadhAraM cha vijitya pRRithivIpatIn |
taireva sahitaH sarvairgirivrajamupAdravat
shlokas.16:
jArAsandhiM sAntvayitvA kare cha viniveshya ha |
taireva sahito rAjankarNamabhyadravadbalI
shlokas.17:
sa kampayanniva mahIM balena chatura~NgiNA |
yuyudhe pANDavashreShThaH karNenAmitraghAtinA
shlokas.18:
sa karNaM yudhi nirjitya vashe kRRitvA cha bhArata |
tato vijigye balavAnrAj~naH parvatavAsinaH
shlokas.19:
atha modAgiriM chaiva rAjAnaM balavattaram |
pANDavo bAhuvIryeNa nijaghAna mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.20:
tataH pauNDrAdhipaM vIraM vAsudevaM mahAbalam |
kaushikIkachChanilayaM rAjAnaM cha mahaujasam
shlokas.21:
ubhau balavRRitau vIrAvubhau tIvraparAkramau |
nirjityAjau mahArAja va~NgarAjamupAdravat
shlokas.22:
samudrasenaM nirjitya chandrasenaM cha pArthivam |
tAmraliptaM cha rAjAnaM kAchaM va~NgAdhipaM tathA
shlokas.23:
suhmAnAmadhipaM chaiva ye cha sAgaravAsinaH |
sarvAnmlechChagaNA.nshchaiva vijigye bharatarShabhaH
shlokas.24:
evaM bahuvidhAndeshAnvijitya pavanAtmajaH |
vasu tebhya upAdAya lauhityamagamadbalI
shlokas.25:
sa sarvAnmlechChanRRipatInsAgaradvIpavAsinaH |
karamAhArayAmAsa ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.26:
chandanAguruvastrANi maNimuktamanuttamam |
kA~nchanaM rajataM vajraM vidrumaM cha mahAdhanam
shlokas.27:
sa koTishatasa~Nkhyena dhanena mahatA tadA |
abhyavarShadameyAtmA dhanavarSheNa pANDavam
shlokas.28:
indraprasthamathAgamya bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
nivedayAmAsa tadA dharmarAjAya taddhanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathaiva sahadevo.api dharmarAjena pUjitaH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM prayayau dakShiNAM disham
shlokas.2:
sa shUrasenAnkArtsnyena pUrvamevAjayatprabhuH |
matsyarAjaM cha kauravyo vashe chakre balAdbalI
shlokas.3:
adhirAjAdhipaM chaiva dantavakraM mahAhave |
jigAya karadaM chaiva svarAjye saMnyaveshayat
shlokas.4:
sukumAraM vashe chakre sumitraM cha narAdhipam |
tathaivAparamatsyA.nshcha vyajayatsa paTachcharAn
shlokas.5:
niShAdabhUmiM goshRRi~NgaM parvatapravaraM tathA |
tarasA vyajayaddhImA~nshreNimantaM cha pArthivam
shlokas.6:
navarAShTraM vinirjitya kuntibhojamupAdravat |
prItipUrvaM cha tasyAsau pratijagrAha shAsanam
shlokas.7:
tatashcharmaNvatIkUle jambhakasyAtmajaM nRRipam |
dadarsha vAsudevena sheShitaM pUrvavairiNA
shlokas.8:
chakre tatra sa sa~NgrAmaM saha bhojena bhArata |
sa tamAjau vinirjitya dakShiNAbhimukho yayau
shlokas.9:
karA.nstebhya upAdAya ratnAni vividhAni cha |
tatastaireva sahito narmadAmabhito yayau
shlokas.10:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau sainyena mahatA vRRitau |
jigAya samare vIrAvAshvineyaH pratApavAn
shlokas.11:
tato ratnAnyupAdAya purIM mAhiShmatIM yayau |
tatra nIlena rAj~nA sa chakre yuddhaM nararShabhaH
shlokas.12:
pANDavaH paravIraghnaH sahadevaH pratApavAn |
tato.asya sumahadyuddhamAsIdbhIrubhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.13:
sainyakShayakaraM chaiva prANAnAM sa.nshayAya cha |
chakre tasya hi sAhAyyaM bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH
shlokas.14:
tato hayA rathA nAgAH puruShAH kavachAni cha |
pradIptAni vyadRRishyanta sahadevabale tadA
shlokas.15:
tataH susambhrAntamanA babhUva kurunandanaH |
nottaraM prativaktuM cha shakto.abhUjjanamejaya
shlokas.16:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM bhagavAnagniH pratyamitro.abhavadyudhi |
sahadevasya yaj~nArthaM ghaTamAnasya vai dvija
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatra mAhiShmatIvAsI bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
shrUyate nigRRihIto vai purastAtpAradArikaH
shlokas.18:
nIlasya rAj~naH pUrveShAmupanItashcha so.abhavat |
tadA brAhmaNarUpeNa charamANo yadRRichChayA
shlokas.19:
taM tu rAjA yathAshAstramanvashAddhArmikastadA |
prajajvAla tataH kopAdbhagavAnhavyavAhanaH
shlokas.20:
taM dRRiShTvA vismito rAjA jagAma shirasA kavim |
chakre prasAdaM cha tadA tasya rAj~no vibhAvasuH
shlokas.21:
vareNa ChandayAmAsa taM nRRipaM sviShTakRRittamaH |
abhayaM cha sa jagrAha svasainye vai mahIpatiH
shlokas.22:
tataH prabhRRiti ye kechidaj~nAnAttAM purIM nRRipAH |
jigIShanti balAdrAja.nste dahyantIha vahninA
shlokas.23:
tasyAM puryAM tadA chaiva mAhiShmatyAM kurUdvaha |
babhUvuranabhigrAhyA yoShitashChandataH kila
shlokas.24:
evamagnirvaraM prAdAtstrINAmaprativAraNe |
svairiNyastatra nAryo hi yatheShTaM pracharantyuta
shlokas.25:
varjayanti cha rAjAnastadrAShTraM puruShottama |
bhayAdagnermahArAja tadA prabhRRiti sarvadA
shlokas.26:
sahadevastu dharmAtmA sainyaM dRRiShTvA bhayArditam |
parItamagninA rAjannAkampata yathA giriH
shlokas.27:
upaspRRishya shuchirbhUtvA so.abravItpAvakaM tataH |
tvadartho.ayaM samArambhaH kRRiShNavartmannamo.astu te
shlokas.28:
mukhaM tvamasi devAnAM yaj~nastvamasi pAvaka |
pAvanAtpAvakashchAsi vahanAddhavyavAhanaH
shlokas.29:
vedAstvadarthaM jAtAshcha jAtavedAstato hyasi |
yaj~navighnamimaM kartuM nArhastvaM havyavAhana
shlokas.30:
evamuktvA tu mAdreyaH kushairAstIrya medinIm |
vidhivatpuruShavyAghraH pAvakaM pratyupAvishat
shlokas.31:
pramukhe sarvasainyasya bhItodvignasya bhArata |
na chainamatyagAdvahnirvelAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.32:
tamabhyetya shanairvahniruvAcha kurunandanam |
sahadevaM nRRiNAM devaM sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.33:
uttiShThottiShTha kauravya jij~nAseyaM kRRitA mayA |
vedmi sarvamabhiprAyaM tava dharmasutasya cha
shlokas.34:
mayA tu rakShitavyeyaM purI bharatasattama |
yAvadrAj~no.asya nIlasya kulava.nshadharA iti
IpsitaM tu kariShyAmi manasastava pANDava
shlokas.35:
tata utthAya hRRiShTAtmA prA~njaliH shirasAnataH |
pUjayAmAsa mAdreyaH pAvakaM puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.36:
pAvake vinivRRitte tu nIlo rAjAbhyayAttadA |
satkAreNa naravyAghraM sahadevaM yudhAM patim
shlokas.37:
pratigRRihya cha tAM pUjAM kare cha viniveshya tam |
mAdrIsutastataH prAyAdvijayI dakShiNAM disham
shlokas.38:
traipuraM sa vashe kRRitvA rAjAnamamitaujasam |
nijagrAha mahAbAhustarasA potaneshvaram
shlokas.39:
AhRRitiM kaushikAchAryaM yatnena mahatA tataH |
vashe chakre mahAbAhuH surAShTrAdhipatiM tathA
shlokas.40:
surAShTraviShayasthashcha preShayAmAsa rukmiNe |
rAj~ne bhojakaTasthAya mahAmAtrAya dhImate
shlokas.41:
bhIShmakAya sa dharmAtmA sAkShAdindrasakhAya vai |
sa chAsya sasuto rAjanpratijagrAha shAsanam
shlokas.42:
prItipUrvaM mahAbAhurvAsudevamavekShya cha |
tataH sa ratnAnyAdAya punaH prAyAdyudhAM patiH
shlokas.43:
tataH shUrpArakaM chaiva gaNaM chopakRRitAhvayam |
vashe chakre mahAtejA daNDakA.nshcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.45:
ye cha kAlamukhA nAma narA rAkShasayonayaH |
kRRitsnaM kollagiriM chaiva murachIpattanaM tathA
shlokas.46:
dvIpaM tAmrAhvayaM chaiva parvataM rAmakaM tathA |
timi~NgilaM cha nRRipatiM vashe chakre mahAmatiH
shlokas.47:
ekapAdA.nshcha puruShAnkevalAnvanavAsinaH |
nagarIM sa~njayantIM cha pichChaNDaM karahATakam
dUtaireva vashe chakre karaM chainAnadApayat
shlokas.49:
antAkhIM chaiva romAM cha yavanAnAM puraM tathA |
dUtaireva vashe chakre karaM chainAnadApayat
shlokas.50:
bharukachChaM gato dhImAndUtAnmAdravatIsutaH |
preShayAmAsa rAjendra paulastyAya mahAtmane
vibhIShaNAya dharmAtmA prItipUrvamari.ndamaH
shlokas.51:
sa chAsya pratijagrAha shAsanaM prItipUrvakam |
tachcha kAlakRRitaM dhImAnanvamanyata sa prabhuH
shlokas.52:
tataH sampreShayAmAsa ratnAni vividhAni cha |
chandanAgurumukhyAni divyAnyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.53:
vAsA.nsi cha mahArhANi maNI.nshchaiva mahAdhanAn |
nyavartata tato dhImAnsahadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.54:
evaM nirjitya tarasA sAntvena vijayena cha |
karadAnpArthivAnkRRitvA pratyAgachChadari.ndamaH
shlokas.55:
dharmarAjAya tatsarvaM nivedya bharatarShabha |
kRRitakarmA sukhaM rAjannuvAsa janamejaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nakulasya tu vakShyAmi karmANi vijayaM tathA |
vAsudevajitAmAshAM yathAsau vyajayatprabhuH
shlokas.2:
niryAya khANDavaprasthAtpratIchImabhito disham |
uddishya matimAnprAyAnmahatyA senayA saha
shlokas.3:
siMhanAdena mahatA yodhAnAM garjitena cha |
rathanemininAdaishcha kampayanvasudhAmimAm
shlokas.4:
tato bahudhanaM ramyaM gavAshvadhanadhAnyavat |
kArttikeyasya dayitaM rohItakamupAdravat
shlokas.5:
tatra yuddhaM mahadvRRittaM shUrairmattamayUrakaiH |
marubhUmiM cha kArtsnyena tathaiva bahudhAnyakam
shlokas.6:
shairIShakaM mahechChaM cha vashe chakre mahAdyutiH |
shibI.nstrigartAnambaShThAnmAlavAnpa~nchakarpaTAn
shlokas.7:
tathA madhyamikAyA.nshcha vATadhAnAndvijAnatha |
punashcha parivRRityAtha puShkarAraNyavAsinaH
shlokas.8:
gaNAnutsavasa~NketAnvyajayatpuruSharShabhaH |
sindhukUlAshritA ye cha grAmaNeyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.9:
shUdrAbhIragaNAshchaiva ye chAshritya sarasvatIm |
vartayanti cha ye matsyairye cha parvatavAsinaH
shlokas.10:
kRRitsnaM pa~nchanadaM chaiva tathaivAparaparyaTam |
uttarajyotikaM chaiva tathA vRRindATakaM puram
dvArapAlaM cha tarasA vashe chakre mahAdyutiH
shlokas.11:
ramaThAnhArahUNA.nshcha pratIchyAshchaiva ye nRRipAH |
tAnsarvAnsa vashe chakre shAsanAdeva pANDavaH
shlokas.12:
tatrasthaH preShayAmAsa vAsudevAya chAbhibhuH |
sa chAsya dashabhI rAjyaiH pratijagrAha shAsanam
shlokas.13:
tataH shAkalamabhyetya madrANAM puTabhedanam |
mAtulaM prItipUrveNa shalyaM chakre vashe balI
shlokas.14:
sa tasminsatkRRito rAj~nA satkArArho vishAM pate |
ratnAni bhUrINyAdAya sampratasthe yudhAM patiH
shlokas.15:
tataH sAgarakukShisthAnmlechChAnparamadAruNAn |
pahlavAnbarbarA.nshchaiva tAnsarvAnanayadvasham
shlokas.16:
tato ratnAnyupAdAya vashe kRRitvA cha pArthivAn |
nyavartata narashreShTho nakulashchitramArgavit
shlokas.17:
karabhANAM sahasrANi koshaM tasya mahAtmanaH |
Uhurdasha mahArAja kRRichChrAdiva mahAdhanam
shlokas.18:
indraprasthagataM vIramabhyetya sa yudhiShThiram |
tato mAdrIsutaH shrImAndhanaM tasmai nyavedayat
shlokas.19:
evaM pratIchIM nakulo dishaM varuNapAlitAm |
vijigye vAsudevena nirjitAM bharatarShabhaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rakShaNAddharmarAjasya satyasya paripAlanAt |
shatrUNAM kShapaNAchchaiva svakarmaniratAH prajAH
shlokas.2:
balInAM samyagAdAnAddharmatashchAnushAsanAt |
nikAmavarShI parjanyaH sphIto janapado.abhavat
shlokas.3:
sarvArambhAH supravRRittA gorakShaM karShaNaM vaNik |
visheShAtsarvamevaitatsa~njaj~ne rAjakarmaNaH
shlokas.4:
dasyubhyo va~nchakebhyo vA rAjanprati parasparam |
rAjavallabhatashchaiva nAshrUyanta mRRiShA giraH
shlokas.5:
avarShaM chAtivarShaM cha vyAdhipAvakamUrChanam |
sarvametattadA nAsIddharmanitye yudhiShThire
shlokas.6:
priyaM kartumupasthAtuM balikarma svabhAvajam |
abhihartuM nRRipA jagmurnAnyaiH kAryaiH pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.7:
dharmyairdhanAgamaistasya vavRRidhe nichayo mahAn |
kartuM yasya na shakyeta kShayo varShashatairapi
shlokas.8:
svakoshasya parImANaM koShThasya cha mahIpatiH |
vij~nAya rAjA kaunteyo yaj~nAyaiva mano dadhe
shlokas.9:
suhRRidashchaiva taM sarve pRRithakcha saha chAbruvan |
yaj~nakAlastava vibho kriyatAmatra sAmpratam
shlokas.10:
athaivaM bruvatAmeva teShAmabhyAyayau hariH |
RRiShiH purANo vedAtmA dRRishyashchApi vijAnatAm
shlokas.11:
jagatastasthuShAM shreShThaH prabhavashchApyayashcha ha |
bhUtabhavyabhavannAthaH keshavaH keshisUdanaH
shlokas.12:
prAkAraH sarvavRRiShNInAmApatsvabhayado.arihA |
balAdhikAre nikShipya saMhatyAnakadundubhim
shlokas.13:
uchchAvachamupAdAya dharmarAjAya mAdhavaH |
dhanaughaM puruShavyAghro balena mahatA vRRitaH
shlokas.14:
taM dhanaughamaparyantaM ratnasAgaramakShayam |
nAdayanrathaghoSheNa pravivesha purottamam
shlokas.15:
asUryamiva sUryeNa nivAtamiva vAyunA |
kRRiShNena samupetena jahRRiShe bhArataM puram
shlokas.16:
taM mudAbhisamAgamya satkRRitya cha yathAvidhi |
sampRRiShTvA kushalaM chaiva sukhAsInaM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.17:
dhaumyadvaipAyanamukhairRRitvigbhiH puruSharShabhaH |
bhImArjunayamaishchApi sahitaH kRRiShNamabravIt
shlokas.18:
tvatkRRite pRRithivI sarvA madvashe kRRiShNa vartate |
dhanaM cha bahu vArShNeya tvatprasAdAdupArjitam
shlokas.19:
so.ahamichChAmi tatsarvaM vidhivaddevakIsuta |
upayoktuM dvijAgryeShu havyavAhe cha mAdhava
shlokas.20:
tadahaM yaShTumichChAmi dAshArha sahitastvayA |
anujaishcha mahAbAho tanmAnuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.21:
sa dIkShApaya govinda tvamAtmAnaM mahAbhuja |
tvayIShTavati dAshArha vipApmA bhavitA hyaham
shlokas.22:
mAM vApyabhyanujAnIhi sahaibhiranujairvibho |
anuj~nAtastvayA kRRiShNa prApnuyAM kratumuttamam
shlokas.23:
taM kRRiShNaH pratyuvAchedaM bahUktvA guNavistaram |
tvameva rAjashArdUla samrADarho mahAkratum
samprApnuhi tvayA prApte kRRitakRRityAstato vayam
shlokas.24:
yajasvAbhIpsitaM yaj~naM mayi shreyasyavasthite |
niyu~NkShva chApi mAM kRRitye sarvaM kartAsmi te vachaH
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
saphalaH kRRiShNa sa~NkalpaH siddhishcha niyatA mama |
yasya me tvaM hRRiShIkesha yathepsitamupasthitaH
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anuj~nAtastu kRRiShNena pANDavo bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
IhituM rAjasUyAya sAdhanAnyupachakrame
shlokas.27:
tata Aj~nApayAmAsa pANDavo.arinibarhaNaH |
sahadevaM yudhAM shreShThaM mantriNashchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.28:
asminkratau yathoktAni yaj~nA~NgAni dvijAtibhiH |
tathopakaraNaM sarvaM ma~NgalAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.29:
adhiyaj~nA.nshcha sambhArAndhaumyoktAnkShiprameva hi |
samAnayantu puruShA yathAyogaM yathAkramam
shlokas.30:
indraseno vishokashcha pUrushchArjunasArathiH |
annAdyAharaNe yuktAH santu matpriyakAmyayA
shlokas.31:
sarvakAmAshcha kAryantAM rasagandhasamanvitAH |
manoharAH prItikarA dvijAnAM kurusattama
shlokas.32:
tadvAkyasamakAlaM tu kRRitaM sarvamavedayat |
sahadevo yudhAM shreShTho dharmarAje mahAtmani
shlokas.33:
tato dvaipAyano rAjannRRitvijaH samupAnayat |
vedAniva mahAbhAgAnsAkShAnmUrtimato dvijAn
shlokas.34:
svayaM brahmatvamakarottasya satyavatIsutaH |
dhana~njayAnAmRRiShabhaH susAmA sAmago.abhavat
shlokas.35:
yAj~navalkyo babhUvAtha brahmiShTho.adhvaryusattamaH |
pailo hotA vasoH putro dhaumyena sahito.abhavat
shlokas.36:
eteShAM shiShyavargAshcha putrAshcha bharatarShabha |
babhUvurhotragAH sarve vedavedA~NgapAragAH
shlokas.37:
te vAchayitvA puNyAhamIhayitvA cha taM vidhim |
shAstroktaM yojayAmAsustaddevayajanaM mahat
shlokas.38:
tatra chakruranuj~nAtAH sharaNAnyuta shilpinaH |
ratnavanti vishAlAni veshmAnIva divaukasAm
shlokas.39:
tata Aj~nApayAmAsa sa rAjA rAjasattamaH |
sahadevaM tadA sadyo mantriNaM kurusattamaH
shlokas.40:
AmantraNArthaM dUtA.nstvaM preShayasvAshugAndrutam |
upashrutya vacho rAj~naH sa dUtAnprAhiNottadA
shlokas.41:
AmantrayadhvaM rAShTreShu brAhmaNAnbhUmipAnapi |
vishashcha mAnyA~nshUdrA.nshcha sarvAnAnayateti cha
shlokas.42:
te sarvAnpRRithivIpAlAnpANDaveyasya shAsanAt |
AmantrayAM babhUvushcha preShayAmAsa chAparAn
shlokas.43:
tataste tu yathAkAlaM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
dIkShayAM chakrire viprA rAjasUyAya bhArata
shlokas.44:
dIkShitaH sa tu dharmAtmA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
jagAma yaj~nAyatanaM vRRito vipraiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.45:
bhrAtRRibhirj~nAtibhishchaiva suhRRidbhiH sachivaistathA |
kShatriyaishcha manuShyendra nAnAdeshasamAgataiH
amAtyaishcha nRRipashreShTho dharmo vigrahavAniva
shlokas.47:
teShAmAvasathA.nshchakrurdharmarAjasya shAsanAt |
bahvannA~nshayanairyuktAnsagaNAnAM pRRithakpRRithak
sarvartuguNasampannA~nshilpino.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.48:
teShu te nyavasanrAjanbrAhmaNA bhRRishasatkRRitAH |
kathayantaH kathA bahvIH pashyanto naTanartakAn
shlokas.49:
bhu~njatAM chaiva viprANAM vadatAM cha mahAsvanaH |
anishaM shrUyate smAtra muditAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.50:
dIyatAM dIyatAmeShAM bhujyatAM bhujyatAmiti |
evamprakArAH sa~njalpAH shrUyante smAtra nityashaH
shlokas.51:
gavAM shatasahasrANi shayanAnAM cha bhArata |
rukmasya yoShitAM chaiva dharmarAjaH pRRithagdadau
shlokas.52:
prAvartataivaM yaj~naH sa pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
pRRithivyAmekavIrasya shakrasyeva triviShTape
shlokas.53:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA preShayAmAsa pANDavam |
nakulaM hAstinapuraM bhIShmAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.54:
droNAya dhRRitarAShTrAya vidurAya kRRipAya cha |
bhrAtR^INAM chaiva sarveShAM ye.anuraktA yudhiShThire

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa gatvA hAstinapuraM nakulaH samiti~njayaH |
bhIShmamAmantrayAmAsa dhRRitarAShTraM cha pANDavaH
shlokas.2:
prayayuH prItamanaso yaj~naM brahmapuraHsarAH |
sa.nshrutya dharmarAjasya yaj~naM yaj~navidastadA
shlokas.3:
anye cha shatashastuShTairmanobhirmanujarShabha |
draShTukAmAH sabhAM chaiva dharmarAjaM cha pANDavam
shlokas.4:
digbhyaH sarve samApetuH pArthivAstatra bhArata |
samupAdAya ratnAni vividhAni mahAnti cha
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha bhIShmashcha vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
duryodhanapurogAshcha bhrAtaraH sarva eva te
shlokas.6:
satkRRityAmantritAH sarve AchAryapramukhA nRRipAH |
gAndhArarAjaH subalaH shakunishcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.7:
achalo vRRiShakashchaiva karNashcha rathinAM varaH |
RRitaH shalyo madrarAjo bAhlikashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.8:
somadatto.atha kauravyo bhUrirbhUrishravAH shalaH |
ashvatthAmA kRRipo droNaH saindhavashcha jayadrathaH
shlokas.9:
yaj~nasenaH saputrashcha shAlvashcha vasudhAdhipaH |
prAgjyotiShashcha nRRipatirbhagadatto mahAyashAH
shlokas.10:
saha sarvaistathA mlechChaiH sAgarAnUpavAsibhiH |
pArvatIyAshcha rAjAno rAjA chaiva bRRihadbalaH
shlokas.11:
pauNDrako vAsudevashcha va~NgaH kAli~NgakastathA |
AkarShaH kuntalashchaiva vAnavAsyAndhrakAstathA
shlokas.12:
draviDAH siMhalAshchaiva rAjA kAshmIrakastathA |
kuntibhojo mahAtejAH suhmashcha sumahAbalaH
shlokas.13:
bAhlikAshchApare shUrA rAjAnaH sarva eva te |
virATaH saha putraishcha mAchellashcha mahArathaH
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha nAnAjanapadeshvarAH
shlokas.14:
shishupAlo mahAvIryaH saha putreNa bhArata |
AgachChatpANDaveyasya yaj~naM sa~NgrAmadurmadaH
shlokas.15:
rAmashchaivAniruddhashcha babhrushcha sahasAraNaH |
gadapradyumnasAmbAshcha chArudeShNashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.16:
ulmuko nishaThashchaiva vIraH prAdyumnireva cha |
vRRiShNayo nikhilenAnye samAjagmurmahArathAH
shlokas.17:
ete chAnye cha bahavo rAjAno madhyadeshajAH |
AjagmuH pANDuputrasya rAjasUyaM mahAkratum
shlokas.18:
dadusteShAmAvasathAndharmarAjasya shAsanAt |
bahukakShyAnvitAnrAjandIrghikAvRRikShashobhitAn
shlokas.19:
tathA dharmAtmajasteShAM chakre pUjAmanuttamAm |
satkRRitAshcha yathoddiShTA~njagmurAvasathAnnRRipAH
shlokas.20:
kailAsashikharaprakhyAnmanoj~nAndravyabhUShitAn |
sarvataH sa.nvRRitAnuchchaiH prAkAraiH sukRRitaiH sitaiH
shlokas.21:
suvarNajAlasa.nvItAnmaNikuTTimashobhitAn |
sukhArohaNasopAnAnmahAsanaparichChadAn
shlokas.22:
sragdAmasamavachChannAnuttamAgurugandhinaH |
ha.nsA.nshuvarNasadRRishAnAyojanasudarshanAn
shlokas.23:
asambAdhAnsamadvArAnyutAnuchchAvachairguNaiH |
bahudhAtupinaddhA~NgAnhimavachChikharAniva
shlokas.24:
vishrAntAste tato.apashyanbhUmipA bhUridakShiNam |
vRRitaM sadasyairbahubhirdharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.25:
tatsadaH pArthivaiH kIrNaM brAhmaNaishcha mahAtmabhiH |
bhrAjate sma tadA rAjannAkapRRiShThamivAmaraiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pitAmahaM guruM chaiva pratyudgamya yudhiShThiraH |
abhivAdya tato rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
bhIShmaM droNaM kRRipaM drauNiM duryodhanavivi.nshatI
shlokas.2:
asminyaj~ne bhavanto mAmanugRRihNantu sarvashaH |
idaM vaH svamahaM chaiva yadihAsti dhanaM mama
prINayantu bhavanto mAM yatheShTamaniyantritAH
shlokas.3:
evamuktvA sa tAnsarvAndIkShitaH pANDavAgrajaH |
yuyoja ha yathAyogamadhikAreShvanantaram
shlokas.4:
bhakShyabhojyAdhikAreShu duHshAsanamayojayat |
parigrahe brAhmaNAnAmashvatthAmAnamuktavAn
shlokas.5:
rAj~nAM tu pratipUjArthaM sa~njayaM saMnyayojayat |
kRRitAkRRitaparij~nAne bhIShmadroNau mahAmatI
shlokas.6:
hiraNyasya suvarNasya ratnAnAM chAnvavekShaNe |
dakShiNAnAM cha vai dAne kRRipaM rAjA nyayojayat
tathAnyAnpuruShavyAghrA.nstasmi.nstasminnyayojayat
shlokas.7:
bAhliko dhRRitarAShTrashcha somadatto jayadrathaH |
nakulena samAnItAH svAmivattatra remire
shlokas.8:
kShattA vyayakarastvAsIdviduraH sarvadharmavit |
duryodhanastvarhaNAni pratijagrAha sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
sarvalokaH samAvRRittaH piprIShuH phalamuttamam |
draShTukAmaH sabhAM chaiva dharmarAjaM cha pANDavam
shlokas.10:
na kashchidAharattatra sahasrAvaramarhaNam |
ratnaishcha bahubhistatra dharmarAjamavardhayan
shlokas.11:
kathaM nu mama kauravyo ratnadAnaiH samApnuyAt |
yaj~namityeva rAjAnaH spardhamAnA dadurdhanam
shlokas.12:
bhavanaiH savimAnAgraiH sodarkairbalasa.nvRRitaiH |
lokarAjavimAnaishcha brAhmaNAvasathaiH saha
shlokas.13:
kRRitairAvasathairdivyairvimAnapratimaistathA |
vichitrai ratnavadbhishcha RRiddhyA paramayA yutaiH
shlokas.14:
rAjabhishcha samAvRRittairatIvashrIsamRRiddhibhiH |
ashobhata sado rAjankaunteyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
RRiddhyA cha varuNaM devaM spardhamAno yudhiShThiraH |
ShaDagninAtha yaj~nena so.ayajaddakShiNAvatA
sarvA~njanAnsarvakAmaiH samRRiddhaiH samatarpayat
shlokas.16:
annavAnbahubhakShyashcha bhuktavajjanasa.nvRRitaH |
ratnopahArakarmaNyo babhUva sa samAgamaH
shlokas.17:
iDAjyahomAhutibhirmantrashikShAsamanvitaiH |
tasminhi tatRRipurdevAstate yaj~ne maharShibhiH
shlokas.18:
yathA devAstathA viprA dakShiNAnnamahAdhanaiH |
tatRRipuH sarvavarNAshcha tasminyaj~ne mudAnvitAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abhiShechanIye.ahni brAhmaNA rAjabhiH saha |
antarvedIM pravivishuH satkArArthaM maharShayaH
shlokas.2:
nAradapramukhAstasyAmantarvedyAM mahAtmanaH |
samAsInAH shushubhire saha rAjarShibhistadA
shlokas.3:
sametA brahmabhavane devA devarShayo yathA |
karmAntaramupAsanto jajalpuramitaujasaH
shlokas.4:
idamevaM na chApyevamevametanna chAnyathA |
ityUchurbahavastatra vitaNDAnAH parasparam
shlokas.5:
kRRishAnarthA.nstathA kechidakRRishA.nstatra kurvate |
akRRishA.nshcha kRRishA.nshchakrurhetubhiH shAstranishchitaiH
shlokas.6:
tatra medhAvinaH kechidarthamanyaiH prapUritam |
vichikShipuryathA shyenA nabhogatamivAmiSham
shlokas.7:
kechiddharmArthasa.nyuktAH kathAstatra mahAvratAH |
remire kathayantashcha sarvavedavidAM varAH
shlokas.8:
sA vedirvedasampannairdevadvijamaharShibhiH |
AbabhAse samAkIrNA nakShatrairdyaurivAmalA
shlokas.9:
na tasyAM saMnidhau shUdraH kashchidAsInna chAvrataH |
antarvedyAM tadA rAjanyudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.10:
tAM tu lakShmIvato lakShmIM tadA yaj~navidhAnajAm |
tutoSha nAradaH pashyandharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.11:
atha chintAM samApede sa munirmanujAdhipa |
nAradastaM tadA pashyansarvakShatrasamAgamam
shlokas.12:
sasmAra cha purAvRRittAM kathAM tAM bharatarShabha |
a.nshAvataraNe yAsau brahmaNo bhavane.abhavat
shlokas.13:
devAnAM sa~NgamaM taM tu vij~nAya kurunandana |
nAradaH puNDarIkAkShaM sasmAra manasA harim
shlokas.14:
sAkShAtsa vibudhArighnaH kShatre nArAyaNo vibhuH |
pratij~nAM pAlayandhImA~njAtaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.15:
sa.ndidesha purA yo.asau vibudhAnbhUtakRRitsvayam |
anyonyamabhinighnantaH punarlokAnavApsyatha
shlokas.16:
iti nArAyaNaH shambhurbhagavA~njagataH prabhuH |
Adishya vibudhAnsarvAnajAyata yadukShaye
shlokas.17:
kShitAvandhakavRRiShNInAM va.nshe va.nshabhRRitAM varaH |
parayA shushubhe lakShmyA nakShatrANAmivoDurAT
shlokas.18:
yasya bAhubalaM sendrAH surAH sarva upAsate |
so.ayaM mAnuShavannAma harirAste.arimardanaH
shlokas.19:
aho bata mahadbhUtaM svayambhUryadidaM svayam |
AdAsyati punaH kShatramevaM balasamanvitam
shlokas.20:
ityetAM nAradashchintAM chintayAmAsa dharmavit |
hariM nArAyaNaM j~nAtvA yaj~nairIDyaM tamIshvaram
shlokas.21:
tasmindharmavidAM shreShTho dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
mahAdhvare mahAbuddhistasthau sa bahumAnataH
shlokas.22:
tato bhIShmo.abravIdrAjandharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
kriyatAmarhaNaM rAj~nAM yathArhamiti bhArata
shlokas.23:
AchAryamRRitvijaM chaiva sa.nyuktaM cha yudhiShThira |
snAtakaM cha priyaM chAhuH ShaDarghyArhAnnRRipaM tathA
shlokas.24:
etAnarhAnabhigatAnAhuH sa.nvatsaroShitAn |
ta ime kAlapUgasya mahato.asmAnupAgatAH
shlokas.25:
eShAmekaikasho rAjannarghyamAnIyatAmiti |
atha chaiShAM variShThAya samarthAyopanIyatAm
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kasmai bhavAnmanyate.arghamekasmai kurunandana |
upanIyamAnaM yuktaM cha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato bhIShmaH shAntanavo buddhyA nishchitya bhArata |
vArShNeyaM manyate kRRiShNamarhaNIyatamaM bhuvi
shlokas.28:
eSha hyeShAM sametAnAM tejobalaparAkramaiH |
madhye tapannivAbhAti jyotiShAmiva bhAskaraH
shlokas.29:
asUryamiva sUryeNa nivAtamiva vAyunA |
bhAsitaM hlAditaM chaiva kRRiShNenedaM sado hi naH
shlokas.30:
tasmai bhIShmAbhyanuj~nAtaH sahadevaH pratApavAn |
upajahre.atha vidhivadvArShNeyAyArghyamuttamam
shlokas.31:
pratijagrAha tatkRRiShNaH shAstradRRiShTena karmaNA |
shishupAlastu tAM pUjAM vAsudeve na chakShame
shlokas.32:
sa upAlabhya bhIShmaM cha dharmarAjaM cha sa.nsadi |
apAkShipadvAsudevaM chedirAjo mahAbalaH

shlokas.1:
shishupAla uvAcha||
nAyamarhati vArShNeyastiShThatsviha mahAtmasu |
mahIpatiShu kauravya rAjavatpArthivArhaNam
shlokas.2:
nAyaM yuktaH samAchAraH pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
yatkAmAtpuNDarIkAkShaM pANDavArchitavAnasi
shlokas.3:
bAlA yUyaM na jAnIdhvaM dharmaH sUkShmo hi pANDavAH |
ayaM tatrAbhyatikrAnta Apageyo.alpadarshanaH
shlokas.4:
tvAdRRisho dharmayukto hi kurvANaH priyakAmyayA |
bhavatyabhyadhikaM bhIShmo lokeShvavamataH satAm
shlokas.5:
kathaM hyarAjA dAshArho madhye sarvamahIkShitAm |
arhaNAmarhati tathA yathA yuShmAbhirarchitaH
shlokas.6:
atha vA manyase kRRiShNaM sthaviraM bharatarShabha |
vasudeve sthite vRRiddhe kathamarhati tatsutaH
shlokas.7:
atha vA vAsudevo.api priyakAmo.anuvRRittavAn |
drupade tiShThati kathaM mAdhavo.arhati pUjanam
shlokas.8:
AchAryaM manyase kRRiShNamatha vA kurupu~Ngava |
droNe tiShThati vArShNeyaM kasmAdarchitavAnasi
shlokas.9:
RRitvijaM manyase kRRiShNamatha vA kurunandana |
dvaipAyane sthite vipre kathaM kRRiShNo.architastvayA
shlokas.10:
naiva RRitvi~Nna chAchAryo na rAjA madhusUdanaH |
architashcha kurushreShTha kimanyatpriyakAmyayA
shlokas.11:
atha vApyarchanIyo.ayaM yuShmAkaM madhusUdanaH |
kiM rAjabhirihAnItairavamAnAya bhArata
shlokas.12:
vayaM tu na bhayAdasya kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH |
prayachChAmaH karAnsarve na lobhAnna cha sAntvanAt
shlokas.13:
asya dharmapravRRittasya pArthivatvaM chikIrShataH |
karAnasmai prayachChAmaH so.ayamasmAnna manyate
shlokas.14:
kimanyadavamAnAddhi yadimaM rAjasa.nsadi |
aprAptalakShaNaM kRRiShNamarghyeNArchitavAnasi
shlokas.15:
akasmAddharmaputrasya dharmAtmeti yasho gatam |
ko hi dharmachyute pUjAmevaM yuktAM prayojayet
yo.ayaM vRRiShNikule jAto rAjAnaM hatavAnpurA
shlokas.16:
adya dharmAtmatA chaiva vyapakRRiShTA yudhiShThirAt |
kRRipaNatvaM niviShTaM cha kRRiShNe.arghyasya nivedanAt
shlokas.17:
yadi bhItAshcha kaunteyAH kRRipaNAshcha tapasvinaH |
nanu tvayApi boddhavyaM yAM pUjAM mAdhavo.arhati
shlokas.18:
atha vA kRRipaNairetAmupanItAM janArdana |
pUjAmanarhaH kasmAttvamabhyanuj~nAtavAnasi
shlokas.19:
ayuktAmAtmanaH pUjAM tvaM punarbahu manyase |
haviShaH prApya niShyandaM prAshituM shveva nirjane
shlokas.20:
na tvayaM pArthivendrANAmavamAnaH prayujyate |
tvAmeva kuravo vyaktaM pralambhante janArdana
shlokas.21:
klIbe dArakriyA yAdRRigandhe vA rUpadarshanam |
arAj~no rAjavatpUjA tathA te madhusUdana
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTo yudhiShThiro rAjA dRRiShTo bhIShmashcha yAdRRishaH |
vAsudevo.apyayaM dRRiShTaH sarvametadyathAtatham
shlokas.23:
ityuktvA shishupAlastAnutthAya paramAsanAt |
niryayau sadasastasmAtsahito rAjabhistadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA shishupAlamupAdravat |
uvAcha chainaM madhuraM sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.2:
nedaM yuktaM mahIpAla yAdRRishaM vai tvamuktavAn |
adharmashcha paro rAjanpAruShyaM cha nirarthakam
shlokas.3:
na hi dharmaM paraM jAtu nAvabudhyeta pArthiva |
bhIShmaH shAntanavastvenaM mAvama.nsthA ato.anyathA
shlokas.4:
pashya chemAnmahIpAlA.nstvatto vRRiddhatamAnbahUn |
mRRiShyante chArhaNAM kRRiShNe tadvattvaM kShantumarhasi
shlokas.5:
veda tattvena kRRiShNaM hi bhIShmashchedipate bhRRisham |
na hyenaM tvaM tathA vettha yathainaM veda kauravaH
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAsmA anunayo deyo nAyamarhati sAntvanam |
lokavRRiddhatame kRRiShNe yo.arhaNAM nAnumanyate
shlokas.7:
kShatriyaH kShatriyaM jitvA raNe raNakRRitAM varaH |
yo mu~nchati vashe kRRitvA gururbhavati tasya saH
shlokas.8:
asyAM cha samitau rAj~nAmekamapyajitaM yudhi |
na pashyAmi mahIpAlaM sAtvatIputratejasA
shlokas.9:
na hi kevalamasmAkamayamarchyatamo.achyutaH |
trayANAmapi lokAnAmarchanIyo janArdanaH
shlokas.10:
kRRiShNena hi jitA yuddhe bahavaH kShatriyarShabhAH |
jagatsarvaM cha vArShNeye nikhilena pratiShThitam
shlokas.11:
tasmAtsatsvapi vRRiddheShu kRRiShNamarchAma netarAn |
evaM vaktuM na chArhastvaM mA bhUtte buddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.12:
j~nAnavRRiddhA mayA rAjanbahavaH paryupAsitAH |
teShAM kathayatAM shaurerahaM guNavato guNAn
samAgatAnAmashrauShaM bahUnbahumatAnsatAm
shlokas.13:
karmANyapi cha yAnyasya janmaprabhRRiti dhImataH |
bahushaH kathyamAnAni narairbhUyaH shrutAni me
shlokas.14:
na kevalaM vayaM kAmAchchedirAja janArdanam |
na sambandhaM puraskRRitya kRRitArthaM vA katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
archAmahe.architaM sadbhirbhuvi bhaumasukhAvaham |
yashaH shauryaM jayaM chAsya vij~nAyArchAM prayujmahe
shlokas.16:
na hi kashchidihAsmAbhiH subAlo.apyaparIkShitaH |
guNairvRRiddhAnatikramya harirarchyatamo mataH
shlokas.17:
j~nAnavRRiddho dvijAtInAM kShatriyANAM balAdhikaH |
pUjye tAviha govinde hetU dvAvapi sa.nsthitau
shlokas.18:
vedavedA~Ngavij~nAnaM balaM chApyamitaM tathA |
nRRiNAM hi loke kasyAsti vishiShTaM keshavAdRRite
shlokas.19:
dAnaM dAkShyaM shrutaM shauryaM hrIH kIrtirbuddhiruttamA |
saMnatiH shrIrdhRRitistuShTiH puShTishcha niyatAchyute
shlokas.20:
tamimaM sarvasampannamAchAryaM pitaraM gurum |
archyamarchitamarchArhaM sarve saMmantumarhatha
shlokas.21:
RRitviggururvivAhyashcha snAtako nRRipatiH priyaH |
sarvametaddhRRiShIkeshe tasmAdabhyarchito.achyutaH
shlokas.22:
kRRiShNa eva hi lokAnAmutpattirapi chApyayaH |
kRRiShNasya hi kRRite bhUtamidaM vishvaM samarpitam
shlokas.23:
eSha prakRRitiravyaktA kartA chaiva sanAtanaH |
parashcha sarvabhUtebhyastasmAdvRRiddhatamo.achyutaH
shlokas.24:
buddhirmano mahAnvAyustejo.ambhaH khaM mahI cha yA |
chaturvidhaM cha yadbhUtaM sarvaM kRRiShNe pratiShThitam
shlokas.25:
AdityashchandramAshchaiva nakShatrANi grahAshcha ye |
dishashchopadishashchaiva sarvaM kRRiShNe pratiShThitam
shlokas.26:
ayaM tu puruSho bAlaH shishupAlo na budhyate |
sarvatra sarvadA kRRiShNaM tasmAdevaM prabhAShate
shlokas.27:
yo hi dharmaM vichinuyAdutkRRiShTaM matimAnnaraH |
sa vai pashyedyathAdharmaM na tathA chedirADayam
shlokas.28:
savRRiddhabAleShvatha vA pArthiveShu mahAtmasu |
ko nArhaM manyate kRRiShNaM ko vApyenaM na pUjayet
shlokas.29:
athemAM duShkRRitAM pUjAM shishupAlo vyavasyati |
duShkRRitAyAM yathAnyAyaM tathAyaM kartumarhati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato bhIShmo virarAma mahAyashAH |
vyAjahArottaraM tatra sahadevo.arthavadvachaH
shlokas.2:
keshavaM keshihantAramaprameyaparAkramam |
pUjyamAnaM mayA yo vaH kRRiShNaM na sahate nRRipAH
shlokas.3:
sarveShAM balinAM mUrdhni mayedaM nihitaM padam |
evamukte mayA samyaguttaraM prabravItu saH
shlokas.4:
matimantastu ye kechidAchAryaM pitaraM gurum |
archyamarchitamarchArhamanujAnantu te nRRipAH
shlokas.5:
tato na vyAjahAraiShAM kashchidbuddhimatAM satAm |
mAninAM balinAM rAj~nAM madhye sa.ndarshite pade
shlokas.6:
tato.apatatpuShpavRRiShTiH sahadevasya mUrdhani |
adRRishyarUpA vAchashchApyabruvansAdhu sAdhviti
shlokas.7:
AvidhyadajinaM kRRiShNaM bhaviShyadbhUtajalpakaH |
sarvasa.nshayanirmoktA nAradaH sarvalokavit
shlokas.8:
tatrAhUtAgatAH sarve sunIthapramukhA gaNAH |
samprAdRRishyanta sa~NkruddhA vivarNavadanAstathA
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThirAbhiShekaM cha vAsudevasya chArhaNam |
abruva.nstatra rAjAno nirvedAdAtmanishchayAt
shlokas.10:
suhRRidbhirvAryamANAnAM teShAM hi vapurAbabhau |
AmiShAdapakRRiShTAnAM siMhAnAmiva garjatAm
shlokas.11:
taM balaughamaparyantaM rAjasAgaramakShayam |
kurvANaM samayaM kRRiShNo yuddhAya bubudhe tadA
shlokas.12:
pUjayitvA tu pUjArhaM brahmakShatraM visheShataH |
sahadevo nRRiNAM devaH samApayata karma tat
shlokas.13:
tasminnabhyarchite kRRiShNe sunIthaH shatrukarShaNaH |
atitAmrekShaNaH kopAduvAcha manujAdhipAn
shlokas.14:
sthitaH senApatirvo.ahaM manyadhvaM kiM nu sAmpratam |
yudhi tiShThAma saMnahya sametAnvRRiShNipANDavAn
shlokas.15:
iti sarvAnsamutsAhya rAj~nastA.nshchedipu~NgavaH |
yaj~nopaghAtAya tataH so.amantrayata rAjabhiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sAgarasa~NkAshaM dRRiShTvA nRRipatisAgaram |
roShAtprachalitaM sarvamidamAha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
bhIShmaM matimatAM shreShThaM vRRiddhaM kurupitAmaham |
bRRihaspatiM bRRihattejAH puruhUta ivArihA
shlokas.3:
asau roShAtprachalito mahAnnRRipatisAgaraH |
atra yatpratipattavyaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
yaj~nasya cha na vighnaH syAtprajAnAM cha shivaM bhavet |
yathA sarvatra tatsarvaM brUhi me.adya pitAmaha
shlokas.5:
ityuktavati dharmaj~ne dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
uvAchedaM vacho bhIShmastataH kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.6:
mA bhaistvaM kurushArdUla shvA siMhaM hantumarhati |
shivaH panthAH sunIto.atra mayA pUrvataraM vRRitaH
shlokas.7:
prasupte hi yathA siMhe shvAnastatra samAgatAH |
bhaSheyuH sahitAH sarve tatheme vasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.8:
vRRiShNisiMhasya suptasya tatheme pramukhe sthitAH |
bhaShante tAta sa~NkruddhAH shvAnaH siMhasya saMnidhau
shlokas.9:
na hi sambudhyate tAvatsuptaH siMha ivAchyutaH |
tena siMhIkarotyetAnnRRisiMhashchedipu~NgavaH
shlokas.10:
pArthivAnpArthivashreShTha shishupAlo.alpachetanaH |
sarvAnsarvAtmanA tAta netukAmo yamakShayam
shlokas.11:
nUnametatsamAdAtuM punarichChatyadhokShajaH |
yadasya shishupAlasthaM tejastiShThati bhArata
shlokas.12:
viplutA chAsya bhadraM te buddhirbuddhimatAM vara |
chedirAjasya kaunteya sarveShAM cha mahIkShitAm
shlokas.13:
AdAtuM hi naravyAghro yaM yamichChatyayaM yadA |
tasya viplavate buddhirevaM chedipateryathA
shlokas.14:
chaturvidhAnAM bhUtAnAM triShu lokeShu mAdhavaH |
prabhavashchaiva sarveShAM nidhanaM cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
iti tasya vachaH shrutvA tatashchedipatirnRRipaH |
bhIShmaM rUkShAkSharA vAchaH shrAvayAmAsa bhArata

shlokas.1:
shishupAla uvAcha||
vibhIShikAbhirbahvIbhirbhIShayansarvapArthivAn |
na vyapatrapase kasmAdvRRiddhaH sankulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.2:
yuktametattRRitIyAyAM prakRRitau vartatA tvayA |
vaktuM dharmAdapetArthaM tvaM hi sarvakurUttamaH
shlokas.3:
nAvi nauriva sambaddhA yathAndho vAndhamanviyAt |
tathAbhUtA hi kauravyA bhIShma yeShAM tvamagraNIH
shlokas.4:
pUtanAghAtapUrvANi karmANyasya visheShataH |
tvayA kIrtayatAsmAkaM bhUyaH prachyAvitaM manaH
shlokas.5:
avaliptasya mUrkhasya keshavaM stotumichChataH |
kathaM bhIShma na te jihvA shatadheyaM vidIryate
shlokas.6:
yatra kutsA prayoktavyA bhIShma bAlatarairnaraiH |
tamimaM j~nAnavRRiddhaH sangopaM sa.nstotumichChasi
shlokas.7:
yadyanena hatA bAlye shakunishchitramatra kim |
tau vAshvavRRiShabhau bhIShma yau na yuddhavishAradau
shlokas.8:
chetanArahitaM kAShThaM yadyanena nipAtitam |
pAdena shakaTaM bhIShma tatra kiM kRRitamadbhutam
shlokas.9:
valmIkamAtraH saptAhaM yadyanena dhRRito.achalaH |
tadA govardhano bhIShma na tachchitraM mataM mama
shlokas.10:
bhuktametena bahvannaM krIDatA nagamUrdhani |
iti te bhIShma shRRiNvAnAH paraM vismayamAgatAH
shlokas.11:
yasya chAnena dharmaj~na bhuktamannaM balIyasaH |
sa chAnena hataH ka.nsa ityetanna mahAdbhutam
shlokas.12:
na te shrutamidaM bhIShma nUnaM kathayatAM satAm |
yadvakShye tvAmadharmaj~na vAkyaM kurukulAdhama
shlokas.13:
strIShu goShu na shastrANi pAtayedbrAhmaNeShu cha |
yasya chAnnAni bhu~njIta yashcha syAchCharaNAgataH
shlokas.14:
iti santo.anushAsanti sajjanA dharmiNaH sadA |
bhIShma loke hi tatsarvaM vitathaM tvayi dRRishyate
shlokas.15:
j~nAnavRRiddhaM cha vRRiddhaM cha bhUyA.nsaM keshavaM mama |
ajAnata ivAkhyAsi sa.nstuvankurusattama
goghnaH strIghnashcha sanbhIShma kathaM sa.nstavamarhati
shlokas.16:
asau matimatAM shreShTho ya eSha jagataH prabhuH |
sambhAvayati yadyevaM tvadvAkyAchcha janArdanaH
evametatsarvamiti sarvaM tadvitathaM dhruvam
shlokas.17:
na gAthA gAthinaM shAsti bahu chedapi gAyati |
prakRRitiM yAnti bhUtAni bhUli~NgashakuniryathA
shlokas.18:
nUnaM prakRRitireShA te jaghanyA nAtra sa.nshayaH |
ataH pApIyasI chaiShAM pANDavAnAmapIShyate
shlokas.19:
yeShAmarchyatamaH kRRiShNastvaM cha yeShAM pradarshakaH |
dharmavAktvamadharmaj~naH satAM mArgAdavaplutaH
shlokas.20:
ko hi dharmiNamAtmAnaM jAna~nj~nAnavatAM varaH |
kuryAdyathA tvayA bhIShma kRRitaM dharmamavekShatA
shlokas.21:
anyakAmA hi dharmaj~na kanyakA prAj~namAninA |
ambA nAmeti bhadraM te kathaM sApahRRitA tvayA
shlokas.22:
yAM tvayApahRRitAM bhIShma kanyAM naiShitavAnnRRipaH |
bhrAtA vichitravIryaste satAM vRRittamanuShThitaH
shlokas.23:
dArayoryasya chAnyena miShataH prAj~namAninaH |
tava jAtAnyapatyAni sajjanAcharite pathi
shlokas.24:
na hi dharmo.asti te bhIShma brahmacharyamidaM vRRithA |
yaddhArayasi mohAdvA klIbatvAdvA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.25:
na tvahaM tava dharmaj~na pashyAmyupachayaM kvachit |
na hi te sevitA vRRiddhA ya evaM dharmamabruvan
shlokas.26:
iShTaM dattamadhItaM cha yaj~nAshcha bahudakShiNAH |
sarvametadapatyasya kalAM nArhati ShoDashIm
shlokas.27:
vratopavAsairbahubhiH kRRitaM bhavati bhIShma yat |
sarvaM tadanapatyasya moghaM bhavati nishchayAt
shlokas.28:
so.anapatyashcha vRRiddhashcha mithyAdharmAnushAsanAt |
ha.nsavattvamapIdAnIM j~nAtibhyaH prApnuyA vadham
shlokas.29:
evaM hi kathayantyanye narA j~nAnavidaH purA |
bhIShma yattadahaM samyagvakShyAmi tava shRRiNvataH
shlokas.30:
vRRiddhaH kila samudrAnte kashchiddha.nso.abhavatpurA |
dharmavAganyathAvRRittaH pakShiNaH so.anushAsti ha
shlokas.31:
dharmaM charata mAdharmamiti tasya vachaH kila |
pakShiNaH shushruvurbhIShma satataM dharmavAdinaH
shlokas.32:
athAsya bhakShyamAjahruH samudrajalachAriNaH |
aNDajA bhIShma tasyAnye dharmArthamiti shushruma
shlokas.33:
tasya chaiva samabhyAshe nikShipyANDAni sarvashaH |
samudrAmbhasyamodanta charanto bhIShma pakShiNaH
shlokas.34:
teShAmaNDAni sarveShAM bhakShayAmAsa pApakRRit |
sa ha.nsaH sampramattAnAmapramattaH svakarmaNi
shlokas.35:
tataH prakShIyamANeShu teShvaNDeShvaNDajo.aparaH |
asha~Nkata mahAprAj~nastaM kadAchiddadarsha ha
shlokas.36:
tataH sa kathayAmAsa dRRiShTvA ha.nsasya kilbiSham |
teShAM paramaduHkhArtaH sa pakShI sarvapakShiNAm
shlokas.37:
tataH pratyakShato dRRiShTvA pakShiNaste samAgatAH |
nijaghnustaM tadA ha.nsaM mithyAvRRittaM kurUdvaha
shlokas.38:
te tvAM ha.nsasadharmANamapIme vasudhAdhipAH |
nihanyurbhIShma sa~NkruddhAH pakShiNastamivANDajam
shlokas.39:
gAthAmapyatra gAyanti ye purANavido janAH |
bhIShma yAM tAM cha te samyakkathayiShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.40:
antarAtmani vinihite; rauShi patraratha vitatham |
aNDabhakShaNamashuchi te; karma vAchamatishayate

shlokas.1:
shishupAla uvAcha||
sa me bahumato rAjA jarAsandho mahAbalaH |
yo.anena yuddhaM neyeSha dAso.ayamiti sa.nyuge
shlokas.2:
keshavena kRRitaM yattu jarAsandhavadhe tadA |
bhImasenArjunAbhyAM cha kastatsAdhviti manyate
shlokas.3:
advAreNa praviShTena ChadmanA brahmavAdinA |
dRRiShTaH prabhAvaH kRRiShNena jarAsandhasya dhImataH
shlokas.4:
yena dharmAtmanAtmAnaM brahmaNyamabhijAnatA |
naiShitaM pAdyamasmai taddAtumagre durAtmane
shlokas.5:
bhujyatAmiti tenoktAH kRRiShNabhImadhana~njayAH |
jarAsandhena kauravya kRRiShNena vikRRitaM kRRitam
shlokas.6:
yadyayaM jagataH kartA yathainaM mUrkha manyase |
kasmAnna brAhmaNaM samyagAtmAnamavagachChati
shlokas.7:
idaM tvAshcharyabhUtaM me yadime pANDavAstvayA |
apakRRiShTAH satAM mArgAnmanyante tachcha sAdhviti
shlokas.8:
atha vA naitadAshcharyaM yeShAM tvamasi bhArata |
strIsadharmA cha vRRiddhashcha sarvArthAnAM pradarshakaH
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA rUkShaM rUkShAkSharaM bahu |
chukopa balinAM shreShTho bhImasenaH pratApavAn
shlokas.10:
tasya padmapratIkAshe svabhAvAyatavistRRite |
bhUyaH krodhAbhitAmrAnte rakte netre babhUvatuH
shlokas.11:
trishikhAM bhrukuTIM chAsya dadRRishuH sarvapArthivAH |
lalATasthAM trikUTasthAM ga~NgAM tripathagAmiva
shlokas.12:
dantAnsa.ndashatastasya kopAddadRRishurAnanam |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni kAlasyeva didhakShataH
shlokas.13:
utpatantaM tu vegena jagrAhainaM manasvinam |
bhIShma eva mahAbAhurmahAsenamiveshvaraH
shlokas.14:
tasya bhImasya bhIShmeNa vAryamANasya bhArata |
guruNA vividhairvAkyaiH krodhaH prashamamAgataH
shlokas.15:
nAtichakrAma bhIShmasya sa hi vAkyamari.ndamaH |
samuddhUto ghanApAye velAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.16:
shishupAlastu sa~Nkruddhe bhImasene narAdhipa |
nAkampata tadA vIraH pauruShe sve vyavasthitaH
shlokas.17:
utpatantaM tu vegena punaH punarari.ndamaH |
na sa taM chintayAmAsa siMhaH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.18:
prahasa.nshchAbravIdvAkyaM chedirAjaH pratApavAn |
bhImasenamatikruddhaM dRRiShTvA bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.19:
mu~nchainaM bhIShma pashyantu yAvadenaM narAdhipAH |
matpratApAgninirdagdhaM pata~Ngamiva vahninA
shlokas.20:
tatashchedipatervAkyaM tachChrutvA kurusattamaH |
bhImasenamuvAchedaM bhIShmo matimatAM varaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chedirAjakule jAtastryakSha eSha chaturbhujaH |
rAsabhArAvasadRRishaM rurAva cha nanAda cha
shlokas.2:
tenAsya mAtApitarau tresatustau sabAndhavau |
vaikRRitaM tachcha tau dRRiShTvA tyAgAya kurutAM matim
shlokas.3:
tataH sabhAryaM nRRipatiM sAmAtyaM sapurohitam |
chintAsaMmUDhahRRidayaM vAguvAchAsharIriNI
shlokas.4:
eSha te nRRipate putraH shrImA~njAto mahAbalaH |
tasmAdasmAnna bhetavyamavyagraH pAhi vai shishum
shlokas.5:
na chaivaitasya mRRityustvaM na kAlaH pratyupasthitaH |
mRRityurhantAsya shastreNa sa chotpanno narAdhipa
shlokas.6:
sa.nshrutyodAhRRitaM vAkyaM bhUtamantarhitaM tataH |
putrasnehAbhisantaptA jananI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.7:
yenedamIritaM vAkyaM mamaiva tanayaM prati |
prA~njalistaM namasyAmi bravItu sa punarvachaH
shlokas.8:
shrotumichChAmi putrasya ko.asya mRRityurbhaviShyati |
antarhitaM tato bhUtamuvAchedaM punarvachaH
shlokas.9:
yenotsa~Nge gRRihItasya bhujAvabhyadhikAvubhau |
patiShyataH kShititale pa~nchashIrShAvivoragau
shlokas.10:
tRRitIyametadbAlasya lalATasthaM cha lochanam |
nimajjiShyati yaM dRRiShTvA so.asya mRRityurbhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
tryakShaM chaturbhujaM shrutvA tathA cha samudAhRRitam |
dharaNyAM pArthivAH sarve abhyagachChandidRRikShavaH
shlokas.12:
tAnpUjayitvA samprAptAnyathArhaM sa mahIpatiH |
ekaikasya nRRipasyA~Nke putramAropayattadA
shlokas.13:
evaM rAjasahasrANAM pRRithaktvena yathAkramam |
shishura~Nke samArUDho na tatprApa nidarshanam
shlokas.14:
tatashchedipuraM prAptau sa~NkarShaNajanArdanau |
yAdavau yAdavIM draShTuM svasAraM tAM pitustadA
shlokas.15:
abhivAdya yathAnyAyaM yathAjyeShThaM nRRipA.nshcha tAn |
kushalAnAmayaM pRRiShTvA niShaNNau rAmakeshavau
shlokas.16:
abhyarchitau tadA vIrau prItyA chAbhyadhikaM tataH |
putraM dAmodarotsa~Nge devI saMnyadadhAtsvayam
shlokas.17:
nyastamAtrasya tasyA~Nke bhujAvabhyadhikAvubhau |
petatustachcha nayanaM nimamajja lalATajam
shlokas.18:
taddRRiShTvA vyathitA trastA varaM kRRiShNamayAchata |
dadasva me varaM kRRiShNa bhayArtAyA mahAbhuja
shlokas.19:
tvaM hyArtAnAM samAshvAso bhItAnAmabhaya~NkaraH |
pitRRiShvasAraM mA bhaiShIrityuvAcha janArdanaH
shlokas.20:
dadAni kaM varaM kiM vA karavANi pitRRiShvasaH |
shakyaM vA yadi vAshakyaM kariShyAmi vachastava
shlokas.21:
evamuktA tataH kRRiShNamabravIdyadunandanam |
shishupAlasyAparAdhAnkShamethAstvaM mahAbala
shlokas.22:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
aparAdhashataM kShAmyaM mayA hyasya pitRRiShvasaH |
putrasya te vadhArhANAM mA tvaM shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.23:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evameSha nRRipaH pApaH shishupAlaH sumandadhIH |
tvAM samAhvayate vIra govindavaradarpitaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
naiShA chedipaterbuddhiryayA tvAhvayate.achyutam |
nUnameSha jagadbhartuH kRRiShNasyaiva vinishchayaH
shlokas.2:
ko hi mAM bhImasenAdya kShitAvarhati pArthivaH |
kSheptuM daivaparItAtmA yathaiSha kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.3:
eSha hyasya mahAbAho tejo.nshashcha harerdhruvam |
tameva punarAdAtumichChatpRRithuyashA hariH
shlokas.4:
yenaiSha kurushArdUla shArdUla iva chedirAT |
garjatyatIva durbuddhiH sarvAnasmAnachintayan
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato na mamRRiShe chaidyastadbhIShmavachanaM tadA |
uvAcha chainaM sa~NkruddhaH punarbhIShmamathottaram
shlokas.6:
shishupAla uvAcha||
dviShatAM no.astu bhIShmaiSha prabhAvaH keshavasya yaH |
yasya sa.nstavavaktA tvaM bandivatsatatotthitaH
shlokas.7:
sa.nstavAya mano bhIShma pareShAM ramate sadA |
yadi sa.nstauShi rAj~nastvamimaM hitvA janArdanam
shlokas.8:
daradaM stuhi bAhlIkamimaM pArthivasattamam |
jAyamAnena yeneyamabhavaddAritA mahI
shlokas.9:
va~NgA~NgaviShayAdhyakShaM sahasrAkShasamaM bale |
stuhi karNamimaM bhIShma mahAchApavikarShaNam
shlokas.10:
droNaM drauNiM cha sAdhu tvaM pitAputrau mahArathau |
stuhi stutyAvimau bhIShma satataM dvijasattamau
shlokas.11:
yayoranyataro bhIShma sa~NkruddhaH sacharAcharAm |
imAM vasumatIM kuryAdasheShAmiti me matiH
shlokas.12:
droNasya hi samaM yuddhe na pashyAmi narAdhipam |
ashvatthAmnastathA bhIShma na chaitau stotumichChasi
shlokas.13:
shalyAdInapi kasmAttvaM na stauShi vasudhAdhipAn |
stavAya yadi te buddhirvartate bhIShma sarvadA
shlokas.14:
kiM hi shakyaM mayA kartuM yadvRRiddhAnAM tvayA nRRipa |
purA kathayatAM nUnaM na shrutaM dharmavAdinAm
shlokas.15:
AtmanindAtmapUjA cha paranindA parastavaH |
anAcharitamAryANAM vRRittametachchaturvidham
shlokas.16:
yadastavyamimaM shashvanmohAtsa.nstauShi bhaktitaH |
keshavaM tachcha te bhIShma na kashchidanumanyate
shlokas.17:
kathaM bhojasya puruShe vargapAle durAtmani |
samAveshayase sarvaM jagatkevalakAmyayA
shlokas.18:
atha vaiShA na te bhaktiH pakRRitiM yAti bhArata |
mayaiva kathitaM pUrvaM bhUli~NgashakuniryathA
shlokas.19:
bhUli~NgashakunirnAma pArshve himavataH pare |
bhIShma tasyAH sadA vAchaH shrUyante.arthavigarhitAH
shlokas.20:
mA sAhasamitIdaM sA satataM vAshate kila |
sAhasaM chAtmanAtIva charantI nAvabudhyate
shlokas.21:
sA hi mA.nsArgalaM bhIShma mukhAtsiMhasya khAdataH |
dantAntaravilagnaM yattadAdatte.alpachetanA
shlokas.22:
ichChataH sA hi siMhasya bhIShma jIvatyasa.nshayam |
tadvattvamapyadharmaj~na sadA vAchaH prabhAShase
shlokas.23:
ichChatAM pArthivendrANAM bhIShma jIvasyasa.nshayam |
lokavidviShTakarmA hi nAnyo.asti bhavatA samaH
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatashchedipateH shrutvA bhIShmaH sa kaTukaM vachaH |
uvAchedaM vacho rAja.nshchedirAjasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.25:
ichChatAM kila nAmAhaM jIvAmyeShAM mahIkShitAm |
yo.ahaM na gaNayAmyetA.nstRRiNAnIva narAdhipAn
shlokas.26:
evamukte tu bhIShmeNa tataH sa~nchukrudhurnRRipAH |
kechijjahRRiShire tatra kechidbhIShmaM jagarhire
shlokas.27:
kechidUchurmaheShvAsAH shrutvA bhIShmasya tadvachaH |
pApo.avalipto vRRiddhashcha nAyaM bhIShmo.arhati kShamAm
shlokas.28:
hanyatAM durmatirbhIShmaH pashuvatsAdhvayaM nRRipaiH |
sarvaiH sametya sa.nrabdhairdahyatAM vA kaTAgninA
shlokas.29:
iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA tataH kurupitAmahaH |
uvAcha matimAnbhIShmastAneva vasudhAdhipAn
shlokas.30:
uktasyoktasya nehAntamahaM samupalakShaye |
yattu vakShyAmi tatsarvaM shRRiNudhvaM vasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.31:
pashuvadghAtanaM vA me dahanaM vA kaTAgninA |
kriyatAM mUrdhni vo nyastaM mayedaM sakalaM padam
shlokas.32:
eSha tiShThati govindaH pUjito.asmAbhirachyutaH |
yasya vastvarate buddhirmaraNAya sa mAdhavam
shlokas.33:
kRRiShNamAhvayatAmadya yuddhe shAr~NgagadAdharam |
yAvadasyaiva devasya dehaM vishatu pAtitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shrutvaiva bhIShmasya chedirADuruvikramaH |
yuyutsurvAsudevena vAsudevamuvAcha ha
shlokas.2:
Ahvaye tvAM raNaM gachCha mayA sArdhaM janArdana |
yAvadadya nihanmi tvAM sahitaM sarvapANDavaiH
shlokas.3:
saha tvayA hi me vadhyAH pANDavAH kRRiShNa sarvathA |
nRRipatInsamatikramya yairarAjA tvamarchitaH
shlokas.4:
ye tvAM dAsamarAjAnaM bAlyAdarchanti durmatim |
anarhamarhavatkRRiShNa vadhyAsta iti me matiH
ityuktvA rAjashArdUlastasthau garjannamarShaNaH
shlokas.5:
evamukte tataH kRRiShNo mRRidupUrvamidaM vachaH |
uvAcha pArthivAnsarvA.nstatsamakShaM cha pANDavAn
shlokas.6:
eSha naH shatruratyantaM pArthivAH sAtvatIsutaH |
sAtvatAnAM nRRisha.nsAtmA na hito.anapakAriNAm
shlokas.7:
prAgjyotiShapuraM yAtAnasmA~nj~nAtvA nRRisha.nsakRRit |
adahaddvArakAmeSha svasrIyaH sannarAdhipAH
shlokas.8:
krIDato bhojarAjanyAneSha raivatake girau |
hatvA baddhvA cha tAnsarvAnupAyAtsvapuraM purA
shlokas.9:
ashvamedhe hayaM medhyamutsRRiShTaM rakShibhirvRRitam |
piturme yaj~navighnArthamaharatpApanishchayaH
shlokas.10:
sauvIrAnpratipattau cha babhroreSha yashasvinaH |
bhAryAmabhyaharanmohAdakAmAM tAmito gatAm
shlokas.11:
eSha mAyApratichChannaH karUShArthe tapasvinIm |
jahAra bhadrAM vaishAlIM mAtulasya nRRisha.nsakRRit
shlokas.12:
pitRRiShvasuH kRRite duHkhaM sumahanmarShayAmyaham |
diShTyA tvidaM sarvarAj~nAM saMnidhAvadya vartate
shlokas.13:
pashyanti hi bhavanto.adya mayyatIva vyatikramam |
kRRitAni tu parokShaM me yAni tAni nibodhata
shlokas.14:
imaM tvasya na shakShyAmi kShantumadya vyatikramam |
avalepAdvadhArhasya samagre rAjamaNDale
shlokas.15:
rukmiNyAmasya mUDhasya prArthanAsInmumUrShataH |
na cha tAM prAptavAnmUDhaH shUdro vedashrutiM yathA
shlokas.16:
evamAdi tataH sarve sahitAste narAdhipAH |
vAsudevavachaH shrutvA chedirAjaM vyagarhayan
shlokas.17:
tatastadvachanaM shrutvA shishupAlaH pratApavAn |
jahAsa svanavaddhAsaM prahasyedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.18:
matpUrvAM rukmiNIM kRRiShNa sa.nsatsu parikIrtayan |
visheShataH pArthiveShu vrIDAM na kuruShe katham
shlokas.19:
manyamAno hi kaH satsu puruShaH parikIrtayet |
anyapUrvAM striyaM jAtu tvadanyo madhusUdana
shlokas.20:
kShama vA yadi te shraddhA mA vA kRRiShNa mama kShama |
kruddhAdvApi prasannAdvA kiM me tvatto bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
tathA bruvata evAsya bhagavAnmadhusUdanaH |
vyapAharachChiraH kruddhashchakreNAmitrakarShaNaH
sa papAta mahAbAhurvajrAhata ivAchalaH
shlokas.22:
tatashchedipaterdehAttejo.agryaM dadRRishurnRRipAH |
utpatantaM mahArAja gaganAdiva bhAskaram
shlokas.23:
tataH kamalapatrAkShaM kRRiShNaM lokanamaskRRitam |
vavande tattadA tejo vivesha cha narAdhipa
shlokas.24:
tadadbhutamamanyanta dRRiShTvA sarve mahIkShitaH |
yadvivesha mahAbAhuM tattejaH puruShottamam
shlokas.25:
anabhre pravavarSha dyauH papAta jvalitAshaniH |
kRRiShNena nihate chaidye chachAla cha vasundharA
shlokas.26:
tataH kechinmahIpAlA nAbruva.nstatra ki~nchana |
atItavAkpathe kAle prekShamANA janArdanam
shlokas.27:
hastairhastAgramapare pratyapIShannamarShitAH |
apare dashanairoShThAnadashankrodhamUrChitAH
shlokas.28:
rahastu kechidvArShNeyaM prashasha.nsurnarAdhipAH |
kechideva tu sa.nrabdhA madhyasthAstvapare.abhavan
shlokas.29:
prahRRiShTAH keshavaM jagmuH sa.nstuvanto maharShayaH |
brAhmaNAshcha mahAtmAnaH pArthivAshcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.30:
pANDavastvabravIdbhrAtR^InsatkAreNa mahIpatim |
damaghoShAtmajaM vIraM sa.nsAdhayata mA chiram
tathA cha kRRitavantaste bhrAturvai shAsanaM tadA
shlokas.31:
chedInAmAdhipatye cha putramasya mahIpatim |
abhyaShi~nchattadA pArthaH saha tairvasudhAdhipaiH
shlokas.32:
tataH sa kururAjasya kratuH sarvasamRRiddhimAn |
yUnAM prItikaro rAjansambabhau vipulaujasaH
shlokas.33:
shAntavighnaH sukhArambhaH prabhUtadhanadhAnyavAn |
annavAnbahubhakShyashcha keshavena surakShitaH
shlokas.34:
samApayAmAsa cha taM rAjasUyaM mahAkratum |
taM tu yaj~naM mahAbAhurA samApterjanArdanaH
rarakSha bhagavA~nshauriH shAr~NgachakragadAdharaH
shlokas.35:
tatastvavabhRRithasnAtaM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
samastaM pArthivaM kShatramabhigamyedamabravIt
shlokas.36:
diShTyA vardhasi dharmaj~na sAmrAjyaM prAptavAnvibho |
AjamIDhAjamIDhAnAM yashaH sa.nvardhitaM tvayA
karmaNaitena rAjendra dharmashcha sumahAnkRRitaH
shlokas.37:
ApRRichChAmo naravyAghra sarvakAmaiH supUjitAH |
svarAShTrANi gamiShyAmastadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.38:
shrutvA tu vachanaM rAj~nAM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
yathArhaM pUjya nRRipatInbhrAtR^InsarvAnuvAcha ha
shlokas.39:
rAjAnaH sarva evaite prItyAsmAnsamupAgatAH |
prasthitAH svAni rAShTrANi mAmApRRichChya parantapAH
te.anuvrajata bhadraM vo viShayAntaM nRRipottamAn
shlokas.40:
bhrAturvachanamAj~nAya pANDavA dharmachAriNaH |
yathArhaM nRRipamukhyA.nstAnekaikaM samanuvrajan
shlokas.41:
virATamanvayAttUrNaM dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
dhana~njayo yaj~nasenaM mahAtmAnaM mahArathaH
shlokas.42:
bhIShmaM cha dhRRitarAShTraM cha bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
droNaM cha sasutaM vIraM sahadevo mahArathaH
shlokas.43:
nakulaH subalaM rAjansahaputraM samanvayAt |
draupadeyAH sasaubhadrAH pArvatIyAnmahIpatIn
shlokas.45:
gateShu pArthivendreShu sarveShu bharatarShabha |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM vAsudevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.46:
ApRRichChe tvAM gamiShyAmi dvArakAM kurunandana |
rAjasUyaM kratushreShThaM diShTyA tvaM prAptavAnasi
shlokas.47:
tamuvAchaivamuktastu dharmarANmadhusUdanam |
tava prasAdAdgovinda prAptavAnasmi vai kratum
shlokas.48:
samastaM pArthivaM kShatraM tvatprasAdAdvashAnugam |
upAdAya baliM mukhyaM mAmeva samupasthitam
shlokas.49:
na vayaM tvAmRRite vIra ra.nsyAmeha katha~nchana |
avashyaM chApi gantavyA tvayA dvAravatI purI
shlokas.50:
evamuktaH sa dharmAtmA yudhiShThirasahAyavAn |
abhigamyAbravItprItaH pRRithAM pRRithuyashA hariH
shlokas.51:
sAmrAjyaM samanuprAptAH putrAste.adya pitRRiShvasaH |
siddhArthA vasumantashcha sA tvaM prItimavApnuhi
shlokas.52:
anuj~nAtastvayA chAhaM dvArakAM gantumutsahe |
subhadrAM draupadIM chaiva sabhAjayata keshavaH
shlokas.53:
niShkramyAntaHpurAchchaiva yudhiShThirasahAyavAn |
snAtashcha kRRitajapyashcha brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha
shlokas.54:
tato meghavaraprakhyaM syandanaM vai sukalpitam |
yojayitvA mahArAja dArukaH pratyupasthitaH
shlokas.55:
upasthitaM rathaM dRRiShTvA tArkShyapravaraketanam |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya samAruhya mahAmanAH
prayayau puNDarIkAkShastato dvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.56:
taM padbhyAmanuvavrAja dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH shrImAnvAsudevaM mahAbalam
shlokas.57:
tato muhUrtaM sa~NgRRihya syandanapravaraM hariH |
abravItpuNDarIkAkShaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.58:
apramattaH sthito nityaM prajAH pAhi vishAM pate |
parjanyamiva bhUtAni mahAdrumamivANDajAH
bAndhavAstvopajIvantu sahasrAkShamivAmarAH
shlokas.59:
kRRitvA paraspareNaivaM sa.nvidaM kRRiShNapANDavau |
anyonyaM samanuj~nApya jagmatuH svagRRihAnprati
shlokas.60:
gate dvAravatIM kRRiShNe sAtvatapravare nRRipa |
eko duryodhano rAjA shakunishchApi saubalaH
tasyAM sabhAyAM divyAyAmUShatustau nararShabhau

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vasanduryodhanastasyAM sabhAyAM bharatarShabha |
shanairdadarsha tAM sarvAM sabhAM shakuninA saha
shlokas.2:
tasyAM divyAnabhiprAyAndadarsha kurunandanaH |
na dRRiShTapUrvA ye tena nagare nAgasAhvaye
shlokas.3:
sa kadAchitsabhAmadhye dhArtarAShTro mahIpatiH |
sphATikaM talamAsAdya jalamityabhisha~NkayA
shlokas.4:
svavastrotkarShaNaM rAjA kRRitavAnbuddhimohitaH |
durmanA vimukhashchaiva parichakrAma tAM sabhAm
shlokas.5:
tataH sphATikatoyAM vai sphATikAmbujashobhitAm |
vApIM matvA sthalamiti savAsAH prApatajjale
shlokas.6:
jale nipatitaM dRRiShTvA ki~NkarA jahasurbhRRisham |
vAsA.nsi cha shubhAnyasmai pradadU rAjashAsanAt
shlokas.7:
tathAgataM tu taM dRRiShTvA bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
arjunashcha yamau chobhau sarve te prAhasa.nstadA
shlokas.8:
nAmarShayattatasteShAmavahAsamamarShaNaH |
AkAraM rakShamANastu na sa tAnsamudaikShata
shlokas.9:
punarvasanamutkShipya pratariShyanniva sthalam |
Aruroha tataH sarve jahasuste punarjanAH
shlokas.10:
dvAraM cha vivRRitAkAraM lalATena samAhanat |
sa.nvRRitaM cheti manvAno dvAradeshAdupAramat
shlokas.11:
evaM pralambhAnvividhAnprApya tatra vishAM pate |
pANDaveyAbhyanuj~nAtastato duryodhano nRRipaH
shlokas.12:
aprahRRiShTena manasA rAjasUye mahAkratau |
prekShya tAmadbhutAmRRiddhiM jagAma gajasAhvayam
shlokas.13:
pANDavashrIprataptasya dhyAnaglAnasya gachChataH |
duryodhanasya nRRipateH pApA matirajAyata
shlokas.14:
pArthAnsumanaso dRRiShTvA pArthivA.nshcha vashAnugAn |
kRRitsnaM chApi hitaM lokamAkumAraM kurUdvaha
shlokas.15:
mahimAnaM paraM chApi pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
duryodhano dhArtarAShTro vivarNaH samapadyata
shlokas.16:
sa tu gachChannanekAgraH sabhAmevAnuchintayan |
shriyaM cha tAmanupamAM dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.17:
pramatto dhRRitarAShTrasya putro duryodhanastadA |
nAbhyabhAShatsubalajaM bhAShamANaM punaH punaH
shlokas.18:
anekAgraM tu taM dRRiShTvA shakuniH pratyabhAShata |
duryodhana kutomUlaM niHshvasanniva gachChasi
shlokas.19:
duryodhana uvAcha||
dRRiShTvemAM pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM yudhiShThiravashAnugAm |
jitAmastrapratApena shvetAshvasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
taM cha yaj~naM tathAbhUtaM dRRiShTvA pArthasya mAtula |
yathA shakrasya deveShu tathAbhUtaM mahAdyute
shlokas.21:
amarSheNa susampUrNo dahyamAno divAnisham |
shuchishukrAgame kAle shuShye toyamivAlpakam
shlokas.22:
pashya sAtvatamukhyena shishupAlaM nipAtitam |
na cha tatra pumAnAsItkashchittasya padAnugaH
