shlokas.23:
dahyamAnA hi rAjAnaH pANDavotthena vahninA |
kShAntavanto.aparAdhaM taM ko hi taM kShantumarhati
shlokas.24:
vAsudevena tatkarma tathAyuktaM mahatkRRitam |
siddhaM cha pANDaveyAnAM pratApena mahAtmanAm
shlokas.25:
tathA hi ratnAnyAdAya vividhAni nRRipA nRRipam |
upatiShThanti kaunteyaM vaishyA iva karapradAH
shlokas.26:
shriyaM tathAvidhAM dRRiShTvA jvalantImiva pANDave |
amarShavashamApanno dahye.ahamatathochitaH
shlokas.27:
vahnimeva pravekShyAmi bhakShayiShyAmi vA viSham |
apo vApi pravekShyAmi na hi shakShyAmi jIvitum
shlokas.28:
ko hi nAma pumA.Nlloke marShayiShyati sattvavAn |
sapatnAnRRidhyato dRRiShTvA hAnimAtmana eva cha
shlokas.29:
so.ahaM na strI na chApyastrI na pumAnnApumAnapi |
yo.ahaM tAM marShayAmyadya tAdRRishIM shriyamAgatAm
shlokas.30:
IshvaratvaM pRRithivyAshcha vasumattAM cha tAdRRishIm |
yaj~naM cha tAdRRishaM dRRiShTvA mAdRRishaH ko na sa~njvaret
shlokas.31:
ashaktashchaika evAhaM tAmAhartuM nRRipashriyam |
sahAyA.nshcha na pashyAmi tena mRRityuM vichintaye
shlokas.32:
daivameva paraM manye pauruShaM tu nirarthakam |
dRRiShTvA kuntIsute shubhrAM shriyaM tAmAhRRitAM tathA
shlokas.33:
kRRito yatno mayA pUrvaM vinAshe tasya saubala |
tachcha sarvamatikramya sa vRRiddho.apsviva pa~Nkajam
shlokas.34:
tena daivaM paraM manye pauruShaM tu nirarthakam |
dhArtarAShTrA hi hIyante pArthA vardhanti nityashaH
shlokas.35:
so.ahaM shriyaM cha tAM dRRiShTvA sabhAM tAM cha tathAvidhAm |
rakShibhishchAvahAsaM taM paritapye yathAgninA
shlokas.36:
sa mAmabhyanujAnIhi mAtulAdya suduHkhitam |
amarShaM cha samAviShTaM dhRRitarAShTre nivedaya

shlokas.1:
shakuniruvAcha||
duryodhana na te.amarShaH kAryaH prati yudhiShThiram |
bhAgadheyAni hi svAni pANDavA bhu~njate sadA
shlokas.2:
anekairabhyupAyaishcha tvayArabdhAH purAsakRRit |
vimuktAshcha naravyAghrA bhAgadheyapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.3:
tairlabdhA draupadI bhAryA drupadashcha sutaiH saha |
sahAyaH pRRithivIlAbhe vAsudevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
labdhashcha nAbhibhUto.arthaH pitryoM.ashaH pRRithivIpate |
vivRRiddhastejasA teShAM tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.5:
dhana~njayena gANDIvamakShayyau cha maheShudhI |
labdhAnyastrANi divyAni tarpayitvA hutAshanam
shlokas.6:
tena kArmukamukhyena bAhuvIryeNa chAtmanaH |
kRRitA vashe mahIpAlAstatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.7:
agnidAhAnmayaM chApi mokShayitvA sa dAnavam |
sabhAM tAM kArayAmAsa savyasAchI parantapaH
shlokas.8:
tena chaiva mayenoktAH ki~NkarA nAma rAkShasAH |
vahanti tAM sabhAM bhImAstatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.9:
yachchAsahAyatAM rAjannuktavAnasi bhArata |
tanmithyA bhrAtaro hIme sahAyAste mahArathAH
shlokas.10:
droNastava maheShvAsaH saha putreNa dhImatA |
sUtaputrashcha rAdheyo gautamashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.11:
ahaM cha saha sodaryaiH saumadattishcha vIryavAn |
etaistvaM sahitaH sarvairjaya kRRitsnAM vasundharAm
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
tvayA cha sahito rAjannetaishchAnyairmahArathaiH |
etAneva vijeShyAmi yadi tvamanumanyase
shlokas.13:
eteShu vijiteShvadya bhaviShyati mahI mama |
sarve cha pRRithivIpAlAH sabhA sA cha mahAdhanA
shlokas.14:
shakuniruvAcha||
dhana~njayo vAsudevo bhImaseno yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha drupadashcha sahAtmajaiH
shlokas.15:
naite yudhi balAjjetuM shakyAH suragaNairapi |
mahArathA maheShvAsAH kRRitAstrA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.16:
ahaM tu tadvijAnAmi vijetuM yena shakyate |
yudhiShThiraM svayaM rAja.nstannibodha juShasva cha
shlokas.17:
duryodhana uvAcha||
apramAdena suhRRidAmanyeShAM cha mahAtmanAm |
yadi shakyA vijetuM te tanmamAchakShva mAtula
shlokas.18:
shakuniruvAcha||
dyUtapriyashcha kaunteyo na cha jAnAti devitum |
samAhUtashcha rAjendro na shakShyati nivartitum
shlokas.19:
devane kushalashchAhaM na me.asti sadRRisho bhuvi |
triShu lokeShu kaunteyaM taM tvaM dyUte samAhvaya
shlokas.20:
tasyAkShakushalo rAjannAdAsye.ahamasa.nshayam |
rAjyaM shriyaM cha tAM dIptAM tvadarthaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.21:
idaM tu sarvaM tvaM rAj~ne duryodhana nivedaya |
anuj~nAtastu te pitrA vijeShye taM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.22:
duryodhana uvAcha||
tvameva kurumukhyAya dhRRitarAShTrAya saubala |
nivedaya yathAnyAyaM nAhaM shakShye nisha.nsitum

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anubhUya tu rAj~nastaM rAjasUyaM mahAkratum |
yudhiShThirasya nRRipatergAndhArIputrasa.nyutaH
shlokas.2:
priyakRRinmatamAj~nAya pUrvaM duryodhanasya tat |
praj~nAchakShuShamAsInaM shakuniH saubalastadA
shlokas.3:
duryodhanavachaH shrutvA dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam |
upagamya mahAprAj~naM shakunirvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.4:
duryodhano mahArAja vivarNo hariNaH kRRishaH |
dInashchintAparashchaiva tadviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
na vai parIkShase samyagasahyaM shatrusambhavam |
jyeShThaputrasya shokaM tvaM kimarthaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
duryodhana kutomUlaM bhRRishamArto.asi putraka |
shrotavyashchenmayA so.artho brUhi me kurunandana
shlokas.7:
ayaM tvAM shakuniH prAha vivarNaM hariNaM kRRisham |
chintaya.nshcha na pashyAmi shokasya tava sambhavam
shlokas.8:
aishvaryaM hi mahatputra tvayi sarvaM samarpitam |
bhrAtaraH suhRRidashchaiva nAcharanti tavApriyam
shlokas.9:
AchChAdayasi prAvArAnashnAsi pishitaudanam |
AjAneyA vahanti tvAM kenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.10:
shayanAni mahArhANi yoShitashcha manoramAH |
guNavanti cha veshmAni vihArAshcha yathAsukham
shlokas.11:
devAnAmiva te sarvaM vAchi baddhaM na sa.nshayaH |
sa dIna iva durdharShaH kasmAchChochasi putraka
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ashnAmyAchChAdaye chAhaM yathA kupuruShastathA |
amarShaM dhAraye chograM titikShankAlaparyayam
shlokas.13:
amarShaNaH svAH prakRRitIrabhibhUya pare sthitAH |
kleshAnmumukShuH parajAnsa vai puruSha uchyate
shlokas.14:
santoSho vai shriyaM hanti abhimAnashcha bhArata |
anukroshabhaye chobhe yairvRRito nAshnute mahat
shlokas.15:
na mAmavati tadbhuktaM shriyaM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThire |
jvalantImiva kaunteye vivarNakaraNIM mama
shlokas.16:
sapatnAnRRidhyato.a.atmAnaM hIyamAnaM nishAmya cha |
adRRishyAmapi kaunteye sthitAM pashyannivodyatAm
tasmAdahaM vivarNashcha dInashcha hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.17:
aShTAshItisahasrANi snAtakA gRRihamedhinaH |
tri.nshaddAsIka ekaiko yAnbibharti yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
dashAnyAni sahasrANi nityaM tatrAnnamuttamam |
bhu~njate rukmapAtrIbhiryudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.19:
kadalImRRigamokAni kRRiShNashyAmAruNAni cha |
kAmbojaH prAhiNottasmai parArdhyAnapi kambalAn
shlokas.20:
rathayoShidgavAshvasya shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
tri.nshataM choShTravAmInAM shatAni vicharantyuta
shlokas.21:
pRRithagvidhAni ratnAni pArthivAH pRRithivIpate |
Aharankratumukhye.asminkuntIputrAya bhUrishaH
shlokas.22:
na kvachiddhi mayA dRRiShTastAdRRisho naiva cha shrutaH |
yAdRRigdhanAgamo yaj~ne pANDuputrasya dhImataH
shlokas.23:
aparyantaM dhanaughaM taM dRRiShTvA shatrorahaM nRRipa |
sharma naivAdhigachChAmi chintayAno.anishaM vibho
shlokas.24:
brAhmaNA vATadhAnAshcha gomantaH shatasa~NghashaH |
traikharvaM balimAdAya dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.25:
kamaNDalUnupAdAya jAtarUpamayA~nshubhAn |
evaM baliM samAdAya praveshaM lebhire tataH
shlokas.26:
yannaiva madhu shakrAya dhArayantyamarastriyaH |
tadasmai kA.nsyamAhArShIdvAruNaM kalashodadhiH
shlokas.27:
shaikyaM rukmasahasrasya bahuratnavibhUShitam |
dRRiShTvA cha mama tatsarvaM jvararUpamivAbhavat
shlokas.28:
gRRihItvA tattu gachChanti samudrau pUrvadakShiNau |
tathaiva pashchimaM yAnti gRRihItvA bharatarShabha
shlokas.29:
uttaraM tu na gachChanti vinA tAta patatribhiH |
idaM chAdbhutamatrAsIttanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.30:
pUrNe shatasahasre tu viprANAM pariviShyatAm |
sthApitA tatra sa~nj~nAbhUchCha~Nkho dhmAyati nityashaH
shlokas.31:
muhurmuhuH praNadatastasya sha~Nkhasya bhArata |
uttamaM shabdamashrauShaM tato romANi me.ahRRiShan
shlokas.32:
pArthivairbahubhiH kIrNamupasthAnaM didRRikShubhiH |
sarvaratnAnyupAdAya pArthivA vai janeshvara
shlokas.33:
yaj~ne tasya mahArAja pANDuputrasya dhImataH |
vaishyA iva mahIpAlA dvijAtipariveShakAH
shlokas.34:
na sA shrIrdevarAjasya yamasya varuNasya vA |
guhyakAdhipatervApi yA shrI rAjanyudhiShThire
shlokas.35:
tAM dRRiShTvA pANDuputrasya shriyaM paramikAmaham |
shAntiM na parigachChAmi dahyamAnena chetasA
shlokas.36:
shakuniruvAcha||
yAmetAmuttamAM lakShmIM dRRiShTavAnasi pANDave |
tasyAH prAptAvupAyaM me shRRiNu satyaparAkrama
shlokas.37:
ahamakSheShvabhij~nAtaH pRRithivyAmapi bhArata |
hRRidayaj~naH paNaj~nashcha visheShaj~nashcha devane
shlokas.38:
dyUtapriyashcha kaunteyo na cha jAnAti devitum |
AhUtashchaiShyati vyaktaM dIvyAvetyAhvayasva tam
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH shakuninA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
dhRRitarAShTramidaM vAkyamapadAntaramabravIt
shlokas.41:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kShattA mantrI mahAprAj~naH sthito yasyAsmi shAsane |
tena sa~Ngamya vetsyAmi kAryasyAsya vinishchayam
shlokas.42:
sa hi dharmaM puraskRRitya dIrghadarshI paraM hitam |
ubhayoH pakShayoryuktaM vakShyatyarthavinishchayam
shlokas.43:
duryodhana uvAcha||
nivartayiShyati tvAsau yadi kShattA sameShyati |
nivRRitte tvayi rAjendra mariShye.ahamasa.nshayam
shlokas.44:
sa mayi tvaM mRRite rAjanvidureNa sukhI bhava |
bhokShyase pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM kiM mayA tvaM kariShyasi
shlokas.45:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ArtavAkyaM tu tattasya praNayoktaM nishamya saH |
dhRRitarAShTro.abravItpreShyAnduryodhanamate sthitaH
shlokas.46:
sthUNAsahasrairbRRihatIM shatadvArAM sabhAM mama |
manoramAM darshanIyAmAshu kurvantu shilpinaH
shlokas.47:
tataH sa.nstIrya ratnaistAmakShAnAvApya sarvashaH |
sukRRitAM supraveshAM cha nivedayata me shanaiH
shlokas.48:
duryodhanasya shAntyarthamiti nishchitya bhUmipaH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAja prAhiNodvidurAya vai
shlokas.49:
apRRiShTvA viduraM hyasya nAsItkashchidvinishchayaH |
dyUtadoShA.nshcha jAnansa putrasnehAdakRRiShyata
shlokas.51:
so.abhigamya mahAtmAnaM bhrAtA bhrAtaramagrajam |
mUrdhnA praNamya charaNAvidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.52:
nAbhinandAmi te rAjanvyavasAyamimaM prabho |
putrairbhedo yathA na syAddyUtahetostathA kuru
shlokas.53:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kShattaH putreShu putrairme kalaho na bhaviShyati |
divi devAH prasAdaM naH kariShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.54:
ashubhaM vA shubhaM vApi hitaM vA yadi vAhitam |
pravartatAM suhRRiddyUtaM diShTametanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.55:
mayi saMnihite chaiva bhIShme cha bharatarShabhe |
anayo daivavihito na katha~nchidbhaviShyati
shlokas.56:
gachCha tvaM rathamAsthAya hayairvAtasamairjave |
khANDavaprasthamadyaiva samAnaya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.57:
na vAryo vyavasAyo me viduraitadbravImi te |
daivameva paraM manye yenaitadupapadyate
shlokas.58:
ityukto viduro dhImAnnaitadastIti chintayan |
ApageyaM mahAprAj~namabhyagachChatsuduHkhitaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM samabhavaddyUtaM bhrAtR^INAM tanmahAtyayam |
yatra tadvyasanaM prAptaM pANDavairme pitAmahaiH
shlokas.2:
ke cha tatra sabhAstArA rAjAno brahmavittama |
ke chainamanvamodanta ke chainaM pratyaShedhayan
shlokas.3:
vistareNaitadichChAmi kathyamAnaM tvayA dvija |
mUlaM hyetadvinAshasya pRRithivyA dvijasattama
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktastadA rAj~nA vyAsashiShyaH pratApavAn |
AchachakShe yathAvRRittaM tatsarvaM sarvavedavit
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu me vistareNemAM kathAM bharatasattama |
bhUya eva mahArAja yadi te shravaNe matiH
shlokas.6:
vidurasya mataM j~nAtvA dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamuvAcha vijane punaH
shlokas.7:
alaM dyUtena gAndhAre viduro na prasha.nsati |
na hyasau sumahAbuddhirahitaM no vadiShyati
shlokas.8:
hitaM hi paramaM manye viduro yatprabhAShate |
kriyatAM putra tatsarvametanmanye hitaM tava
shlokas.9:
devarShirvAsavagururdevarAjAya dhImate |
yatprAha shAstraM bhagavAnbRRihaspatirudAradhIH
shlokas.10:
tadveda viduraH sarvaM sarahasyaM mahAkaviH |
sthitashcha vachane tasya sadAhamapi putraka
shlokas.11:
viduro vApi medhAvI kurUNAM pravaro mataH |
uddhavo vA mahAbuddhirvRRiShNInAmarchito nRRipa
shlokas.12:
dyUtena tadalaM putra dyUte bhedo hi dRRishyate |
bhede vinAsho rAjyasya tatputra parivarjaya
shlokas.13:
pitrA mAtrA cha putrasya yadvai kAryaM paraM smRRitam |
prAptastvamasi tattAta pitRRipaitAmahaM padam
shlokas.14:
adhItavAnkRRitI shAstre lAlitaH satataM gRRihe |
bhrAtRRijyeShThaH sthito rAjye vindase kiM na shobhanam
shlokas.15:
pRRithagjanairalabhyaM yadbhojanAchChAdanaM param |
tatprApto.asi mahAbAho kasmAchChochasi putraka
shlokas.16:
sphItaM rAShTraM mahAbAho pitRRipaitAmahaM mahat |
nityamAj~nApayanbhAsi divi deveshvaro yathA
shlokas.17:
tasya te viditapraj~na shokamUlamidaM katham |
samutthitaM duHkhataraM tanme sha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.18:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ashnAmyAchChAdayAmIti prapashyanpApapUruShaH |
nAmarShaM kurute yastu puruShaH so.adhamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.19:
na mAM prINAti rAjendra lakShmIH sAdhAraNA vibho |
jvalitAmiva kaunteye shriyaM dRRiShTvA cha vivyathe
shlokas.20:
sarvAM hi pRRithivIM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiravashAnugAm |
sthiro.asmi yo.ahaM jIvAmi duHkhAdetadbravImi te
shlokas.21:
AvarjitA ivAbhAnti nighnAshchaitrakikaukurAH |
kAraskarA lohaja~NghA yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.22:
himavatsAgarAnUpAH sarvaratnAkarAstathA |
antyAH sarve paryudastA yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.23:
jyeShTho.ayamiti mAM matvA shreShThashcheti vishAM pate |
yudhiShThireNa satkRRitya yukto ratnaparigrahe
shlokas.24:
upasthitAnAM ratnAnAM shreShThAnAmarghahAriNAm |
nAdRRishyata paraH prAnto nAparastatra bhArata
shlokas.25:
na me hastaH samabhavadvasu tatpratigRRihNataH |
prAtiShThanta mayi shrAnte gRRihya dUrAhRRitaM vasu
shlokas.26:
kRRitAM bindusaroratnairmayena sphATikachChadAm |
apashyaM nalinIM pUrNAmudakasyeva bhArata
shlokas.27:
vastramutkarShati mayi prAhasatsa vRRikodaraH |
shatrorRRiddhivisheSheNa vimUDhaM ratnavarjitam
shlokas.28:
tatra sma yadi shaktaH syAM pAtayeyaM vRRikodaram |
sapatnenAvahAso hi sa mAM dahati bhArata
shlokas.29:
punashcha tAdRRishImeva vApIM jalajashAlinIm |
matvA shilAsamAM toye patito.asmi narAdhipa
shlokas.30:
tatra mAM prAhasatkRRiShNaH pArthena saha sasvanam |
draupadI cha saha strIbhirvyathayantI mano mama
shlokas.31:
klinnavastrasya cha jale ki~NkarA rAjachoditAH |
dadurvAsA.nsi me.anyAni tachcha duHkhataraM mama
shlokas.32:
pralambhaM cha shRRiNuShvAnyaM gadato me narAdhipa |
advAreNa vinirgachChandvArasa.nsthAnarUpiNA
abhihatya shilAM bhUyo lalATenAsmi vikShataH
shlokas.33:
tatra mAM yamajau dUrAdAlokya lalitau kila |
bAhubhiH parigRRihNItAM shochantau sahitAvubhau
shlokas.34:
uvAcha sahadevastu tatra mAM vismayanniva |
idaM dvAramito gachCha rAjanniti punaH punaH
shlokas.35:
nAmadheyAni ratnAnAM purastAnna shrutAni me |
yAni dRRiShTAni me tasyAM manastapati tachcha me

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
yanmayA pANDavAnAM tu dRRiShTaM tachChRRiNu bhArata |
AhRRitaM bhUmipAlairhi vasu mukhyaM tatastataH
shlokas.2:
na vinde dRRiDhamAtmAnaM dRRiShTvAhaM tadarerdhanam |
phalato bhUmito vApi pratipadyasva bhArata
shlokas.3:
aiDA.nshchailAnvArShada.nshA~njAtarUpapariShkRRitAn |
prAvArAjinamukhyA.nshcha kAmbojaH pradadau vasu
shlokas.4:
ashvA.nstittirikalmAShA.nstrishataM shukanAsikAn |
uShTravAmIstrishataM cha puShTAH pIlushamI~NgudaiH
shlokas.5:
govAsanA brAhmaNAshcha dAsamIyAshcha sarvashaH |
prItyarthaM te mahAbhAgA dharmarAj~no mahAtmanaH
trikharvaM balimAdAya dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.6:
kamaNDalUnupAdAya jAtarUpamayA~nshubhAn |
evaM baliM pradAyAtha praveshaM lebhire tataH
shlokas.7:
shataM dAsIsahasrANAM kArpAsikanivAsinAm |
shyAmAstanvyo dIrghakeshyo hemAbharaNabhUShitAH
shUdrA viprottamArhANi rA~NkavAnyajinAni cha
shlokas.8:
baliM cha kRRitsnamAdAya bharukachChanivAsinaH |
upaninyurmahArAja hayAngAndhAradeshajAn
shlokas.9:
indrakRRiShTairvartayanti dhAnyairnadImukhaishcha ye |
samudraniShkuTe jAtAH parisindhu cha mAnavAH
shlokas.10:
te vairAmAH pAradAshcha va~NgAshcha kitavaiH saha |
vividhaM balimAdAya ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.11:
ajAvikaM gohiraNyaM kharoShTraM phalajaM madhu |
kambalAnvividhA.nshchaiva dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.12:
prAgjyotiShAdhipaH shUro mlechChAnAmadhipo balI |
yanavaiH sahito rAjA bhagadatto mahArathaH
shlokas.13:
AjAneyAnhayA~nshIghrAnAdAyAnilaraMhasaH |
baliM cha kRRitsnamAdAya dvAri tiShThati vAritaH
shlokas.14:
ashmasAramayaM bhANDaM shuddhadantatsarUnasIn |
prAgjyotiSho.atha taddattvA bhagadatto.avrajattadA
shlokas.15:
dvyakShA.nstryakShA.NllalATAkShAnnAnAdigbhyaH samAgatAn |
auShNIShAnanivAsA.nshcha bAhukAnpuruShAdakAn
shlokas.16:
ekapAdA.nshcha tatrAhamapashyaM dvAri vAritAn |
balyarthaM dadatastasmai hiraNyaM rajataM bahu
shlokas.17:
indragopakavarNAbhA~nshukavarNAnmanojavAn |
tathaivendrAyudhanibhAnsandhyAbhrasadRRishAnapi
shlokas.18:
anekavarNAnAraNyAngRRihItvAshvAnmanojavAn |
jAtarUpamanarghyaM cha dadustasyaikapAdakAH
shlokas.19:
chInAnhUNA~nshakAnoDrAnparvatAntaravAsinaH |
vArShNeyAnhArahUNA.nshcha kRRiShNAnhaimavatA.nstathA
shlokas.20:
na pArayAmyabhigatAnvividhAndvAri vAritAn |
balyarthaM dadatastasya nAnArUpAnanekashaH
shlokas.21:
kRRiShNagrIvAnmahAkAyAnrAsabhA~nshatapAtinaH |
AhArShurdashasAhasrAnvinItAndikShu vishrutAn
shlokas.22:
pramANarAgasparshADhyaM bAhlIchInasamudbhavam |
aurNaM cha rA~NkavaM chaiva kITajaM paTTajaM tathA
shlokas.23:
kuTTIkRRitaM tathaivAnyatkamalAbhaM sahasrashaH |
shlakShNaM vastramakArpAsamAvikaM mRRidu chAjinam
shlokas.24:
nishitA.nshchaiva dIrghAsInRRiShTishaktiparashvadhAn |
aparAntasamudbhUtA.nstathaiva parashU~nshitAn
shlokas.25:
rasAngandhA.nshcha vividhAnratnAni cha sahasrashaH |
baliM cha kRRitsnamAdAya dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.26:
shakAstukhArAH ka~NkAshcha romashAH shRRi~NgiNo narAH |
mahAgamAndUragamAngaNitAnarbudaM hayAn
shlokas.27:
koTishashchaiva bahushaH suvarNaM padmasaMmitam |
balimAdAya vividhaM dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.28:
AsanAni mahArhANi yAnAni shayanAni cha |
maNikA~nchanachitrANi gajadantamayAni cha
shlokas.29:
rathA.nshcha vividhAkArA~njAtarUpapariShkRRitAn |
hayairvinItaiH sampannAnvaiyAghraparivAraNAn
shlokas.30:
vichitrA.nshcha paristomAnratnAni cha sahasrashaH |
nArAchAnardhanArAchA~nshastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.31:
etaddattvA mahaddravyaM pUrvadeshAdhipo nRRipaH |
praviShTo yaj~nasadanaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
dAyaM tu tasmai vividhaM shRRiNu me gadato.anagha |
yaj~nArthaM rAjabhirdattaM mahAntaM dhanasa~nchayam
shlokas.2:
merumandarayormadhye shailodAmabhito nadIm |
ye te kIchakaveNUnAM ChAyAM ramyAmupAsate
shlokas.3:
khashA ekAshanAjyohAH pradarA dIrghaveNavaH |
pashupAshcha kuNindAshcha ta~NgaNAH parata~NgaNAH
shlokas.4:
te vai pipIlikaM nAma varadattaM pipIlikaiH |
jAtarUpaM droNameyamahArShuH pu~njasho nRRipAH
shlokas.5:
kRRiShNA.NllalAmA.nshchamarA~nshuklA.nshchAnyA~nshashiprabhAn |
himavatpuShpajaM chaiva svAdu kShaudraM tathA bahu
shlokas.6:
uttarebhyaH kurubhyashchApyapoDhaM mAlyamambubhiH |
uttarAdapi kailAsAdoShadhIH sumahAbalAH
shlokas.7:
pArvatIyA baliM chAnyamAhRRitya praNatAH sthitAH |
ajAtashatrornRRipaterdvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.8:
ye parArdhe himavataH sUryodayagirau nRRipAH |
vAriSheNasamudrAnte lohityamabhitashcha ye
phalamUlAshanA ye cha kirAtAshcharmavAsasaH
shlokas.9:
chandanAgurukAShThAnAM bhArAnkAlIyakasya cha |
charmaratnasuvarNAnAM gandhAnAM chaiva rAshayaH
shlokas.10:
kairAtikAnAmayutaM dAsInAM cha vishAM pate |
AhRRitya ramaNIyArthAndUrajAnmRRigapakShiNaH
shlokas.11:
nichitaM parvatebhyashcha hiraNyaM bhUrivarchasam |
baliM cha kRRitsnamAdAya dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.12:
kAyavyA daradA dArvAH shUrA vaiyamakAstathA |
audumbarA durvibhAgAH pAradA bAhlikaiH saha
shlokas.13:
kAshmIrAH kundamAnAshcha paurakA ha.nsakAyanAH |
shibitrigartayaudheyA rAjanyA madrakekayAH
shlokas.14:
ambaShThAH kaukurAstArkShyA vastrapAH pahlavaiH saha |
vasAtayaH samauleyAH saha kShudrakamAlavaiH
shlokas.15:
shauNDikAH kukkurAshchaiva shakAshchaiva vishAM pate |
a~NgA va~NgAshcha puNDrAshcha shAnavatyA gayAstathA
shlokas.16:
sujAtayaH shreNimantaH shreyA.nsaH shastrapANayaH |
AhArShuH kShatriyA vittaM shatasho.ajAtashatrave
shlokas.17:
va~NgAH kali~NgapatayastAmraliptAH sapuNDrakAH |
dukUlaM kaushikaM chaiva patrorNaM prAvarAnapi
shlokas.18:
tatra sma dvArapAlaiste prochyante rAjashAsanAt |
kRRitakArAH subalayastato dvAramavApsyatha
shlokas.19:
IShAdantAnhemakakShAnpadmavarNAnkuthAvRRitAn |
shailAbhAnnityamattA.nshcha abhitaH kAmyakaM saraH
shlokas.20:
dattvaikaiko dashashatAnku~njarAnkavachAvRRitAn |
kShamAvataH kulInA.nshcha dvAreNa prAvisha.nstataH
shlokas.21:
ete chAnye cha bahavo gaNA digbhyaH samAgatAH |
anyaishchopAhRRitAnyatra ratnAnIha mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.22:
rAjA chitraratho nAma gandharvo vAsavAnugaH |
shatAni chatvAryadadaddhayAnAM vAtaraMhasAm
shlokas.23:
tumburustu pramudito gandharvo vAjinAM shatam |
AmrapatrasavarNAnAmadadaddhemamAlinAm
shlokas.24:
kRRitI tu rAjA kauravya shUkarANAM vishAM pate |
adadadgajaratnAnAM shatAni subahUnyapi
shlokas.25:
virATena tu matsyena balyarthaM hemamAlinAm |
ku~njarANAM sahasre dve mattAnAM samupAhRRite
shlokas.26:
pA.nshurAShTrAdvasudAno rAjA ShaDvi.nshatiM gajAn |
ashvAnAM cha sahasre dve rAjankA~nchanamAlinAm
shlokas.27:
javasattvopapannAnAM vayaHsthAnAM narAdhipa |
baliM cha kRRitsnamAdAya pANDavebhyo nyavedayat
shlokas.28:
yaj~nasenena dAsInAM sahasrANi chaturdasha |
dAsAnAmayutaM chaiva sadArANAM vishAM pate
shlokas.29:
gajayuktA mahArAja rathAH ShaDvi.nshatistathA |
rAjyaM cha kRRitsnaM pArthebhyo yaj~nArthaM vai niveditam
shlokas.30:
samudrasAraM vaiDUryaM muktAH sha~NkhA.nstathaiva cha |
shatashashcha kuthA.nstatra siMhalAH samupAharan
shlokas.31:
sa.nvRRitA maNichIraistu shyAmAstAmrAntalochanAH |
tAngRRihItvA narAstatra dvAri tiShThanti vAritAH
shlokas.32:
prItyarthaM brAhmaNAshchaiva kShatriyAshcha vinirjitAH |
upAjahrurvishashchaiva shUdrAH shushrUShavo.api cha
prItyA cha bahumAnAchcha abhyagachChanyudhiShThiram
shlokas.33:
sarve mlechChAH sarvavarNA AdimadhyAntajAstathA |
nAnAdeshasamutthaishcha nAnAjAtibhirAgataiH
paryasta iva loko.ayaM yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.34:
uchchAvachAnupagrAhAnrAjabhiH prahitAnbahUn |
shatrUNAM pashyato duHkhAnmumUrShA me.adya jAyate
shlokas.35:
bhRRityAstu ye pANDavAnAM tA.nste vakShyAmi bhArata |
yeShAmAmaM cha pakvaM cha sa.nvidhatte yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.36:
ayutaM trINi padmAni gajArohAH sasAdinaH |
rathAnAmarbudaM chApi pAdAtA bahavastathA
shlokas.37:
pramIyamANamArabdhaM pachyamAnaM tathaiva cha |
visRRijyamAnaM chAnyatra puNyAhasvana eva cha
shlokas.38:
nAbhuktavantaM nAhRRiShTaM nAsubhikShaM katha~nchana |
apashyaM sarvavarNAnAM yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.39:
aShTAshItisahasrANi snAtakA gRRihamedhinaH |
tri.nshaddAsIka ekaiko yAnbibharti yudhiShThiraH
suprItAH parituShTAshcha te.apyAsha.nsantyarikShayam
shlokas.40:
dashAnyAni sahasrANi yatInAmUrdhvaretasAm |
bhu~njate rukmapAtrIShu yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.41:
bhuktAbhuktaM kRRitAkRRitaM sarvamAkubjavAmanam |
abhu~njAnA yAj~nasenI pratyavaikShadvishAM pate
shlokas.42:
dvau karaM na prayachChetAM kuntIputrAya bhArata |
vaivAhikena pA~nchAlAH sakhyenAndhakavRRiShNayaH

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
AryAstu ye vai rAjAnaH satyasandhA mahAvratAH |
paryAptavidyA vaktAro vedAntAvabhRRithAplutAH
shlokas.2:
dhRRitimanto hrIniShedhA dharmAtmAno yashasvinaH |
mUrdhAbhiShiktAste chainaM rAjAnaH paryupAsate
shlokas.3:
dakShiNArthaM samAnItA rAjabhiH kA.nsyadohanAH |
AraNyA bahusAhasrA apashyaM tatra tatra gAH
shlokas.4:
Ajahrustatra satkRRitya svayamudyamya bhArata |
abhiShekArthamavyagrA bhANDamuchchAvachaM nRRipAH
shlokas.5:
bAhlIko rathamAhArShIjjAmbUnadapariShkRRitam |
sudakShiNastaM yuyuje shvetaiH kAmbojajairhayaiH
shlokas.6:
sunItho.apratimaM tasya anukarShaM mahAyashAH |
dhvajaM chedipatiH kShipramahArShItsvayamudyatam
shlokas.7:
dAkShiNAtyaH saMnahanaM sraguShNIShe cha mAgadhaH |
vasudAno maheShvAso gajendraM ShaShTihAyanam
shlokas.8:
matsyastvakShAnavAbadhnAdekalavya upAnahau |
AvantyastvabhiShekArthamApo bahuvidhAstathA
shlokas.9:
chekitAna upAsa~NgaM dhanuH kAshya upAharat |
asiM rukmatsaruM shalyaH shaikyaM kA~nchanabhUShaNam
shlokas.10:
abhyaShi~nchattato dhaumyo vyAsashcha sumahAtapAH |
nAradaM vai puraskRRitya devalaM chAsitaM munim
shlokas.11:
prItimanta upAtiShThannabhiShekaM maharShayaH |
jAmadagnyena sahitAstathAnye vedapAragAH
shlokas.12:
abhijagmurmahAtmAnaM mantravadbhUridakShiNam |
mahendramiva devendraM divi saptarShayo yathA
shlokas.13:
adhArayachChatramasya sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
dhana~njayashcha vyajane bhImasenashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.14:
upAgRRihNAdyamindrAya purAkalpe prajApatiH |
tamasmai sha~NkhamAhArShIdvAruNaM kalashodadhiH
shlokas.15:
siktaM niShkasahasreNa sukRRitaM vishvakarmaNA |
tenAbhiShiktaH kRRiShNena tatra me kashmalo.abhavat
shlokas.16:
gachChanti pUrvAdaparaM samudraM chApi dakShiNam |
uttaraM tu na gachChanti vinA tAta patatribhiH
shlokas.17:
tatra sma dadhmuH shatashaH sha~NkhAnma~NgalyakAraNAt |
prANada.nste samAdhmAtAstatra romANi me.ahRRiShan
shlokas.18:
praNatA bhUmipAshchApi peturhInAH svatejasA |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH pANDavAshcha sAtyakiH keshavo.aShTamaH
shlokas.19:
sattvasthAH shauryasampannA anyonyapriyakAriNaH |
visa~nj~nAnbhUmipAndRRiShTvA mAM cha te prAhasa.nstadA
shlokas.20:
tataH prahRRiShTo bIbhatsuH prAdAddhemaviShANinAm |
shatAnyanaDuhAM pa~ncha dvijamukhyeShu bhArata
shlokas.21:
naivaM shambarahantAbhUdyauvanAshvo manurna cha |
na cha rAjA pRRithurvainyo na chApyAsIdbhagIrathaH
shlokas.22:
yathAtimAtraM kaunteyaH shriyA paramayA yutaH |
rAjasUyamavApyaivaM harishchandra iva prabhuH
shlokas.23:
etAM dRRiShTvA shriyaM pArthe harishchandre yathA vibho |
kathaM nu jIvitaM shreyo mama pashyasi bhArata
shlokas.24:
andheneva yugaM naddhaM viparyastaM narAdhipa |
kanIyA.nso vivardhante jyeShThA hIyanti bhArata
shlokas.25:
evaM dRRiShTvA nAbhivindAmi sharma; parIkShamANo.api kurupravIra |
tenAhamevaM kRRishatAM gatashcha; vivarNatAM chaiva sashokatAM cha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tvaM vai jyeShTho jyaiShThineyaH putra mA pANDavAndviShaH |
dveShTA hyasukhamAdatte yathaiva nidhanaM tathA
shlokas.2:
avyutpannaM samAnArthaM tulyamitraM yudhiShThiram |
adviShantaM kathaM dviShyAttvAdRRisho bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
tulyAbhijanavIryashcha kathaM bhrAtuH shriyaM nRRipa |
putra kAmayase mohAnmaivaM bhUH shAmya sAdhviha
shlokas.4:
atha yaj~navibhUtiM tAM kA~NkShase bharatarShabha |
RRitvijastava tanvantu saptatantuM mahAdhvaram
shlokas.5:
AhariShyanti rAjAnastavApi vipulaM dhanam |
prItyA cha bahumAnAchcha ratnAnyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.6:
anarthAcharitaM tAta parasvaspRRihaNaM bhRRisham |
svasantuShTaH svadharmastho yaH sa vai sukhamedhate
shlokas.7:
avyApAraH parArtheShu nityodyogaH svakarmasu |
udyamo rakShaNe sveShAmetadvaibhavalakShaNam
shlokas.8:
vipattiShvavyatho dakSho nityamutthAnavAnnaraH |
apramatto vinItAtmA nityaM bhadrANi pashyati
shlokas.9:
antarvedyAM dadadvittaM kAmAnanubhavanpriyAn |
krIDanstrIbhirnirAta~NkaH prashAmya bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
duryodhana uvAcha||
jAnanvai mohayasi mAM nAvi nauriva sa.nyatA |
svArthe kiM nAvadhAnaM te utAho dveShTi mAM bhavAn
shlokas.11:
na santIme dhArtarAShTrA yeShAM tvamanushAsitA |
bhaviShyamarthamAkhyAsi sadA tvaM kRRityamAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
parapraNeyo.agraNIrhi yashcha mArgAtpramuhyati |
panthAnamanugachCheyuH kathaM tasya padAnugAH
shlokas.13:
rAjanparigatapraj~no vRRiddhasevI jitendriyaH |
pratipannAnsvakAryeShu saMmohayasi no bhRRisham
shlokas.14:
lokavRRittAdrAjavRRittamanyadAha bRRihaspatiH |
tasmAdrAj~nA prayatnena svArthashchintyaH sadaiva hi
shlokas.15:
kShatriyasya mahArAja jaye vRRittiH samAhitA |
sa vai dharmo.astvadharmo vA svavRRittau bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
prakAlayeddishaH sarvAH pratodeneva sArathiH |
pratyamitrashriyaM dIptAM bubhUShurbharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
prachChanno vA prakAsho vA yo yogo ripubAndhanaH |
tadvai shastraM shastravidAM na shastraM ChedanaM smRRitam
shlokas.18:
asantoShaH shriyo mUlaM tasmAttaM kAmayAmyaham |
samuchChraye yo yatate sa rAjanparamo nayI
shlokas.19:
mamatvaM hi na kartavyamaishvarye vA dhane.api vA |
pUrvAvAptaM harantyanye rAjadharmaM hi taM viduH
shlokas.20:
adrohe samayaM kRRitvA chichCheda namucheH shiraH |
shakraH sA hi matA tasya ripau vRRittiH sanAtanI
shlokas.21:
dvAvetau grasate bhUmiH sarpo bilashayAniva |
rAjAnaM chAviroddhAraM brAhmaNaM chApravAsinam
shlokas.22:
nAsti vai jAtitaH shatruH puruShasya vishAM pate |
yena sAdhAraNI vRRittiH sa shatrurnetaro janaH
shlokas.23:
shatrupakShaM samRRidhyantaM yo mohAtsamupekShate |
vyAdhirApyAyita iva tasya mUlaM Chinatti saH
shlokas.24:
alpo.api hyariratyantaM vardhamAnaparAkramaH |
valmIko mUlaja iva grasate vRRikShamantikAt
shlokas.25:
AjamIDha riporlakShmIrmA te rochiShTa bhArata |
eSha bhAraH sattvavatAM nayaH shirasi dhiShThitaH
shlokas.26:
janmavRRiddhimivArthAnAM yo vRRiddhimabhikA~NkShate |
edhate j~nAtiShu sa vai sadyovRRiddhirhi vikramaH
shlokas.27:
nAprApya pANDavaishvaryaM sa.nshayo me bhaviShyati |
avApsye vA shriyaM tAM hi sheShye vA nihato yudhi
shlokas.28:
atAdRRishasya kiM me.adya jIvitena vishAM pate |
vardhante pANDavA nityaM vayaM tu sthiravRRiddhayaH

shlokas.1:
shakuniruvAcha||
yAM tvametAM shriyaM dRRiShTvA pANDuputre yudhiShThire |
tapyase tAM hariShyAmi dyUtenAhUyatAM paraH
shlokas.2:
agatvA sa.nshayamahamayuddhvA cha chamUmukhe |
akShAnkShipannakShataH sanvidvAnaviduSho jaye
shlokas.3:
glahAndhanUMShi me viddhi sharAnakShA.nshcha bhArata |
akShANAM hRRidayaM me jyAM rathaM viddhi mamAstaram
shlokas.4:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ayamutsahate rAja~nshriyamAhartumakShavit |
dyUtena pANDuputrebhyastattubhyaM tAta rochatAm
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sthito.asmi shAsane bhrAturvidurasya mahAtmanaH |
tena sa~Ngamya vetsyAmi kAryasyAsya vinishchayam
shlokas.6:
duryodhana uvAcha||
vihaniShyati te buddhiM viduro muktasa.nshayaH |
pANDavAnAM hite yukto na tathA mama kaurava
shlokas.7:
nArabhetparasAmarthyAtpuruShaH kAryamAtmanaH |
matisAmyaM dvayornAsti kAryeShu kurunandana
shlokas.8:
bhayaM pariharanmanda AtmAnaM paripAlayan |
varShAsu klinnakaTavattiShThannevAvasIdati
shlokas.9:
na vyAdhayo nApi yamaH shreyaHprAptiM pratIkShate |
yAvadeva bhavetkalpastAvachChreyaH samAcharet
shlokas.10:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sarvathA putra balibhirvigrahaM te na rochaye |
vairaM vikAraM sRRijati tadvai shastramanAyasam
shlokas.11:
anarthamarthaM manyase rAjaputra; sa~NgranthanaM kalahasyAtighoram |
tadvai pravRRittaM tu yathA kathaM chi;dvimokShayechchApyasisAyakA.nshcha
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
dyUte purANairvyavahAraH praNIta;statrAtyayo nAsti na samprahAraH |
tadrochatAM shakunervAkyamadya; sabhAM kShipraM tvamihAj~nApayasva
shlokas.13:
svargadvAraM dIvyatAM no vishiShTaM; tadvartinAM chApi tathaiva yuktam |
bhavedevaM hyAtmanA tulyameva; durodaraM pANDavaistvaM kuruShva
shlokas.14:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
vAkyaM na me rochate yattvayoktaM; yatte priyaM tatkriyatAM narendra |
pashchAttapsyase tadupAkramya vAkyaM; na hIdRRishaM bhAvi vacho hi dharmyam
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTaM hyetadvidureNaivameva; sarvaM pUrvaM buddhividyAnugena |
tadevaitadavashasyAbhyupaiti; mahadbhayaM kShatriyabIjaghAti
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA dhRRitarAShTro manIShI; daivaM matvA paramaM dustaraM cha |
shashAsochchaiH puruShAnputravAkye; sthito rAjA daivasaMmUDhachetAH
shlokas.17:
sahasrastambhAM hemavaiDUryachitrAM; shatadvArAM toraNasphATishRRi~NgAm |
sabhAmagryAM kroshamAtrAyatAM me; tadvistArAmAshu kurvantu yuktAH
shlokas.18:
shrutvA tasya tvaritA nirvisha~NkAH; prAj~nA dakShAstAM tathA chakrurAshu |
sarvadravyANyupajahruH sabhAyAM; sahasrashaH shilpinashchApi yuktAH
shlokas.19:
kAlenAlpenAtha niShThAM gatAM tAM; sabhAM ramyAM bahuratnAM vichitrAm |
chitrairhaimairAsanairabhyupetA;mAchakhyuste tasya rAj~naH pratItAH
shlokas.20:
tato vidvAnviduraM mantrimukhya;muvAchedaM dhRRitarAShTro narendraH |
yudhiShThiraM rAjaputraM hi gatvA; madvAkyena kShipramihAnayasva
shlokas.21:
sabheyaM me bahuratnA vichitrA; shayyAsanairupapannA mahArhaiH |
sA dRRishyatAM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhametya; suhRRiddyUtaM vartatAmatra cheti
shlokas.22:
matamAj~nAya putrasya dhRRitarAShTro narAdhipaH |
matvA cha dustaraM daivametadrAjA chakAra ha
shlokas.23:
anyAyena tathoktastu viduro viduShAM varaH |
nAbhyanandadvacho bhrAturvachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.24:
nAbhinandAmi nRRipate praiShametaM; maivaM kRRithAH kulanAshAdbibhemi |
putrairbhinnaiH kalahaste dhruvaM syA;detachCha~Nke dyUtakRRite narendra
shlokas.25:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
neha kShattaH kalahastapsyate mAM; na cheddaivaM pratilomaM bhaviShyat |
dhAtrA tu diShTasya vashe kiledaM; sarvaM jagachcheShTati na svatantram
shlokas.26:
tadadya vidura prApya rAjAnaM mama shAsanAt |
kShipramAnaya durdharShaM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prAyAdviduro.ashvairudArai;rmahAjavairbalibhiH sAdhudAntaiH |
balAnniyukto dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA; manIShiNAM pANDavAnAM sakAsham
shlokas.2:
so.abhipatya tadadhvAnamAsAdya nRRipateH puram |
pravivesha mahAbuddhiH pUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.3:
sa rAjagRRihamAsAdya kuberabhavanopamam |
abhyagachChata dharmAtmA dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.4:
taM vai rAjA satyadhRRitirmahAtmA; ajAtashatrurviduraM yathAvat |
pUjApUrvaM pratigRRihyAjamIDha;stato.apRRichChaddhRRitarAShTraM saputram
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vij~nAyate te manaso na praharShaH; kachchitkShattaH kushalenAgato.asi |
kachchitputrAH sthavirasyAnulomA; vashAnugAshchApi visho.api kachchit
shlokas.6:
vidura uvAcha||
rAjA mahAtmA kushalI saputra; Aste vRRito j~nAtibhirindrakalpaiH |
prIto rAjanputragaNairvinItai;rvishoka evAtmaratirdRRiDhAtmA
shlokas.7:
idaM tu tvAM kururAjo.abhyuvAcha; pUrvaM pRRiShTvA kushalaM chAvyayaM cha |
iyaM sabhA tvatsabhAtulyarUpA; bhrAtR^INAM te pashya tAmetya putra
shlokas.8:
samAgamya bhrAtRRibhiH pArtha tasyAM; suhRRiddyUtaM kriyatAM ramyatAM cha |
prIyAmahe bhavataH sa~Ngamena; samAgatAH kuravashchaiva sarve
shlokas.9:
durodarA vihitA ye tu tatra; mahAtmanA dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA |
tAndrakShyase kitavAnsaMniviShTA;nityAgato.ahaM nRRipate tajjuShasva
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dyUte kShattaH kalaho vidyate naH; ko vai dyUtaM rochayedbudhyamAnaH |
kiM vA bhavAnmanyate yuktarUpaM; bhavadvAkye sarva eva sthitAH sma
shlokas.11:
vidura uvAcha||
jAnAmyahaM dyUtamanarthamUlaM; kRRitashcha yatno.asya mayA nivAraNe |
rAjA tu mAM prAhiNottvatsakAshaM; shrutvA vidva~nshreya ihAcharasva
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke tatrAnye kitavA dIvyamAnA; vinA rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya putraiH |
pRRichChAmi tvAM vidura brUhi nastA;nyairdIvyAmaH shatashaH saMnipatya
shlokas.13:
vidura uvAcha||
gAndhArarAjaH shakunirvishAM pate; rAjAtidevI kRRitahasto matAkShaH |
vivi.nshatishchitrasenashcha rAjA; satyavrataH purumitro jayashcha
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mahAbhayAH kitavAH saMniviShTA; mAyopadhA devitAro.atra santi |
dhAtrA tu diShTasya vashe kiledaM; nAdevanaM kitavairadya tairme
shlokas.15:
nAhaM rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanA;nna gantumichChAmi kave durodaram |
iShTo hi putrasya pitA sadaiva; tadasmi kartA vidurAttha mAM yathA
shlokas.16:
na chAkAmaH shakuninA devitAhaM; na chenmAM dhRRiShNurAhvayitA sabhAyAm |
AhUto.ahaM na nivarte kadA chi;ttadAhitaM shAshvataM vai vrataM me
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA viduraM dharmarAjaH; prAyAtrikaM sarvamAj~nApya tUrNam |
prAyAchChvobhUte sagaNaH sAnuyAtraH; saha strIbhirdraupadImAdikRRitvA
shlokas.18:
daivaM praj~nAM tu muShNAti tejashchakShurivApatat |
dhAtushcha vashamanveti pAshairiva naraH sitaH
shlokas.19:
ityuktvA prayayau rAjA saha kShattrA yudhiShThiraH |
amRRiShyamANastatpArthaH samAhvAnamari.ndamaH
shlokas.20:
bAhlikena rathaM dattamAsthAya paravIrahA |
parichChanno yayau pArtho bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaH
shlokas.21:
rAjashriyA dIpyamAno yayau brahmapuraHsaraH |
dhRRitarAShTreNa chAhUtaH kAlasya samayena cha
shlokas.22:
sa hAstinapuraM gatvA dhRRitarAShTragRRihaM yayau |
samiyAya cha dharmAtmA dhRRitarAShTreNa pANDavaH
shlokas.23:
tathA droNena bhIShmeNa karNena cha kRRipeNa cha |
samiyAya yathAnyAyaM drauNinA cha vibhuH saha
shlokas.24:
sametya cha mahAbAhuH somadattena chaiva ha |
duryodhanena shalyena saubalena cha vIryavAn
shlokas.25:
ye chAnye tatra rAjAnaH pUrvameva samAgatAH |
jayadrathena cha tathA kurubhishchApi sarvashaH
shlokas.26:
tataH sarvairmahAbAhurbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH |
pravivesha gRRihaM rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH
shlokas.27:
dadarsha tatra gAndhArIM devIM patimanuvratAm |
snuShAbhiH sa.nvRRitAM shashvattArAbhiriva rohiNIm
shlokas.28:
abhivAdya sa gAndhArIM tayA cha pratinanditaH |
dadarsha pitaraM vRRiddhaM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram
shlokas.29:
rAj~nA mUrdhanyupAghrAtAste cha kauravanandanAH |
chatvAraH pANDavA rAjanbhImasenapurogamAH
shlokas.30:
tato harShaH samabhavatkauravANAM vishAM pate |
tAndRRiShTvA puruShavyAghrAnpANDavAnpriyadarshanAn
shlokas.31:
vivishuste.abhyanuj~nAtA ratnavanti gRRihANyatha |
dadRRishushchopayAtAstAndraupadIpramukhAH striyaH
shlokas.32:
yAj~nasenyAH parAmRRiddhiM dRRiShTvA prajvalitAmiva |
snuShAstA dhRRitarAShTrasya nAtipramanaso.abhavan
shlokas.33:
tataste puruShavyAghrA gatvA strIbhistu sa.nvidam |
kRRitvA vyAyAmapUrvANi kRRityAni pratikarma cha
shlokas.34:
tataH kRRitAhnikAH sarve divyachandanarUShitAH |
kalyANamanasashchaiva brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha
shlokas.35:
manoj~namashanaM bhuktvA vivishuH sharaNAnyatha |
upagIyamAnA nArIbhirasvapankurunandanAH
shlokas.36:
jagAma teShAM sA rAtriH puNyA rativihAriNAm |
stUyamAnAshcha vishrAntAH kAle nidrAmathAtyajan
shlokas.37:
sukhoShitAstAM rajanIM prAtaH sarve kRRitAhnikAH |
sabhAM ramyAM pravivishuH kitavairabhisa.nvRRitAm

shlokas.1:
shakuniruvAcha||
upastIrNA sabhA rAjanrantuM chaite kRRitakShaNAH |
akShAnuptvA devanasya samayo.astu yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nikRRitirdevanaM pApaM na kShAtro.atra parAkramaH |
na cha nItirdhruvA rAjankiM tvaM dyUtaM prasha.nsasi
shlokas.3:
na hi mAnaM prasha.nsanti nikRRitau kitavasya ha |
shakune maiva no jaiShIramArgeNa nRRisha.nsavat
shlokas.4:
shakuniruvAcha||
yo.anveti sa~NkhyAM nikRRitau vidhij~na;shcheShTAsvakhinnaH kitavo.akShajAsu |
mahAmatiryashcha jAnAti dyUtaM; sa vai sarvaM sahate prakriyAsu
shlokas.5:
akShaglahaH so.abhibhavetparaM na;stenaiva kAlo bhavatIdamAttha |
dIvyAmahe pArthiva mA visha~NkAM; kuruShva pANaM cha chiraM cha mA kRRithAH
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evamAhAyamasito devalo munisattamaH |
imAni lokadvArANi yo vai sa~ncharate sadA
shlokas.7:
idaM vai devanaM pApaM mAyayA kitavaiH saha |
dharmeNa tu jayo yuddhe tatparaM sAdhu devanam
shlokas.8:
nAryA mlechChanti bhAShAbhirmAyayA na charantyuta |
ajihmamashaThaM yuddhametatsatpuruShavratam
shlokas.9:
shaktito brAhmaNAnvandyA~nshikShituM prayatAmahe |
tadvai vittaM mAtidevIrmA jaiShIH shakune param
shlokas.10:
nAhaM nikRRityA kAmaye sukhAnyuta dhanAni vA |
kitavasyApyanikRRitervRRittametanna pUjyate
shlokas.11:
shakuniruvAcha||
shrotriyo.ashrotriyamuta nikRRityaiva yudhiShThira |
vidvAnaviduSho.abhyeti nAhustAM nikRRitiM janAH
shlokas.12:
evaM tvaM mAmihAbhyetya nikRRitiM yadi manyase |
devanAdvinivartasva yadi te vidyate bhayam
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AhUto na nivarteyamiti me vratamAhitam |
vidhishcha balavAnrAjandiShTasyAsmi vashe sthitaH
shlokas.14:
asminsamAgame kena devanaM me bhaviShyati |
pratipANashcha ko.anyo.asti tato dyUtaM pravartatAm
shlokas.15:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ahaM dAtAsmi ratnAnAM dhanAnAM cha vishAM pate |
madarthe devitA chAyaM shakunirmAtulo mama
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anyenAnyasya viShamaM devanaM pratibhAti me |
etadvidvannupAdatsva kAmamevaM pravartatAm
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
upohyamAne dyUte tu rAjAnaH sarva eva te |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya vivishustAM sabhAM tataH
shlokas.18:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipashchaiva vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
nAtIvaprItamanasaste.anvavartanta bhArata
shlokas.19:
te dva.ndvashaH pRRithakchaiva siMhagrIvA mahaujasaH |
siMhAsanAni bhUrINi vichitrANi cha bhejire
shlokas.20:
shushubhe sA sabhA rAjanrAjabhistaiH samAgataiH |
devairiva mahAbhAgaiH samavetaistriviShTapam
shlokas.21:
sarve vedavidaH shUrAH sarve bhAsvaramUrtayaH |
prAvartata mahArAja suhRRiddyUtamanantaram
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM bahudhano rAjansAgarAvartasambhavaH |
maNirhArottaraH shrImAnkanakottamabhUShaNaH
shlokas.23:
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM pratipANastu kastava |
bhavatveSha kramastAta jayAmyenaM durodaram
shlokas.24:
duryodhana uvAcha||
santi me maNayashchaiva dhanAni vividhAni cha |
matsarashcha na me.artheShu jayAmyenaM durodaram
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato jagrAha shakunistAnakShAnakShatattvavit |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mattaH kaitavakenaiva yajjito.asmi durodaram |
shakune hanta dIvyAmo glahamAnAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.2:
ime niShkasahasrasya kuNDino bharitAH shatam |
kosho hiraNyamakShayyaM jAtarUpamanekashaH
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH shakuniH prAha jitamityeva taM nRRipam |
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM sahasrasamito vaiyAghraH supravartitaH |
suchakropaskaraH shrImAnki~NkiNIjAlamaNDitaH
shlokas.5:
saMhrAdano rAjaratho ya ihAsmAnupAvahat |
jaitro rathavaraH puNyo meghasAgaraniHsvanaH
shlokas.6:
aShTau yaM kurarachChAyAH sadashvA rAShTrasaMmatAH |
vahanti naiShAmuchyeta padA bhUmimupaspRRishan
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sahasrasa~NkhyA nAgA me mattAstiShThanti saubala |
hemakakShAH kRRitApIDAH padmino hemamAlinaH
shlokas.9:
sudAntA rAjavahanAH sarvashabdakShamA yudhi |
IShAdantA mahAkAyAH sarve chAShTakareNavaH
shlokas.10:
sarve cha purabhettAro nagameghanibhA gajAH |
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tameva.nvAdinaM pArthaM prahasanniva saubalaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shataM dAsIsahasrANi taruNyo me prabhadrikAH |
kambukeyUradhAriNyo niShkakaNThyaH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.13:
mahArhamAlyAbharaNAH suvastrAshchandanokShitAH |
maNInhema cha bibhratyaH sarvA vai sUkShmavAsasaH
shlokas.14:
anusevAM charantImAH kushalA nRRityasAmasu |
snAtakAnAmamAtyAnAM rAj~nAM cha mama shAsanAt
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
etAvantyeva dAsAnAM sahasrANyuta santi me |
pradakShiNAnulomAshcha prAvAravasanAH sadA
shlokas.17:
prAj~nA medhAvino dakShA yuvAno mRRiShTakuNDalAH |
pAtrIhastA divArAtramatithInbhojayantyuta
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rathAstAvanta eveme hemabhANDAH patAkinaH |
hayairvinItaiH sampannA rathibhishchitrayodhibhiH
shlokas.20:
ekaiko yatra labhate sahasraparamAM bhRRitim |
yudhyato.ayudhyato vApi vetanaM mAsakAlikam
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityevamukte pArthena kRRitavairo durAtmavAn |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ashvA.nstittirikalmAShAngAndharvAnhemamAlinaH |
dadau chitrarathastuShTo yA.nstAngANDIvadhanvane
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rathAnAM shakaTAnAM cha hayAnAM chAyutAni me |
yuktAnAmeva tiShThanti vAhairuchchAvachairvRRitAH
shlokas.25:
evaM varNasya varNasya samuchchIya sahasrashaH |
kShIraM pibantastiShThanti bhu~njAnAH shAlitaNDulAn
shlokas.26:
ShaShTistAni sahasrANi sarve pRRithulavakShasaH |
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tAmralohaiH parivRRitA nidhayo me chatuHshatAH |
pa~nchadrauNika ekaikaH suvarNasyAhatasya vai
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.29:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
mahArAja vijAnIhi yattvAM vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu |
mumUrShorauShadhamiva na rochetApi te shrutam
shlokas.2:
yadvai purA jAtamAtro rurAva; gomAyuvadvisvaraM pApachetAH |
duryodhano bhAratAnAM kulaghnaH; so.ayaM yukto bhavitA kAlahetuH
shlokas.3:
gRRihe vasantaM gomAyuM tvaM vai matvA na budhyase |
duryodhanasya rUpeNa shRRiNu kAvyAM giraM mama
shlokas.4:
madhu vai mAdhviko labdhvA prapAtaM nAvabudhyate |
Aruhya taM majjati vA patanaM vAdhigachChati
shlokas.5:
so.ayaM matto.akShadevena madhuvanna parIkShate |
prapAtaM budhyate naiva vairaM kRRitvA mahArathaiH
shlokas.6:
viditaM te mahArAja rAjasvevAsama~njasam |
andhakA yAdavA bhojAH sametAH ka.nsamatyajan
shlokas.7:
niyogAchcha hate tasminkRRiShNenAmitraghAtinA |
evaM te j~nAtayaH sarve modamAnAH shataM samAH
shlokas.8:
tvanniyuktaH savyasAchI nigRRihNAtu suyodhanam |
nigrahAdasya pApasya modantAM kuravaH sukham
shlokas.9:
kAkenemA.nshchitrabarhA~nshArdUlAnkroShTukena cha |
krINIShva pANDavAnrAjanmA majjIH shokasAgare
shlokas.10:
tyajetkulArthe puruShaM grAmasyArthe kulaM tyajet |
grAmaM janapadasyArthe AtmArthe pRRithivIM tyajet
shlokas.11:
sarvaj~naH sarvabhAvaj~naH sarvashatrubhaya~NkaraH |
iti sma bhAShate kAvyo jambhatyAge mahAsurAn
shlokas.12:
hiraNyaShThIvinaH kashchitpakShiNo vanagocharAn |
gRRihe kila kRRitAvAsA.NllobhAdrAjannapIDayat
shlokas.13:
sadopabhojyA.NllobhAndho hiraNyArthe parantapa |
AyatiM cha tadAtvaM cha ubhe sadyo vyanAshayat
shlokas.14:
tadAtvakAmaH pANDU.nstvaM mA druho bharatarShabha |
mohAtmA tapyase pashchAtpakShihA puruSho yathA
shlokas.15:
jAtaM jAtaM pANDavebhyaH puShpamAdatsva bhArata |
mAlAkAra ivArAme snehaM kurvanpunaH punaH
shlokas.16:
vRRikShAna~NgArakArIva mainAndhAkShIH samUlakAn |
mA gamaH sasutAmAtyaH sabalashcha parAbhavam
shlokas.17:
samavetAnhi kaH pArthAnpratiyudhyeta bhArata |
marudbhiH sahito rAjannapi sAkShAnmarutpatiH

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
dyUtaM mUlaM kalahasyAnupAti; mithobhedAya mahate vA raNAya |
yadAsthito.ayaM dhRRitarAShTrasya putro; duryodhanaH sRRijate vairamugram
shlokas.2:
prAtipIyAH shAntanavA bhaimasenAH sabAhlikAH |
duryodhanAparAdhena kRRichChraM prApsyanti sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
duryodhano madenaiva kShemaM rAShTrAdapohati |
viShANaM gauriva madAtsvayamArujate balAt
shlokas.4:
yashchittamanveti parasya rAja;nvIraH kaviH svAmatipatya dRRiShTim |
nAvaM samudra iva bAlanetrA;mAruhya ghore vyasane nimajjet
shlokas.5:
duryodhano glahate pANDavena; priyAyase tvaM jayatIti tachcha |
atinarmAjjAyate samprahAro; yato vinAshaH samupaiti pu.nsAm
shlokas.6:
AkarShaste.avAkphalaH kupraNIto; hRRidi prauDho mantrapadaH samAdhiH |
yudhiShThireNa saphalaH sa.nstavo.astu; sAmnaH surikto.arimateH sudhanvA
shlokas.7:
prAtipIyAH shAntanavAshcha rAja;nkAvyAM vAchaM shRRiNuta mAtyagAdvaH |
vaishvAnaraM prajvalitaM sughora;mayuddhena prashamayatotpatantam
shlokas.8:
yadA manyuM pANDavo.ajAtashatru;rna sa.nyachChedakShamayAbhibhUtaH |
vRRikodaraH savyasAchI yamau cha; ko.atra dvIpaH syAttumule vastadAnIm
shlokas.9:
mahArAja prabhavastvaM dhanAnAM; purA dyUtAnmanasA yAvadichCheH |
bahu vittaM pANDavA.nshchejjayestvaM; kiM tena syAdvasu vindeha pArthAn
shlokas.10:
jAnImahe devitaM saubalasya; veda dyUte nikRRitiM pArvatIyaH |
yataH prAptaH shakunistatra yAtu; mAyAyodhI bhArata pArvatIyaH

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
pareShAmeva yashasA shlAghase tvaM; sadA ChannaH kutsayandhArtarAShTrAn |
jAnImastvAM vidura yatpriyastvaM; bAlAnivAsmAnavamanyase tvam
shlokas.2:
suvij~neyaH puruSho.anyatrakAmo; nindAprasha.nse hi tathA yunakti |
jihvA manaste hRRidayaM nirvyanakti; jyAyo nirAha manasaH prAtikUlyam
shlokas.3:
utsa~Ngena vyAla ivAhRRito.asi; mArjAravatpoShakaM chopaha.nsi |
bhartRRighnatvAnna hi pApIya Ahu;stasmAtkShattaH kiM na bibheShi pApAt
shlokas.4:
jitvA shatrUnphalamAptaM mahanno; mAsmAnkShattaH paruShANIha vochaH |
dviShadbhistvaM samprayogAbhinandI; muhurdveShaM yAsi naH sampramohAt
shlokas.5:
amitratAM yAti naro.akShamaM bruva;nnigUhate guhyamamitrasa.nstave |
tadAshritApatrapA kiM na bAdhate; yadichChasi tvaM tadihAdya bhAShase
shlokas.6:
mA no.avama.nsthA vidma manastavedaM; shikShasva buddhiM sthavirANAM sakAshAt |
yasho rakShasva vidura sampraNItaM; mA vyApRRitaH parakAryeShu bhUstvam
shlokas.7:
ahaM karteti vidura mAvama.nsthA; mA no nityaM paruShANIha vochaH |
na tvAM pRRichChAmi vidura yaddhitaM me; svasti kShattarmA titikShUnkShiNu tvam
shlokas.8:
ekaH shAstA na dvitIyo.asti shAstA; garbhe shayAnaM puruShaM shAsti shAstA |
tenAnushiShTaH pravaNAdivAmbho; yathA niyukto.asmi tathA vahAmi
shlokas.9:
bhinatti shirasA shailamahiM bhojayate cha yaH |
sa eva tasya kurute kAryANAmanushAsanam
shlokas.10:
yo balAdanushAstIha so.amitraM tena vindati |
mitratAmanuvRRittaM tu samupekSheta paNDitaH
shlokas.11:
pradIpya yaH pradIptAgniM prAktvarannAbhidhAvati |
bhasmApi na sa vindeta shiShTaM kvachana bhArata
shlokas.12:
na vAsayetpAravargyaM dviShantaM; visheShataH kShattarahitaM manuShyam |
sa yatrechChasi vidura tatra gachCha; susAntvitApi hyasatI strI jahAti
shlokas.13:
vidura uvAcha||
etAvatA ye puruShaM tyajanti; teShAM sakhyamantavadbrUhi rAjan |
rAj~nAM hi chittAni pariplutAni; sAntvaM dattvA musalairghAtayanti
shlokas.14:
abAlastvaM manyase rAjaputra; bAlo.ahamityeva sumandabuddhe |
yaH sauhRRide puruShaM sthApayitvA; pashchAdenaM dUShayate sa bAlaH
shlokas.15:
na shreyase nIyate mandabuddhiH; strI shrotriyasyeva gRRihe praduShTA |
dhruvaM na rochedbharatarShabhasya; patiH kumAryA iva ShaShTivarShaH
shlokas.16:
anupriyaM chedanukA~NkShase tvaM; sarveShu kAryeShu hitAhiteShu |
striyashcha rAja~njaDapa~NgukA.nshcha; pRRichCha tvaM vai tAdRRishA.nshchaiva mUDhAn
shlokas.17:
labhyaH khalu prAtipIya naro.anupriyavAgiha |
apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktA shrotA cha durlabhaH
shlokas.18:
yastu dharme parAshvasya hitvA bhartuH priyApriye |
apriyANyAha pathyAni tena rAjA sahAyavAn
shlokas.19:
avyAdhijaM kaTukaM tIkShNamuShNaM; yashomuShaM paruShaM pUtigandhi |
satAM peyaM yanna pibantyasanto; manyuM mahArAja piba prashAmya
shlokas.20:
vaichitravIryasya yasho dhanaM cha; vA~nChAmyahaM sahaputrasya shashvat |
yathA tathA vo.astu namashcha vo.astu; mamApi cha svasti dishantu viprAH
shlokas.21:
AshIviShAnnetraviShAnkopayenna tu paNDitaH |
evaM te.ahaM vadAmIdaM prayataH kurunandana

shlokas.1:
shakuniruvAcha||
bahu vittaM parAjaiShIH pANDavAnAM yudhiShThira |
AchakShva vittaM kaunteya yadi te.astyaparAjitam
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mama vittamasa~NkhyeyaM yadahaM veda saubala |
atha tvaM shakune kasmAdvittaM samanupRRichChasi
shlokas.3:
ayutaM prayutaM chaiva kharvaM padmaM tathArbudam |
sha~NkhaM chaiva nikharvaM cha samudraM chAtra paNyatAm
etanmama dhanaM rAja.nstena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gavAshvaM bahudhenUkamasa~NkhyeyamajAvikam |
yatki~nchidanuvarNAnAM prAksindhorapi saubala
etanmama dhanaM rAja.nstena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
puraM janapado bhUmirabrAhmaNadhanaiH saha |
abrAhmaNAshcha puruShA rAja~nshiShTaM dhanaM mama
etadrAjandhanaM mahyaM tena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rAjaputrA ime rAja~nshobhante yena bhUShitAH |
kuNDalAni cha niShkAshcha sarvaM chA~NgavibhUShaNam
etanmama dhanaM rAja.nstena dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shyAmo yuvA lohitAkShaH siMhaskandho mahAbhujaH |
nakulo glaha eko me yachchaitatsvagataM dhanam
shlokas.12:
shakuniruvAcha||
priyaste nakulo rAjanrAjaputro yudhiShThira |
asmAkaM dhanatAM prApto bhUyastvaM kena dIvyasi
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu shakunistAnakShAnpratyapadyata |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM dharmAnsahadevo.anushAsti; loke hyasminpaNDitAkhyAM gatashcha |
anarhatA rAjaputreNa tena; tvayA dIvyAmyapriyavatpriyeNa
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.16:
shakuniruvAcha||
mAdrIputrau priyau rAja.nstavemau vijitau mayA |
garIyA.nsau tu te manye bhImasenadhana~njayau
shlokas.17:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
adharmaM charase nUnaM yo nAvekShasi vai nayam |
yo naH sumanasAM mUDha vibhedaM kartumichChasi
shlokas.18:
shakuniruvAcha||
garte mattaH prapatati pramattaH sthANumRRichChati |
jyeShTho rAjanvariShTho.asi namaste bharatarShabha
shlokas.19:
svapne na tAni pashyanti jAgrato vA yudhiShThira |
kitavA yAni dIvyantaH pralapantyutkaTA iva
shlokas.20:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yo naH sa~Nkhye nauriva pAranetA; jetA ripUNAM rAjaputrastarasvI |
anarhatA lokavIreNa tena; dIvyAmyahaM shakune phalgunena
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.22:
shakuniruvAcha||
ayaM mayA pANDavAnAM dhanurdharaH; parAjitaH pANDavaH savyasAchI |
bhImena rAjandayitena dIvya; yatkaitavyaM pANDava te.avashiShTam
shlokas.23:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yo no netA yo yudhAM naH praNetA; yathA vajrI dAnavashatrurekaH |
tiryakprekShI saMhatabhrUrmahAtmA; siMhaskandho yashcha sadAtyamarShI
shlokas.24:
balena tulyo yasya pumAnna vidyate; gadAbhRRitAmagrya ihArimardanaH |
anarhatA rAjaputreNa tena; dIvyAmyahaM bhImasenena rAjan
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.26:
shakuniruvAcha||
bahu vittaM parAjaiShIrbhrAtR^I.nshcha sahayadvipAn |
AchakShva vittaM kaunteya yadi te.astyaparAjitam
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ahaM vishiShTaH sarveShAM bhrAtR^INAM dayitastathA |
kuryAmaste jitAH karma svayamAtmanyupaplave
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vyavasito nikRRitiM samupAshritaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.29:
shakuniruvAcha||
etatpApiShThamakaroryadAtmAnaM parAjitaH |
shiShTe sati dhane rAjanpApa AtmaparAjayaH
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA matAkShastAnglahe sarvAnavasthitAn |
parAjayallokavIrAnAkShepeNa pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.31:
shakuniruvAcha||
asti vai te priyA devI glaha eko.aparAjitaH |
paNasva kRRiShNAM pA~nchAlIM tayAtmAnaM punarjaya
shlokas.32:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
naiva hrasvA na mahatI nAtikRRiShNA na rohiNI |
sarAgaraktanetrA cha tayA dIvyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.33:
shAradotpalapatrAkShyA shAradotpalagandhayA |
shAradotpalasevinyA rUpeNa shrIsamAnayA
shlokas.34:
tathaiva syAdAnRRisha.nsyAttathA syAdrUpasampadA |
tathA syAchChIlasampattyA yAmichChetpuruShaH striyam
shlokas.35:
charamaM sa.nvishati yA prathamaM pratibudhyate |
A gopAlAvipAlebhyaH sarvaM veda kRRitAkRRitam
shlokas.36:
AbhAti padmavadvaktraM sasvedaM mallikeva cha |
vedImadhyA dIrghakeshI tAmrAkShI nAtiromashA
shlokas.37:
tayaiva.nvidhayA rAjanpA~nchAlyAhaM sumadhyayA |
glahaM dIvyAmi chArva~NgyA draupadyA hanta saubala
shlokas.38:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukte tu vachane dharmarAjena bhArata |
dhigdhigityeva vRRiddhAnAM sabhyAnAM niHsRRitA giraH
shlokas.39:
chukShubhe sA sabhA rAjanrAj~nAM sa~njaj~nire kathAH |
bhIShmadroNakRRipAdInAM svedashcha samajAyata
shlokas.40:
shiro gRRihItvA viduro gatasattva ivAbhavat |
Aste dhyAyannadhovaktro niHshvasanpannago yathA
shlokas.41:
dhRRitarAShTrastu saMhRRiShTaH paryapRRichChatpunaH punaH |
kiM jitaM kiM jitamiti hyAkAraM nAbhyarakShata
shlokas.42:
jaharSha karNo.atibhRRishaM saha duHshAsanAdibhiH |
itareShAM tu sabhyAnAM netrebhyaH prApatajjalam

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ehi kShattardraupadImAnayasva; priyAM bhAryAM saMmatAM pANDavAnAm |
saMmArjatAM veshma paraitu shIghra;mAnando naH saha dAsIbhirastu
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
durvibhAvyaM bhavati tvAdRRishena; na manda sambudhyasi pAshabaddhaH |
prapAte tvaM lambamAno na vetsi; vyAghrAnmRRigaH kopayase.atibAlyAt
shlokas.3:
AshIviShAH shirasi te pUrNakoshA mahAviShAH |
mA kopiShThAH sumandAtmanmA gamastvaM yamakShayam
shlokas.4:
na hi dAsItvamApannA kRRiShNA bhavati bhArata |
anIshena hi rAj~naiShA paNe nyasteti me matiH
shlokas.5:
ayaM dhatte veNurivAtmaghAtI; phalaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTrasya putraH |
dyUtaM hi vairAya mahAbhayAya; pakvo na budhyatyayamantakAle
shlokas.6:
nAruntudaH syAnna nRRisha.nsavAdI; na hInataH paramabhyAdadIta |
yayAsya vAchA para udvijeta; na tAM vadedrushatIM pApalokyAm
shlokas.7:
samuchcharantyativAdA hi vaktrA;dyairAhataH shochati rAtryahAni |
parasya nAmarmasu te patanti; tAnpaNDito nAvasRRijetpareShu
shlokas.8:
ajo hi shastramakhanatkilaikaH; shastre vipanne padbhirapAsya bhUmim |
nikRRintanaM svasya kaNThasya ghoraM; tadvadvairaM mA khanIH pANDuputraiH
shlokas.9:
na ki~nchidIDyaM pravadanti pApaM; vanecharaM vA gRRihamedhinaM vA |
tapasvinaM samparipUrNavidyaM; bhaShanti haivaM shvanarAH sadaiva
shlokas.10:
dvAraM sughoraM narakasya jihmaM; na budhyase dhRRitarAShTrasya putra |
tvAmanvetAro bahavaH kurUNAM; dyUtodaye saha duHshAsanena
shlokas.11:
majjantyalAbUni shilAH plavante; muhyanti nAvo.ambhasi shashvadeva |
mUDho rAjA dhRRitarAShTrasya putro; na me vAchaH pathyarUpAH shRRiNoti
shlokas.12:
anto nUnaM bhavitAyaM kurUNAM; sudAruNaH sarvaharo vinAshaH |
vAchaH kAvyAH suhRRidAM pathyarUpA; na shrUyante vardhate lobha eva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhigastu kShattAramiti bruvANo; darpeNa matto dhRRitarAShTrasya putraH |
avaikShata prAtikAmIM sabhAyA;muvAcha chainaM paramAryamadhye
shlokas.2:
tvaM prAtikAmindraupadImAnayasva; na te bhayaM vidyate pANDavebhyaH |
kShattA hyayaM vivadatyeva bhIru;rna chAsmAkaM vRRiddhikAmaH sadaiva
shlokas.3:
evamuktaH prAtikAmI sa sUtaH; prAyAchChIghraM rAjavacho nishamya |
pravishya cha shveva sa siMhagoShThaM; samAsadanmahiShIM pANDavAnAm
shlokas.4:
prAtikAmyuvAcha||
yudhiShThire dyUtamadena matte; duryodhano draupadi tvAmajaiShIt |
sA prapadya tvaM dhRRitarAShTrasya veshma; nayAmi tvAM karmaNe yAj~naseni
shlokas.5:
draupadyuvAcha||
kathaM tvevaM vadasi prAtikAmi;nko vai dIvyedbhAryayA rAjaputraH |
mUDho rAjA dyUtamadena matta; Aho nAnyatkaitavamasya ki~nchit
shlokas.6:
prAtikAmyuvAcha||
yadA nAbhUtkaitavamanyadasya; tadAdevItpANDavo.ajAtashatruH |
nyastAH pUrvaM bhrAtarastena rAj~nA; svayaM chAtmA tvamatho rAjaputri
shlokas.7:
draupadyuvAcha||
gachCha tvaM kitavaM gatvA sabhAyAM pRRichCha sUtaja |
kiM nu pUrvaM parAjaiShIrAtmAnaM mAM nu bhArata
etajj~nAtvA tvamAgachCha tato mAM naya sUtaja
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sabhAM gatvA sa chovAcha draupadyAstadvachastadA |
kasyesho naH parAjaiShIriti tvAmAha draupadI
kiM nu pUrvaM parAjaiShIrAtmAnamatha vApi mAm
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThirastu nishcheShTo gatasattva ivAbhavat |
na taM sUtaM pratyuvAcha vachanaM sAdhvasAdhu vA
shlokas.10:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ihaitya kRRiShNA pA~nchAlI prashnametaM prabhAShatAm |
ihaiva sarve shRRiNvantu tasyA asya cha yadvachaH
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa gatvA rAjabhavanaM duryodhanavashAnugaH |
uvAcha draupadIM sUtaH prAtikAmI vyathanniva
shlokas.12:
sabhyAstvamI rAjaputryAhvayanti; manye prAptaH sa~NkShayaH kauravANAm |
na vai samRRiddhiM pAlayate laghIyA;nyattvaM sabhAmeShyasi rAjaputri
shlokas.13:
draupadyuvAcha||
evaM nUnaM vyadadhAtsa.nvidhAtA; sparshAvubhau spRRishato dhIrabAlau |
dharmaM tvekaM paramaM prAha loke; sa naH shamaM dhAsyati gopyamAnaH
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirastu tachChrutvA duryodhanachikIrShitam |
draupadyAH saMmataM dUtaM prAhiNodbharatarShabha
shlokas.15:
ekavastrA adhonIvI rodamAnA rajasvalA |
sabhAmAgamya pA~nchAlI shvashurasyAgrato.abhavat
shlokas.16:
tatasteShAM mukhamAlokya rAjA; duryodhanaH sUtamuvAcha hRRiShTaH |
ihaivaitAmAnaya prAtikAmi;npratyakShamasyAH kuravo bruvantu
shlokas.17:
tataH sUtastasya vashAnugAmI; bhItashcha kopAddrupadAtmajAyAH |
vihAya mAnaM punareva sabhyA;nuvAcha kRRiShNAM kimahaM bravImi
shlokas.18:
duryodhana uvAcha||
duHshAsanaiSha mama sUtaputro; vRRikodarAdudvijate.alpachetAH |
svayaM pragRRihyAnaya yAj~nasenIM; kiM te kariShyantyavashAH sapatnAH
shlokas.19:
tataH samutthAya sa rAjaputraH; shrutvA bhrAtuH kopaviraktadRRiShTiH |
pravishya tadveshma mahArathAnA;mityabravIddraupadIM rAjaputrIm
shlokas.20:
ehyehi pA~nchAli jitAsi kRRiShNe; duryodhanaM pashya vimuktalajjA |
kurUnbhajasvAyatapadmanetre; dharmeNa labdhAsi sabhAM paraihi
shlokas.21:
tataH samutthAya sudurmanAH sA; vivarNamAmRRijya mukhaM kareNa |
ArtA pradudrAva yataH striyastA; vRRiddhasya rAj~naH kurupu~Ngavasya
shlokas.22:
tato javenAbhisasAra roShA;dduHshAsanastAmabhigarjamAnaH |
dIrgheShu nIleShvatha chormimatsu; jagrAha kesheShu narendrapatnIm
shlokas.23:
ye rAjasUyAvabhRRithe jalena; mahAkratau mantrapUtena siktAH |
te pANDavAnAM paribhUya vIryaM; balAtpramRRiShTA dhRRitarAShTrajena
shlokas.24:
sa tAM parAmRRishya sabhAsamIpa;mAnIya kRRiShNAmatikRRiShNakeshIm |
duHshAsano nAthavatImanAthava;chchakarSha vAyuH kadalImivArtAm
shlokas.25:
sA kRRiShyamANA namitA~NgayaShTiH; shanairuvAchAdya rajasvalAsmi |
ekaM cha vAso mama mandabuddhe; sabhAM netuM nArhasi mAmanArya
shlokas.26:
tato.abravIttAM prasabhaM nigRRihya; kesheShu kRRiShNeShu tadA sa kRRiShNAm |
kRRiShNaM cha jiShNuM cha hariM naraM cha; trANAya vikrosha nayAmi hi tvAm
shlokas.27:
rajasvalA vA bhava yAj~naseni; ekAmbarA vApyatha vA vivastrA |
dyUte jitA chAsi kRRitAsi dAsI; dAsIShu kAmashcha yathopajoSham
shlokas.28:
prakIrNakeshI patitArdhavastrA; duHshAsanena vyavadhUyamAnA |
hrImatyamarSheNa cha dahyamAnA; shanairidaM vAkyamuvAcha kRRiShNA
shlokas.29:
ime sabhAyAmupadiShTashAstrAH; kriyAvantaH sarva evendrakalpAH |
gurusthAnA guravashchaiva sarve; teShAmagre notsahe sthAtumevam
shlokas.30:
nRRisha.nsakarma.nstvamanAryavRRitta; mA mAM vivastrAM kRRidhi mA vikArShIH |
na marShayeyustava rAjaputrAH; sendrApi devA yadi te sahAyAH
shlokas.31:
dharme sthito dharmasutashcha rAjA; dharmashcha sUkShmo nipuNopalabhyaH |
vAchApi bhartuH paramANumAtraM; nechChAmi doShaM svaguNAnvisRRijya
shlokas.32:
idaM tvanAryaM kuruvIramadhye; rajasvalAM yatparikarShase mAm |
na chApi kashchitkurute.atra pUjAM; dhruvaM tavedaM matamanvapadyan
shlokas.33:
dhigastu naShTaH khalu bhAratAnAM; dharmastathA kShatravidAM cha vRRittam |
yatrAbhyatItAM kurudharmavelAM; prekShanti sarve kuravaH sabhAyAm
shlokas.34:
droNasya bhIShmasya cha nAsti sattvaM; dhruvaM tathaivAsya mahAtmano.api |
rAj~nastathA hImamadharmamugraM; na lakShayante kuruvRRiddhamukhyAH
shlokas.35:
tathA bruvantI karuNaM sumadhyamA; kAkSheNa bhartR^InkupitAnapashyat |
sA pANDavAnkopaparItadehA;nsa.ndIpayAmAsa kaTAkShapAtaiH
shlokas.36:
hRRitena rAjyena tathA dhanena; ratnaishcha mukhyairna tathA babhUva |
yathArtayA kopasamIritena; kRRiShNAkaTAkSheNa babhUva duHkham
shlokas.37:
duHshAsanashchApi samIkShya kRRiShNA;mavekShamANAM kRRipaNAnpatI.nstAn |
AdhUya vegena visa~nj~nakalpA;muvAcha dAsIti hasannivograH
shlokas.38:
karNastu tadvAkyamatIva hRRiShTaH; sampUjayAmAsa hasansashabdam |
gAndhArarAjaH subalasya putra;stathaiva duHshAsanamabhyanandat
shlokas.39:
sabhyAstu ye tatra babhUvuranye; tAbhyAmRRite dhArtarAShTreNa chaiva |
teShAmabhUdduHkhamatIva kRRiShNAM; dRRiShTvA sabhAyAM parikRRiShyamANAm
shlokas.40:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na dharmasaukShmyAtsubhage vivaktuM; shaknomi te prashnamimaM yathAvat |
asvo hyashaktaH paNituM parasvaM; striyashcha bharturvashatAM samIkShya
shlokas.41:
tyajeta sarvAM pRRithivIM samRRiddhAM; yudhiShThiraH satyamatho na jahyAt |
uktaM jito.asmIti cha pANDavena; tasmAnna shaknomi vivektumetat
shlokas.42:
dyUte.advitIyaH shakunirnareShu; kuntIsutastena nisRRiShTakAmaH |
na manyate tAM nikRRitiM mahAtmA; tasmAnna te prashnamimaM bravImi
shlokas.43:
draupadyuvAcha||
AhUya rAjA kushalaiH sabhAyAM; duShTAtmabhirnaikRRitikairanAryaiH |
dyUtapriyairnAtikRRitaprayatnaH; kasmAdayaM nAma nisRRiShTakAmaH
shlokas.44:
sa shuddhabhAvo nikRRitipravRRitti;mabudhyamAnaH kurupANDavAgryaH |
sambhUya sarvaishcha jito.api yasmA;tpashchAchcha yatkaitavamabhyupetaH
shlokas.45:
tiShThanti cheme kuravaH sabhAyA;mIshAH sutAnAM cha tathA snuShANAm |
samIkShya sarve mama chApi vAkyaM; vibrUta me prashnamimaM yathAvat
shlokas.46:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA bruvantIM karuNaM rudantI;mavekShamANAmasakRRitpatI.nstAn |
duHshAsanaH paruShANyapriyANi; vAkyAnyuvAchAmadhurANi chaiva
shlokas.47:
tAM kRRiShyamANAM cha rajasvalAM cha; srastottarIyAmatadarhamANAm |
vRRikodaraH prekShya yudhiShThiraM cha; chakAra kopaM paramArtarUpaH

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
bhavanti deshe bandhakyaH kitavAnAM yudhiShThira |
na tAbhiruta dIvyanti dayA chaivAsti tAsvapi
shlokas.2:
kAshyo yadbalimAhArShIddravyaM yachchAnyaduttamam |
tathAnye pRRithivIpAlA yAni ratnAnyupAharan
shlokas.3:
vAhanAni dhanaM chaiva kavachAnyAyudhAni cha |
rAjyamAtmA vayaM chaiva kaitavena hRRitaM paraiH
shlokas.4:
na cha me tatra kopo.abhUtsarvasyesho hi no bhavAn |
idaM tvatikRRitaM manye draupadI yatra paNyate
shlokas.5:
eShA hyanarhatI bAlA pANDavAnprApya kauravaiH |
tvatkRRite klishyate kShudrairnRRisha.nsairnikRRitipriyaiH
shlokas.6:
asyAH kRRite manyurayaM tvayi rAjannipAtyate |
bAhU te sampradhakShyAmi sahadevAgnimAnaya
shlokas.7:
arjuna uvAcha||
na purA bhImasena tvamIdRRishIrvaditA giraH |
paraiste nAshitaM nUnaM nRRisha.nsairdharmagauravam
shlokas.8:
na sakAmAH pare kAryA dharmamevAcharottamam |
bhrAtaraM dhArmikaM jyeShThaM nAtikramitumarhati
shlokas.9:
AhUto hi parai rAjA kShAtradharmamanusmaran |
dIvyate parakAmena tannaH kIrtikaraM mahat
shlokas.10:
bhImasena uvAcha||
evamasmikRRitaM vidyAM yadyasyAhaM dhana~njaya |
dIpte.agnau sahitau bAhU nirdaheyaM balAdiva
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tAnduHkhitAndRRiShTvA pANDavAndhRRitarAShTrajaH |
klishyamAnAM cha pA~nchAlIM vikarNa idamabravIt
shlokas.12:
yAj~nasenyA yaduktaM tadvAkyaM vibrUta pArthivAH |
avivekena vAkyasya narakaH sadya eva naH
shlokas.13:
bhIShmashcha dhRRitarAShTrashcha kuruvRRiddhatamAvubhau |
sametya nAhatuH ki~nchidvidurashcha mahAmatiH
shlokas.14:
bhAradvAjo.api sarveShAmAchAryaH kRRipa eva cha |
ata etAvapi prashnaM nAhaturdvijasattamau
shlokas.15:
ye tvanye pRRithivIpAlAH sametAH sarvato dishaH |
kAmakrodhau samutsRRijya te bruvantu yathAmati
shlokas.16:
yadidaM draupadI vAkyamuktavatyasakRRichChubhA |
vimRRishya kasya kaH pakShaH pArthivA vadatottaram
shlokas.17:
evaM sa bahushaH sarvAnuktavA.nstAnsabhAsadaH |
na cha te pRRithivIpAlAstamUchuH sAdhvasAdhu vA
shlokas.18:
uktvA tathAsakRRitsarvAnvikarNaH pRRithivIpatIn |
pANiM pANau viniShpiShya niHshvasannidamabravIt
shlokas.19:
vibrUta pRRithivIpAlA vAkyaM mA vA katha~nchana |
manye nyAyyaM yadatrAhaM taddhi vakShyAmi kauravAH
shlokas.20:
chatvAryAhurnarashreShThA vyasanAni mahIkShitAm |
mRRigayAM pAnamakShA.nshcha grAmye chaivAtisaktatAm
shlokas.21:
eteShu hi naraH sakto dharmamutsRRijya vartate |
tathAyuktena cha kRRitAM kriyAM loko na manyate
shlokas.22:
tadayaM pANDuputreNa vyasane vartatA bhRRisham |
samAhUtena kitavairAsthito draupadIpaNaH
shlokas.23:
sAdhAraNI cha sarveShAM pANDavAnAmaninditA |
jitena pUrvaM chAnena pANDavena kRRitaH paNaH
shlokas.24:
iyaM cha kIrtitA kRRiShNA saubalena paNArthinA |
etatsarvaM vichAryAhaM manye na vijitAmimAm
shlokas.25:
etachChrutvA mahAnnAdaH sabhyAnAmudatiShThata |
vikarNaM sha.nsamAnAnAM saubalaM cha vinindatAm
shlokas.26:
tasminnuparate shabde rAdheyaH krodhamUrChitaH |
pragRRihya ruchiraM bAhumidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.27:
dRRishyante vai vikarNe hi vaikRRitAni bahUnyapi |
tajjastasya vinAshAya yathAgniraraNiprajaH
shlokas.28:
ete na ki~nchidapyAhushchodyamAnApi kRRiShNayA |
dharmeNa vijitAM manye manyante drupadAtmajAm
shlokas.29:
tvaM tu kevalabAlyena dhArtarAShTra vidIryase |
yadbravIShi sabhAmadhye bAlaH sthavirabhAShitam
shlokas.30:
na cha dharmaM yathAtattvaM vetsi duryodhanAvara |
yadbravIShi jitAM kRRiShNAmajiteti sumandadhIH
shlokas.31:
kathaM hyavijitAM kRRiShNAM manyase dhRRitarAShTraja |
yadA sabhAyAM sarvasvaM nyastavAnpANDavAgrajaH
shlokas.32:
abhyantarA cha sarvasve draupadI bharatarShabha |
evaM dharmajitAM kRRiShNAM manyase na jitAM katham
shlokas.33:
kIrtitA draupadI vAchA anuj~nAtA cha pANDavaiH |
bhavatyavijitA kena hetunaiShA matA tava
shlokas.34:
manyase vA sabhAmetAmAnItAmekavAsasam |
adharmeNeti tatrApi shRRiNu me vAkyamuttaram
shlokas.35:
eko bhartA striyA devairvihitaH kurunandana |
iyaM tvanekavashagA bandhakIti vinishchitA
shlokas.36:
asyAH sabhAmAnayanaM na chitramiti me matiH |
ekAmbaradharatvaM vApyatha vApi vivastratA
shlokas.37:
yachchaiShAM draviNaM ki~nchidyA chaiShA ye cha pANDavAH |
saubaleneha tatsarvaM dharmeNa vijitaM vasu
shlokas.38:
duHshAsana subAlo.ayaM vikarNaH prAj~navAdikaH |
pANDavAnAM cha vAsA.nsi draupadyAshchApyupAhara
shlokas.39:
tachChrutvA pANDavAH sarve svAni vAsA.nsi bhArata |
avakIryottarIyANi sabhAyAM samupAvishan
shlokas.40:
tato duHshAsano rAjandraupadyA vasanaM balAt |
sabhAmadhye samAkShipya vyapakraShTuM prachakrame
shlokas.41:
AkRRiShyamANe vasane draupadyAstu vishAM pate |
tadrUpamaparaM vastraM prAdurAsIdanekashaH
shlokas.42:
tato halahalAshabdastatrAsIdghoranisvanaH |
tadadbhutatamaM loke vIkShya sarvamahIkShitAm
shlokas.43:
shashApa tatra bhImastu rAjamadhye mahAsvanaH |
krodhAdvisphuramANoShTho viniShpiShya kare karam
shlokas.44:
idaM me vAkyamAdaddhvaM kShatriyA lokavAsinaH |
noktapUrvaM narairanyairna chAnyo yadvadiShyati
shlokas.45:
yadyetadevamuktvA tu na kuryAM pRRithivIshvarAH |
pitAmahAnAM sarveShAM nAhaM gatimavApnuyAm
shlokas.46:
asya pApasya durjAterbhAratApasadasya cha |
na pibeyaM balAdvakSho bhittvA chedrudhiraM yudhi
shlokas.47:
tasya te vachanaM shrutvA sarvalokapraharShaNam |
prachakrurbahulAM pUjAM kutsanto dhRRitarAShTrajam
shlokas.48:
yadA tu vAsasAM rAshiH sabhAmadhye samAchitaH |
tato duHshAsanaH shrAnto vrIDitaH samupAvishat
shlokas.49:
dhikShabdastu tatastatra samabhUllomaharShaNaH |
sabhyAnAM naradevAnAM dRRiShTvA kuntIsutA.nstadA
shlokas.50:
na vibruvanti kauravyAH prashnametamiti sma ha |
sa janaH kroshati smAtra dhRRitarAShTraM vigarhayan
shlokas.51:
tato bAhU samuchChritya nivArya cha sabhAsadaH |
viduraH sarvadharmaj~na idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.52:
vidura uvAcha||
draupadI prashnamuktvaivaM roravIti hyanAthavat |
na cha vibrUta taM prashnaM sabhyA dharmo.atra pIDyate
shlokas.53:
sabhAM prapadyate hyArtaH prajvalanniva havyavAT |
taM vai satyena dharmeNa sabhyAH prashamayantyuta
shlokas.54:
dharmaprashnamatho brUyAdArtaH sabhyeShu mAnavaH |
vibrUyustatra te prashnaM kAmakrodhavashAtigAH
shlokas.55:
vikarNena yathApraj~namuktaH prashno narAdhipAH |
bhavanto.api hi taM prashnaM vibruvantu yathAmati
shlokas.56:
yo hi prashnaM na vibrUyAddharmadarshI sabhAM gataH |
anRRite yA phalAvAptistasyAH so.ardhaM samashnute
shlokas.57:
yaH punarvitathaM brUyAddharmadarshI sabhAM gataH |
anRRitasya phalaM kRRitsnaM samprApnotIti nishchayaH
shlokas.58:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prahlAdasya cha sa.nvAdaM munerA~Ngirasasya cha
shlokas.59:
prahlAdo nAma daityendrastasya putro virochanaH |
kanyAhetorA~NgirasaM sudhanvAnamupAdravat
shlokas.60:
ahaM jyAyAnahaM jyAyAniti kanyepsayA tadA |
tayordevanamatrAsItprANayoriti naH shrutam
shlokas.61:
tayoH prashnavivAdo.abhUtprahlAdaM tAvapRRichChatAm |
jyAyAnka AvayorekaH prashnaM prabrUhi mA mRRiShA
shlokas.62:
sa vai vivadanAdbhItaH sudhanvAnaM vyalokayat |
taM sudhanvAbravItkruddho brahmadaNDa iva jvalan
shlokas.63:
yadi vai vakShyasi mRRiShA prahlAdAtha na vakShyasi |
shatadhA te shiro vajrI vajreNa prahariShyati
shlokas.64:
sudhanvanA tathoktaH sanvyathito.ashvatthaparNavat |
jagAma kashyapaM daityaH paripraShTuM mahaujasam
shlokas.65:
prahlAda uvAcha||
tvaM vai dharmasya vij~nAtA daivasyehAsurasya cha |
brAhmaNasya mahAprAj~na dharmakRRichChramidaM shRRiNu
shlokas.66:
yo vai prashnaM na vibrUyAdvitathaM vApi nirdishet |
ke vai tasya pare lokAstanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.67:
kashyapa uvAcha||
jAnanna vibruvanprashnaM kAmAtkrodhAttathA bhayAt |
sahasraM vAruNAnpAshAnAtmani pratimu~nchati
shlokas.68:
tasya sa.nvatsare pUrNe pAsha ekaH pramuchyate |
tasmAtsatyaM tu vaktavyaM jAnatA satyama~njasA
shlokas.69:
viddho dharmo hyadharmeNa sabhAM yatra prapadyate |
na chAsya shalyaM kRRintanti viddhAstatra sabhAsadaH
shlokas.70:
ardhaM harati vai shreShThaH pAdo bhavati kartRRiShu |
pAdashchaiva sabhAsatsu ye na nindanti ninditam
shlokas.71:
anenA bhavati shreShTho muchyante cha sabhAsadaH |
eno gachChati kartAraM nindArho yatra nindyate
shlokas.72:
vitathaM tu vadeyurye dharmaM prahlAda pRRichChate |
iShTApUrtaM cha te ghnanti sapta chaiva parAvarAn
shlokas.73:
hRRitasvasya hi yadduHkhaM hataputrasya chApi yat |
RRiNinaM prati yachchaiva rAj~nA grastasya chApi yat
shlokas.74:
striyAH patyA vihInAyAH sArthAdbhraShTasya chaiva yat |
adhyUDhAyAshcha yadduHkhaM sAkShibhirvihatasya cha
shlokas.75:
etAni vai samAnyAhurduHkhAni tridasheshvarAH |
tAni sarvANi duHkhAni prApnoti vitathaM bruvan
shlokas.76:
samakShadarshanAtsAkShyaM shravaNAchcheti dhAraNAt |
tasmAtsatyaM bruvansAkShI dharmArthAbhyAM na hIyate
shlokas.77:
vidura uvAcha||
kashyapasya vachaH shrutvA prahlAdaH putramabravIt |
shreyAnsudhanvA tvatto vai mattaH shreyA.nstathA~NgirAH
shlokas.78:
mAtA sudhanvanashchApi shreyasI mAtRRitastava |
virochana sudhanvAyaM prANAnAmIshvarastava
shlokas.79:
sudhanvovAcha||
putrasnehaM parityajya yastvaM dharme pratiShThitaH |
anujAnAmi te putraM jIvatveSha shataM samAH
shlokas.80:
vidura uvAcha||
evaM vai paramaM dharmaM shrutvA sarve sabhAsadaH |
yathAprashnaM tu kRRiShNAyA manyadhvaM tatra kiM param
shlokas.81:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidurasya vachaH shrutvA nochuH ki~nchana pArthivAH |
karNo duHshAsanaM tvAha kRRiShNAM dAsIM gRRihAnnaya
shlokas.82:
tAM vepamAnAM savrIDAM pralapantIM sma pANDavAn |
duHshAsanaH sabhAmadhye vichakarSha tapasvinIm

shlokas.1:
draupadyuvAcha||
purastAtkaraNIyaM me na kRRitaM kAryamuttaram |
vihvalAsmi kRRitAnena karShatA balinA balAt
shlokas.2:
abhivAdaM karomyeShAM gurUNAM kurusa.nsadi |
na me syAdaparAdho.ayaM yadidaM na kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tena cha samuddhUtA duHkhena cha tapasvinI |
patitA vilalApedaM sabhAyAmatathochitA
shlokas.4:
draupadyuvAcha||
svaya.nvare yAsmi nRRipairdRRiShTA ra~Nge samAgataiH |
na dRRiShTapUrvA chAnyatra sAhamadya sabhAM gatA
shlokas.5:
yAM na vAyurna chAdityo dRRiShTavantau purA gRRihe |
sAhamadya sabhAmadhye dRRishyAmi kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.6:
yAM na mRRiShyanti vAtena spRRishyamAnAM purA gRRihe |
spRRishyamAnAM sahante.adya pANDavAstAM durAtmanA
shlokas.7:
mRRiShyante kuravashcheme manye kAlasya paryayam |
snuShAM duhitaraM chaiva klishyamAnAmanarhatIm
shlokas.8:
kiM tvataH kRRipaNaM bhUyo yadahaM strI satI shubhA |
sabhAmadhyaM vigAhe.adya kva nu dharmo mahIkShitAm
shlokas.9:
dharmyAH striyaH sabhAM pUrvaM na nayantIti naH shrutam |
sa naShTaH kauraveyeShu pUrvo dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.10:
kathaM hi bhAryA pANDUnAM pArShatasya svasA satI |
vAsudevasya cha sakhI pArthivAnAM sabhAmiyAm
shlokas.11:
tAmimAM dharmarAjasya bhAryAM sadRRishavarNajAm |
brUta dAsImadAsIM vA tatkariShyAmi kauravAH
shlokas.12:
ayaM hi mAM dRRiDhaM kShudraH kauravANAM yashoharaH |
klishnAti nAhaM tatsoDhuM chiraM shakShyAmi kauravAH
shlokas.13:
jitAM vApyajitAM vApi manyadhvaM vA yathA nRRipAH |
tathA pratyuktamichChAmi tatkariShyAmi kauravAH
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
uktavAnasmi kalyANi dharmasya tu parAM gatim |
loke na shakyate gantumapi viprairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.15:
balavA.nstu yathA dharmaM loke pashyati pUruShaH |
sa dharmo dharmavelAyAM bhavatyabhihitaH paraiH
shlokas.16:
na vivektuM cha te prashnametaM shaknomi nishchayAt |
sUkShmatvAdgahanatvAchcha kAryasyAsya cha gauravAt
shlokas.17:
nUnamantaH kulasyAsya bhavitA nachirAdiva |
tathA hi kuravaH sarve lobhamohaparAyaNAH
shlokas.18:
kuleShu jAtAH kalyANi vyasanAbhyAhatA bhRRisham |
dharmyAnmArgAnna chyavante yathA nastvaM vadhUH sthitA
shlokas.19:
upapannaM cha pA~nchAli tavedaM vRRittamIdRRisham |
yatkRRichChramapi samprAptA dharmamevAnvavekShase
shlokas.20:
ete droNAdayashchaiva vRRiddhA dharmavido janAH |
shUnyaiH sharIraistiShThanti gatAsava ivAnatAH
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThirastu prashne.asminpramANamiti me matiH |
ajitAM vA jitAM vApi svayaM vyAhartumarhati
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tu dRRiShTvA bahu tattadevaM; rorUyamANAM kurarImivArtAm |
nochurvachaH sAdhvatha vApyasAdhu; mahIkShito dhArtarAShTrasya bhItAH
shlokas.23:
dRRiShTvA tu tAnpArthivaputrapautrAM;stUShNImbhUtAndhRRitarAShTrasya putraH |
smayannivedaM vachanaM babhAShe; pA~nchAlarAjasya sutAM tadAnIm
shlokas.24:
tiShThatvayaM prashna udArasattve; bhIme.arjune sahadeve tathaiva |
patyau cha te nakule yAj~naseni; vadantvete vachanaM tvatprasUtam
shlokas.25:
anIshvaraM vibruvantvAryamadhye; yudhiShThiraM tava pA~nchAli hetoH |
kurvantu sarve chAnRRitaM dharmarAjaM; pA~nchAli tvaM mokShyase dAsabhAvAt
shlokas.26:
dharme sthito dharmarAjo mahAtmA; svayaM chedaM kathayatvindrakalpaH |
Isho vA te yadyanIsho.atha vaiSha; vAkyAdasya kShipramekaM bhajasva
shlokas.27:
sarve hIme kauraveyAH sabhAyAM; duHkhAntare vartamAnAstavaiva |
na vibruvantyAryasattvA yathAva;tpatI.nshcha te samavekShyAlpabhAgyAn
shlokas.28:
tataH sabhyAH kururAjasya tatra; vAkyaM sarve prashasha.nsustadochchaiH |
chelAvedhA.nshchApi chakrurnadanto; hA hetyAsIdapi chaivAtra nAdaH
sarve chAsanpArthivAH prItimantaH; kurushreShThaM dhArmikaM pUjayantaH
shlokas.29:
yudhiShThiraM cha te sarve samudaikShanta pArthivAH |
kiM nu vakShyati dharmaj~na iti sAchIkRRitAnanAH
shlokas.30:
kiM nu vakShyati bIbhatsurajito yudhi pANDavaH |
bhImaseno yamau cheti bhRRishaM kautUhalAnvitAH
shlokas.31:
tasminnuparate shabde bhImaseno.abravIdidam |
pragRRihya vipulaM vRRittaM bhujaM chandanarUShitam
shlokas.32:
yadyeSha gururasmAkaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
na prabhuH syAtkulasyAsya na vayaM marShayemahi
shlokas.33:
Isho naH puNyatapasAM prANAnAmapi cheshvaraH |
manyate jitamAtmAnaM yadyeSha vijitA vayam
shlokas.34:
na hi muchyeta jIvanme padA bhUmimupaspRRishan |
martyadharmA parAmRRishya pA~nchAlyA mUrdhajAnimAn
shlokas.35:
pashyadhvamAyatau vRRittau bhujau me parighAviva |
naitayorantaraM prApya muchyetApi shatakratuH
shlokas.36:
dharmapAshasitastvevaM nAdhigachChAmi sa~NkaTam |
gauraveNa niruddhashcha nigrahAdarjunasya cha
shlokas.37:
dharmarAjanisRRiShTastu siMhaH kShudramRRigAniva |
dhArtarAShTrAnimAnpApAnniShpiSheyaM talAsibhiH
shlokas.38:
tamuvAcha tadA bhIShmo droNo vidura eva cha |
kShamyatAmevamityevaM sarvaM sambhavati tvayi

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
trayaH kileme adhanA bhavanti; dAsaH shiShyashchAsvatantrA cha nArI |
dAsasya patnI tvaM dhanamasya bhadre; hIneshvarA dAsadhanaM cha dAsI
shlokas.2:
pravishya sA naH parichArairbhajasva; tatte kAryaM shiShTamAveshya veshma |
IshAH sma sarve tava rAjaputri; bhavanti te dhArtarAShTrA na pArthAH
shlokas.3:
anyaM vRRiNIShva patimAshu bhAmini; yasmAddAsyaM na labhase devanena |
anavadyA vai patiShu kAmavRRitti;rnityaM dAsye viditaM vai tavAstu
shlokas.4:
parAjito nakulo bhImaseno; yudhiShThiraH sahadevo.arjunashcha |
dAsIbhUtA pravisha yAj~naseni; parAjitAste patayo na santi
shlokas.5:
prayojanaM chAtmani kiM nu manyate; parAkramaM pauruShaM cheha pArthaH |
pA~nchAlyasya drupadasyAtmajAmimAM; sabhAmadhye yo.atidevIdglaheShu
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tadvai shrutvA bhImaseno.atyamarShI; bhRRishaM nishashvAsa tadArtarUpaH |
rAjAnugo dharmapAshAnubaddho; dahannivainaM kopaviraktadRRiShTiH
shlokas.7:
bhIma uvAcha||
nAhaM kupye sUtaputrasya rAja;nneSha satyaM dAsadharmaH praviShTaH |
kiM vidviSho vAdya mAM dhArayeyu;rnAdevIstvaM yadyanayA narendra
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAdheyasya vachaH shrutvA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM tUShNImbhUtamachetasam
shlokas.9:
bhImArjunau yamau chaiva sthitau te nRRipa shAsane |
prashnaM prabrUhi kRRiShNAM tvamajitAM yadi manyase
shlokas.10:
evamuktvA sa kaunteyamapohya vasanaM svakam |
smayannivaikShatpA~nchAlImaishvaryamadamohitaH
shlokas.11:
kadalIdaNDasadRRishaM sarvalakShaNapUjitam |
gajahastapratIkAshaM vajrapratimagauravam
shlokas.12:
abhyutsmayitvA rAdheyaM bhImamAdharShayanniva |
draupadyAH prekShamANAyAH savyamUrumadarshayat
shlokas.13:
vRRikodarastadAlokya netre utphAlya lohite |
provAcha rAjamadhye taM sabhAM vishrAvayanniva
shlokas.14:
pitRRibhiH saha sAlokyaM mA sma gachChedvRRikodaraH |
yadyetamUruM gadayA na bhindyAM te mahAhave
shlokas.15:
kruddhasya tasya srotobhyaH sarvebhyaH pAvakArchiShaH |
vRRikShasyeva vinishcheruH koTarebhyaH pradahyataH
shlokas.16:
vidura uvAcha||
paraM bhayaM pashyata bhImasenA;dbudhyadhvaM rAj~no varuNasyeva pAshAt |
daiverito nUnamayaM purastA;tparo.anayo bharateShUdapAdi
shlokas.17:
atidyUtaM kRRitamidaM dhArtarAShTrA; ye.asyAM striyaM vivadadhvaM sabhAyAm |
