yogakShemo dRRishyate vo mahAbhayaH; pApAnmantrAnkuravo mantrayanti
shlokas.18:
imaM dharmaM kuravo jAnatAshu; durdRRiShTe.asminpariShatsampraduShyet |
imAM chetpUrvaM kitavo.aglahIShya;dIsho.abhaviShyadaparAjitAtmA
shlokas.19:
svapne yathaitaddhi dhanaM jitaM syA;ttadevaM manye yasya dIvyatyanIshaH |
gAndhAriputrasya vacho nishamya; dharmAdasmAtkuravo mApayAta
shlokas.20:
duryodhana uvAcha||
bhImasya vAkye tadvadevArjunasya; sthito.ahaM vai yamayoshchaivameva |
yudhiShThiraM chetpravadantyanIsha;matho dAsyAnmokShyase yAj~naseni
shlokas.21:
arjuna uvAcha||
Isho rAjA pUrvamAsIdglahe naH; kuntIputro dharmarAjo mahAtmA |
IshastvayaM kasya parAjitAtmA; tajjAnIdhvaM kuravaH sarva eva
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya gehe; gomAyuruchchairvyAharadagnihotre |
taM rAsabhAH pratyabhAShanta rAja;nsamantataH pakShiNashchaiva raudrAH
shlokas.23:
taM cha shabdaM vidurastattvavedI; shushrAva ghoraM subalAtmajA cha |
bhIShmadroNau gautamashchApi vidvA;nsvasti svastItyapi chaivAhuruchchaiH
shlokas.24:
tato gAndhArI vidurashchaiva vidvAM;stamutpAtaM ghoramAlakShya rAj~ne |
nivedayAmAsaturArtavattadA; tato rAjA vAkyamidaM babhAShe
shlokas.25:
hato.asi duryodhana mandabuddhe; yastvaM sabhAyAM kurupu~NgavAnAm |
striyaM samAbhAShasi durvinIta; visheShato draupadIM dharmapatnIm
shlokas.26:
evamuktvA dhRRitarAShTro manIShI; hitAnveShI bAndhavAnAmapAyAt |
kRRiShNAM pA~nchAlImabravItsAntvapUrvaM; vimRRishyaitatpraj~nayA tattvabuddhiH
shlokas.27:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
varaM vRRiNIShva pA~nchAli matto yadabhikA~NkShasi |
vadhUnAM hi vishiShTA me tvaM dharmaparamA satI
shlokas.28:
draupadyuvAcha||
dadAsi chedvaraM mahyaM vRRiNomi bharatarShabha |
sarvadharmAnugaH shrImAnadAso.astu yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.29:
manasvinamajAnanto mA vai brUyuH kumArakAH |
eSha vai dAsaputreti prativindhyaM tamAgatam
shlokas.30:
rAjaputraH purA bhUtvA yathA nAnyaH pumAnkvachit |
lAlito dAsaputratvaM pashyannashyeddhi bhArata
shlokas.31:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dvitIyaM te varaM bhadre dadAmi varayasva mAm |
mano hi me vitarati naikaM tvaM varamarhasi
shlokas.32:
draupadyuvAcha||
sarathau sadhanuShkau cha bhImasenadhana~njayau |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha dvitIyaM varaye varam
shlokas.33:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tRRitIyaM varayAsmatto nAsi dvAbhyAM susatkRRitA |
tvaM hi sarvasnuShANAM me shreyasI dharmachAriNI
shlokas.34:
draupadyuvAcha||
lobho dharmasya nAshAya bhagavannAhamutsahe |
anarhA varamAdAtuM tRRitIyaM rAjasattama
shlokas.35:
ekamAhurvaishyavaraM dvau tu kShatrastriyA varau |
trayastu rAj~no rAjendra brAhmaNasya shataM varAH
shlokas.36:
pApIyA.nsa ime bhUtvA santIrNAH patayo mama |
vetsyanti chaiva bhadrANi rAjanpuNyena karmaNA

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
yA naH shrutA manuShyeShu striyo rUpeNa saMmatAH |
tAsAmetAdRRishaM karma na kasyA~nchana shushrumaH
shlokas.2:
krodhAviShTeShu pArtheShu dhArtarAShTreShu chApyati |
draupadI pANDuputrANAM kRRiShNA shAntirihAbhavat
shlokas.3:
aplave.ambhasi magnAnAmapratiShThe nimajjatAm |
pA~nchAlI pANDuputrANAM naureShA pAragAbhavat
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tadvai shrutvA bhImasenaH kurumadhye.atyamarShaNaH |
strI gatiH pANDuputrANAmityuvAcha sudurmanAH
shlokas.5:
trINi jyotIMShi puruSha iti vai devalo.abravIt |
apatyaM karma vidyA cha yataH sRRiShTAH prajAstataH
shlokas.6:
amedhye vai gataprANe shUnye j~nAtibhirujjhite |
dehe tritayamevaitatpuruShasyopajAyate
shlokas.7:
tanno jyotirabhihataM dArANAmabhimarshanAt |
dhana~njaya kathaM svitsyAdapatyamabhimRRiShTajam
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
na chaivoktA na chAnuktA hInataH paruShA giraH |
bhAratAH pratijalpanti sadA tUttamapUruShAH
shlokas.9:
smaranti sukRRitAnyeva na vairANi kRRitAni cha |
santaH prativijAnanto labdhvA pratyayamAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
bhIma uvAcha||
ihaivaitA.nsturA sarvAnhanmi shatrUnsamAgatAn |
atha niShkramya rAjendra samUlAnkRRindhi bhArata
shlokas.11:
kiM no vivaditeneha kiM naH kleshena bhArata |
adyaivaitAnnihanmIha prashAdhi vasudhAmimAm
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA bhImasenastu kaniShThairbhrAtRRibhirvRRitaH |
mRRigamadhye yathA siMho muhuH parighamaikShata
shlokas.13:
sAntvyamAno vIjyamAnaH pArthenAkliShTakarmaNA |
svidyate cha mahAbAhurantardAhena vIryavAn
shlokas.14:
kruddhasya tasya srotobhyaH karNAdibhyo narAdhipa |
sadhUmaH sasphuli~NgArchiH pAvakaH samajAyata
shlokas.15:
bhrukuTIpuTaduShprekShyamabhavattasya tanmukham |
yugAntakAle samprApte kRRitAntasyeva rUpiNaH
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThirastamAvArya bAhunA bAhushAlinam |
maivamityabravIchchainaM joShamAssveti bhArata
shlokas.17:
nivArya taM mahAbAhuM kopasa.nraktalochanam |
pitaraM samupAtiShThaddhRRitarAShTraM kRRitA~njaliH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rAjankiM karavAmaste prashAdhyasmA.nstvamIshvaraH |
nityaM hi sthAtumichChAmastava bhArata shAsane
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ajAtashatro bhadraM te ariShTaM svasti gachChata |
anuj~nAtAH sahadhanAH svarAjyamanushAsata
shlokas.3:
idaM tvevAvaboddhavyaM vRRiddhasya mama shAsanam |
dhiyA nigaditaM kRRitsnaM pathyaM niHshreyasaM param
shlokas.4:
vettha tvaM tAta dharmANAM gatiM sUkShmAM yudhiShThira |
vinIto.asi mahAprAj~na vRRiddhAnAM paryupAsitA
shlokas.5:
yato buddhistataH shAntiH prashamaM gachCha bhArata |
nAdArau kramate shastraM dArau shastraM nipAtyate
shlokas.6:
na vairANyabhijAnanti guNAnpashyanti nAguNAn |
virodhaM nAdhigachChanti ye ta uttamapUruShAH
shlokas.7:
sa.nvAde paruShANyAhuryudhiShThira narAdhamAH |
pratyAhurmadhyamAstvetAnuktAH paruShamuttaram
shlokas.8:
naivoktA naiva chAnuktA ahitAH paruShA giraH |
pratijalpanti vai dhIrAH sadA uttamapUruShAH
shlokas.9:
smaranti sukRRitAnyeva na vairANi kRRitAnyapi |
santaH prativijAnanto labdhvA pratyayamAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
tathAcharitamAryeNa tvayAsminsatsamAgame |
duryodhanasya pAruShyaM tattAta hRRidi mA kRRithAH
shlokas.11:
mAtaraM chaiva gAndhArIM mAM cha tvadguNakA~NkShiNam |
upasthitaM vRRiddhamandhaM pitaraM pashya bhArata
shlokas.12:
prekShApUrvaM mayA dyUtamidamAsIdupekShitam |
mitrANi draShTukAmena putrANAM cha balAbalam
shlokas.13:
ashochyAH kuravo rAjanyeShAM tvamanushAsitA |
mantrI cha viduro dhImAnsarvashAstravishAradaH
shlokas.14:
tvayi dharmo.arjune vIryaM bhImasene parAkramaH |
shraddhA cha gurushushrUShA yamayoH puruShAgryayoH
shlokas.15:
ajAtashatro bhadraM te khANDavaprasthamAvisha |
bhrAtRRibhiste.astu saubhrAtraM dharme te dhIyatAM manaH
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityukto bharatashreShTho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
kRRitvAryasamayaM sarvaM pratasthe bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.17:
te rathAnmeghasa~NkAshAnAsthAya saha kRRiShNayA |
prayayurhRRiShTamanasa indraprasthaM purottamam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
anuj~nAtA.nstAnviditvA saratnadhanasa~nchayAn |
pANDavAndhArtarAShTrANAM kathamAsInmanastadA
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anuj~nAtA.nstAnviditvA dhRRitarAShTreNa dhImatA |
rAjanduHshAsanaH kShipraM jagAma bhrAtaraM prati
shlokas.3:
duryodhanaM samAsAdya sAmAtyaM bharatarShabha |
duHkhArto bharatashreShTha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.4:
duHkhenaitatsamAnItaM sthaviro nAshayatyasau |
shatrusAdgamayaddravyaM tadbudhyadhvaM mahArathAH
shlokas.5:
atha duryodhanaH karNaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
mithaH sa~Ngamya sahitAH pANDavAnprati mAninaH
shlokas.6:
vaichitravIryaM rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
abhigamya tvarAyuktAH shlakShNaM vachanamabruvan
shlokas.7:
duryodhana uvAcha||
na tvayedaM shrutaM rAjanyajjagAda bRRihaspatiH |
shakrasya nItiM pravadanvidvAndevapurohitaH
shlokas.8:
sarvopAyairnihantavyAH shatravaH shatrukarShaNa |
purA yuddhAdbalAdvApi prakurvanti tavAhitam
shlokas.9:
te vayaM pANDavadhanaiH sarvAnsampUjya pArthivAn |
yadi tAnyodhayiShyAmaH kiM vA naH parihAsyati
shlokas.10:
ahInAshIviShAnkruddhAnda.nshAya samupasthitAn |
kRRitvA kaNThe cha pRRiShThe cha kaH samutsraShTumarhati
shlokas.11:
AttashastrA rathagatAH kupitAstAta pANDavAH |
niHsheShaM naH kariShyanti kruddhA hyAshIviShA yathA
shlokas.12:
saMnaddho hyarjuno yAti vivRRitya parameShudhI |
gANDIvaM muhurAdatte niHshvasa.nshcha nirIkShate
shlokas.13:
gadAM gurvIM samudyamya tvaritashcha vRRikodaraH |
svarathaM yojayitvAshu niryAta iti naH shrutam
shlokas.14:
nakulaH khaDgamAdAya charma chApyaShTachandrakam |
sahadevashcha rAjA cha chakrurAkArami~NgitaiH
shlokas.15:
te tvAsthAya rathAnsarve bahushastraparichChadAn |
abhighnanto rathavrAtAnsenAyogAya niryayuH
shlokas.16:
na kSha.nsyante tathAsmAbhirjAtu viprakRRitA hi te |
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM kasteShAM kShantumarhati
shlokas.17:
punardIvyAma bhadraM te vanavAsAya pANDavaiH |
evametAnvashe kartuM shakShyAmo bharatarShabha
shlokas.18:
te vA dvAdasha varShANi vayaM vA dyUtanirjitAH |
pravishema mahAraNyamajinaiH prativAsitAH
shlokas.19:
trayodashaM cha sajane aj~nAtAH parivatsaram |
j~nAtAshcha punaranyAni vane varShANi dvAdasha
shlokas.20:
nivasema vayaM te vA tathA dyUtaM pravartatAm |
akShAnuptvA punardyUtamidaM dIvyantu pANDavAH
shlokas.21:
etatkRRityatamaM rAjannasmAkaM bharatarShabha |
ayaM hi shakunirveda savidyAmakShasampadam
shlokas.22:
dRRiDhamUlA vayaM rAjye mitrANi parigRRihya cha |
sAravadvipulaM sainyaM satkRRitya cha durAsadam
shlokas.23:
te cha trayodashe varShe pArayiShyanti chedvratam |
jeShyAmastAnvayaM rAjanrochatAM te parantapa
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tUrNaM pratyAnayasvaitAnkAmaM vyadhvagatAnapi |
AgachChantu punardyUtamidaM kurvantu pANDavAH
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato droNaH somadatto bAhlIkashcha mahArathaH |
viduro droNaputrashcha vaishyAputrashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.26:
bhUrishravAH shAntanavo vikarNashcha mahArathaH |
mA dyUtamityabhAShanta shamo.astviti cha sarvashaH
shlokas.27:
akAmAnAM cha sarveShAM suhRRidAmarthadarshinAm |
akarotpANDavAhvAnaM dhRRitarAShTraH sutapriyaH
shlokas.28:
athAbravInmahArAja dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
putrahArdAddharmayuktaM gAndhArI shokakarshitA
shlokas.29:
jAte duryodhane kShattA mahAmatirabhAShata |
nIyatAM paralokAya sAdhvayaM kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.30:
vyanadajjAtamAtro hi gomAyuriva bhArata |
anto nUnaM kulasyAsya kuravastannibodhata
shlokas.31:
mA bAlAnAmashiShTAnAmabhima.nsthA matiM prabho |
mA kulasya kShaye ghore kAraNaM tvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.32:
baddhaM setuM ko nu bhindyAddhamechChAntaM cha pAvakam |
shame dhRRitAnpunaH pArthAnkopayetko nu bhArata
shlokas.33:
smarantaM tvAmAjamIDha smArayiShyAmyahaM punaH |
shAstraM na shAsti durbuddhiM shreyase vetarAya vA
shlokas.34:
na vai vRRiddho bAlamatirbhavedrAjankatha~nchana |
tvannetrAH santu te putrA mA tvAM dIrNAH prahAsiShuH
shlokas.35:
shamena dharmeNa parasya buddhyA; jAtA buddhiH sAstu te mA pratIpA |
pradhva.nsinI krUrasamAhitA shrI;rmRRiduprauDhA gachChati putrapautrAn
shlokas.36:
athAbravInmahArAjo gAndhArIM dharmadarshinIm |
antaH kAmaM kulasyAstu na shakShyAmi nivAritum
shlokas.37:
yathechChanti tathaivAstu pratyAgachChantu pANDavAH |
punardyUtaM prakurvantu mAmakAH pANDavaiH saha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vyadhvagataM pArthaM prAtikAmI yudhiShThiram |
uvAcha vachanAdrAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH
shlokas.2:
upastIrNA sabhA rAjannakShAnuptvA yudhiShThira |
ehi pANDava dIvyeti pitA tvAmAha bhArata
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhAturniyogAdbhUtAni prApnuvanti shubhAshubham |
na nivRRittistayorasti devitavyaM punaryadi
shlokas.4:
akShadyUte samAhvAnaM niyogAtsthavirasya cha |
jAnannapi kShayakaraM nAtikramitumutsahe
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti bruvannivavRRite bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaH |
jAna.nshcha shakunermAyAM pArtho dyUtamiyAtpunaH
shlokas.6:
vivishuste sabhAM tAM tu punareva mahArathAH |
vyathayanti sma chetA.nsi suhRRidAM bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.7:
yathopajoShamAsInAH punardyUtapravRRittaye |
sarvalokavinAshAya daivenopanipIDitAH
shlokas.8:
shakuniruvAcha||
amu~nchatsthaviro yadvo dhanaM pUjitameva tat |
mahAdhanaM glahaM tvekaM shRRiNu me bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
vayaM dvAdasha varShANi yuShmAbhirdyUtanirjitAH |
pravishema mahAraNyaM rauravAjinavAsasaH
shlokas.10:
trayodashaM cha sajane aj~nAtAH parivatsaram |
j~nAtAshcha punaranyAni vane varShANi dvAdasha
shlokas.11:
asmAbhirvA jitA yUyaM vane varShANi dvAdasha |
vasadhvaM kRRiShNayA sArdhamajinaiH prativAsitAH
shlokas.12:
trayodashe cha nirvRRitte punareva yathochitam |
svarAjyaM pratipattavyamitarairatha vetaraiH
shlokas.13:
anena vyavasAyena sahAsmAbhiryudhiShThira |
akShAnuptvA punardyUtamehi dIvyasva bhArata
shlokas.14:
sabhAsada UchuH||
aho dhigbAndhavA nainaM bodhayanti mahadbhayam |
buddhyA bodhyaM na budhyante svayaM cha bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
janapravAdAnsubahUniti shRRiNvannarAdhipaH |
hriyA cha dharmasa~NgAchcha pArtho dyUtamiyAtpunaH
shlokas.16:
jAnannapi mahAbuddhiH punardyUtamavartayat |
apyayaM na vinAshaH syAtkurUNAmiti chintayan
shlokas.17:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM vai madvidho rAjA svadharmamanupAlayan |
AhUto vinivarteta dIvyAmi shakune tvayA
shlokas.18:
shakuniruvAcha||
gavAshvaM bahudhenUkamaparyantamajAvikam |
gajAH kosho hiraNyaM cha dAsIdAsaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.19:
eSha no glaha evaiko vanavAsAya pANDavAH |
yUyaM vayaM vA vijitA vasema vanamAshritAH
shlokas.20:
anena vyavasAyena dIvyAma bharatarShabha |
samutkShepeNa chaikena vanavAsAya bhArata
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratijagrAha taM pArtho glahaM jagrAha saubalaH |
jitamityeva shakuniryudhiShThiramabhAShata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vanavAsAya chakruste matiM pArthAH parAjitAH |
ajinAnyuttarIyANi jagRRihushcha yathAkramam
shlokas.2:
ajinaiH sa.nvRRitAndRRiShTvA hRRitarAjyAnari.ndamAn |
prasthitAnvanavAsAya tato duHshAsano.abravIt
shlokas.3:
pravRRittaM dhArtarAShTrasya chakraM rAj~no mahAtmanaH |
parAbhUtAH pANDuputrA vipattiM paramAM gatAH
shlokas.4:
adya devAH samprayAtAH samairvartmabhirasthalaiH |
guNajyeShThAstathA jyeShThA bhUyA.nso yadvayaM paraiH
shlokas.5:
narakaM pAtitAH pArthA dIrghakAlamanantakam |
sukhAchcha hInA rAjyAchcha vinaShTAH shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.6:
balena mattA ye te sma dhArtarAShTrAnprahAsiShuH |
te nirjitA hRRitadhanA vanameShyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.7:
chitrAnsaMnAhAnavamu~nchantu chaiShAM; vAsA.nsi divyAni cha bhAnumanti |
nivAsyantAM rurucharmANi sarve; yathA glahaM saubalasyAbhyupetAH
shlokas.8:
na santi lokeShu pumA.nsa IdRRishA; ityeva ye bhAvitabuddhayaH sadA |
j~nAsyanti te.a.atmAnamime.adya pANDavA; viparyaye ShaNDhatilA ivAphalAH
shlokas.9:
ayaM hi vAsodaya IdRRishAnAM; manasvinAM kaurava mA bhavedvaH |
adIkShitAnAmajinAni yadva;dbalIyasAM pashyata pANDavAnAm
shlokas.10:
mahAprAj~naH somako yaj~nasenaH; kanyAM pA~nchAlIM pANDavebhyaH pradAya |
akArShIdvai duShkRRitaM neha santi; klIbAH pArthAH patayo yAj~nasenyAH
shlokas.11:
sUkShmAnprAvArAnajinAni choditA;ndRRiShTvAraNye nirdhanAnapratiShThAn |
kAM tvaM prItiM lapsyase yAj~naseni; patiM vRRiNIShva yamihAnyamichChasi
shlokas.12:
ete hi sarve kuravaH sametAH; kShAntA dAntAH sudraviNopapannAH |
eShAM vRRiNIShvaikatamaM patitve; na tvAM tapetkAlaviparyayo.ayam
shlokas.13:
yathAphalAH ShaNDhatilA yathA charmamayA mRRigAH |
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve yathA kAkayavA api
shlokas.14:
kiM pANDavA.nstvaM patitAnupAsse; moghaH shramaH ShaNDhatilAnupAsya |
evaM nRRisha.nsaH paruShANi pArthA;nashrAvayaddhRRitarAShTrasya putraH
shlokas.15:
tadvai shrutvA bhImaseno.atyamarShI; nirbhartsyochchaistaM nigRRihyaiva roShAt |
uvAchedaM sahasaivopagamya; siMho yathA haimavataH shRRigAlam
shlokas.16:
bhImasena uvAcha||
krUra pApajanairjuShTamakRRitArthaM prabhAShase |
gAndhAravidyayA hi tvaM rAjamadhye vikatthase
shlokas.17:
yathA tudasi marmANi vAkSharairiha no bhRRisham |
tathA smArayitA te.ahaM kRRintanmarmANi sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
ye cha tvAmanuvartante kAmalobhavashAnugAH |
goptAraH sAnubandhA.nstAnneShyAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvANamajinairvivAsitaM; duHkhAbhibhUtaM parinRRityati sma |
madhye kurUNAM dharmanibaddhamArgaM; gaurgauriti smAhvayanmuktalajjaH
shlokas.20:
bhImasena uvAcha||
nRRisha.nsaM paruShaM krUraM shakyaM duHshAsana tvayA |
nikRRityA hi dhanaM labdhvA ko vikatthitumarhati
shlokas.21:
mA ha sma sukRRitA.NllokAngachChetpArtho vRRikodaraH |
yadi vakShasi bhittvA te na pibechChoNitaM raNe
shlokas.22:
dhArtarAShTrAnraNe hatvA miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm |
shamaM gantAsmi nachirAtsatyametadbravImi vaH
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya rAjA siMhagateH sakhelaM; duryodhano bhImasenasya harShAt |
gatiM svagatyAnuchakAra mando; nirgachChatAM pANDavAnAM sabhAyAH
shlokas.24:
naitAvatA kRRitamityabravIttaM; vRRikodaraH saMnivRRittArdhakAyaH |
shIghraM hi tvA nihataM sAnubandhaM; sa.nsmAryAhaM prativakShyAmi mUDha
shlokas.25:
etatsamIkShyAtmani chAvamAnaM; niyamya manyuM balavAnsa mAnI |
rAjAnugaH sa.nsadi kauravANAM; viniShkramanvAkyamuvAcha bhImaH
shlokas.26:
ahaM duryodhanaM hantA karNaM hantA dhana~njayaH |
shakuniM chAkShakitavaM sahadevo haniShyati
shlokas.27:
idaM cha bhUyo vakShyAmi sabhAmadhye bRRihadvachaH |
satyaM devAH kariShyanti yanno yuddhaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
suyodhanamimaM pApaM hantAsmi gadayA yudhi |
shiraH pAdena chAsyAhamadhiShThAsyAmi bhUtale
shlokas.29:
vAkyashUrasya chaivAsya paruShasya durAtmanaH |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pAtAsmi mRRigarADiva
shlokas.30:
arjuna uvAcha||
naiva vAchA vyavasitaM bhIma vij~nAyate satAm |
itashchaturdashe varShe draShTAro yadbhaviShyati
shlokas.31:
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneshcha durAtmanaH |
duHshAsanachaturthAnAM bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.32:
asUyitAraM vaktAraM prasraShTAraM durAtmanAm |
bhImasena niyogAtte hantAhaM karNamAhave
shlokas.33:
arjunaH pratijAnIte bhImasya priyakAmyayA |
karNaM karNAnugA.nshchaiva raNe hantAsmi patribhiH
shlokas.34:
ye chAnye pratiyotsyanti buddhimohena mAM nRRipAH |
tA.nshcha sarvA~nshitairbANairnetAsmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.35:
chaleddhi himavAnsthAnAnniShprabhaH syAddivAkaraH |
shaityaM somAtpraNashyeta matsatyaM vichaledyadi
shlokas.36:
na pradAsyati chedrAjyamito varShe chaturdashe |
duryodhano hi satkRRitya satyametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktavati pArthe tu shrImAnmAdravatIsutaH |
pragRRihya vipulaM bAhuM sahadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.38:
saubalasya vadhaM prepsuridaM vachanamabravIt |
krodhasa.nraktanayano niHshvasanniva pannagaH
shlokas.39:
akShAnyAnmanyase mUDha gAndhArANAM yashohara |
naite.akShA nishitA bANAstvayaite samare vRRitAH
shlokas.40:
yathA chaivoktavAnbhImastvAmuddishya sabAndhavam |
kartAhaM karmaNastasya kuru kAryANi sarvashaH
shlokas.41:
hantAsmi tarasA yuddhe tvAM vikramya sabAndhavam |
yadi sthAsyasi sa~NgrAme kShatradharmeNa saubala
shlokas.42:
sahadevavachaH shrutvA nakulo.api vishAM pate |
darshanIyatamo nR^INAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.43:
suteyaM yaj~nasenasya dyUte.asmindhRRitarAShTrajaiH |
yairvAchaH shrAvitA rUkShAH sthitairduryodhanapriye
shlokas.45:
nideshAddharmarAjasya draupadyAH padavIM charan |
nirdhArtarAShTrAM pRRithivIM kartAsmi nachirAdiva
shlokas.46:
evaM te puruShavyAghrAH sarve vyAyatabAhavaH |
pratij~nA bahulAH kRRitvA dhRRitarAShTramupAgaman

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AmantrayAmi bharatA.nstathA vRRiddhaM pitAmaham |
rAjAnaM somadattaM cha mahArAjaM cha bAhlikam
shlokas.2:
droNaM kRRipaM nRRipA.nshchAnyAnashvatthAmAnameva cha |
viduraM dhRRitarAShTraM cha dhArtarAShTrA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
yuyutsuM sa~njayaM chaiva tathaivAnyAnsabhAsadaH |
sarvAnAmantrya gachChAmi draShTAsmi punaretya vaH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
na cha ki~nchittadochuste hriyA santo yudhiShThiram |
manobhireva kalyANaM dadhyuste tasya dhImataH
shlokas.5:
vidura uvAcha||
AryA pRRithA rAjaputrI nAraNyaM gantumarhati |
sukumArI cha vRRiddhA cha nityaM chaiva sukhochitA
shlokas.6:
iha vatsyati kalyANI satkRRitA mama veshmani |
iti pArthA vijAnIdhvamagadaM vo.astu sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira vijAnIhi mamedaM bharatarShabha |
nAdharmeNa jitaH kashchidvyathate vai parAjayAt
shlokas.8:
tvaM vai dharmAnvijAnIShe yudhAM vettA dhana~njayaH |
hantArINAM bhImaseno nakulastvarthasa~NgrahI
shlokas.9:
sa.nyantA sahadevastu dhaumyo brahmaviduttamaH |
dharmArthakushalA chaiva draupadI dharmachAriNI
shlokas.10:
anyonyasya priyAH sarve tathaiva priyavAdinaH |
parairabhedyAH santuShTAH ko vo na spRRihayediha
shlokas.11:
eSha vai sarvakalyANaH samAdhistava bhArata |
nainaM shatrurviShahate shakreNApi samo.achyuta
shlokas.12:
himavatyanushiShTo.asi merusAvarNinA purA |
dvaipAyanena kRRiShNena nagare vAraNAvate
shlokas.13:
bhRRigutu~Nge cha rAmeNa dRRiShadvatyAM cha shambhunA |
ashrauShIrasitasyApi maharShera~njanaM prati
shlokas.14:
draShTA sadA nAradasya dhaumyaste.ayaM purohitaH |
mA hArShIH sAmparAye tvaM buddhiM tAmRRiShipUjitAm
shlokas.15:
purUravasamailaM tvaM buddhyA jayasi pANDava |
shaktyA jayasi rAj~no.anyAnRRiShIndharmopasevayA
shlokas.16:
aindre jaye dhRRitamanA yAmye kopavidhAraNe |
visarge chaiva kaubere vAruNe chaiva sa.nyame
shlokas.17:
AtmapradAnaM saumyatvamadbhyashchaivopajIvanam |
bhUmeH kShamA cha tejashcha samagraM sUryamaNDalAt
shlokas.18:
vAyorbalaM viddhi sa tvaM bhUtebhyashchAtmasambhavam |
agadaM vo.astu bhadraM vo drakShyAmi punarAgatAn
shlokas.19:
ApaddharmArthakRRichChreShu sarvakAryeShu vA punaH |
yathAvatpratipadyethAH kAle kAle yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
ApRRiShTo.asIha kaunteya svasti prApnuhi bhArata |
kRRitArthaM svastimantaM tvAM drakShyAmaH punarAgatam
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastathetyuktvA pANDavaH satyavikramaH |
bhIShmadroNau namaskRRitya prAtiShThata yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminsamprasthite kRRiShNA pRRithAM prApya yashasvinIm |
ApRRichChadbhRRishaduHkhArtA yAshchAnyAstatra yoShitaH
shlokas.2:
yathArhaM vandanAshleShAnkRRitvA gantumiyeSha sA |
tato ninAdaH sumahAnpANDavAntaHpure.abhavat
shlokas.3:
kuntI cha bhRRishasantaptA draupadIM prekShya gachChatIm |
shokavihvalayA vAchA kRRichChrAdvachanamabravIt
shlokas.4:
vatse shoko na te kAryaH prApyedaM vyasanaM mahat |
strIdharmANAmabhij~nAsi shIlAchAravatI tathA
shlokas.5:
na tvAM sa.ndeShTumarhAmi bhartR^Inprati shuchismite |
sAdhvIguNasamAdhAnairbhUShitaM te kuladvayam
shlokas.6:
sabhAgyAH kuravashcheme ye na dagdhAstvayAnaghe |
ariShTaM vraja panthAnaM madanudhyAnabRRiMhitA
shlokas.7:
bhAvinyarthe hi satstrINAM vaiklavyaM nopajAyate |
gurudharmAbhiguptA cha shreyaH kShipramavApsyasi
shlokas.8:
sahadevashcha me putraH sadAvekShyo vane vasan |
yathedaM vyasanaM prApya nAsya sIdenmahanmanaH
shlokas.9:
tathetyuktvA tu sA devI sravannetrajalAvilA |
shoNitAktaikavasanA muktakeshyabhiniryayau
shlokas.10:
tAM kroshantIM pRRithA duHkhAdanuvavrAja gachChatIm |
athApashyatsutAnsarvAnhRRitAbharaNavAsasaH
shlokas.11:
rurucharmAvRRitatanUnhriyA ki~nchidavA~NmukhAn |
paraiH parItAnsaMhRRiShTaiH suhRRidbhishchAnushochitAn
shlokas.12:
tadavasthAnsutAnsarvAnupasRRityAtivatsalA |
sasvajAnAvadachChokAttattadvilapatI bahu
shlokas.13:
kathaM saddharmachAritravRRittasthitivibhUShitAn |
akShudrAndRRiDhabhaktA.nshcha daivatejyAparAnsadA
shlokas.14:
vyasanaM vaH samabhyAgAtko.ayaM vidhiviparyayaH |
kasyApadhyAnajaM chedamAgaH pashyAmi vo dhiyA
shlokas.15:
syAttu madbhAgyadoSho.ayaM yAhaM yuShmAnajIjanam |
duHkhAyAsabhujo.atyarthaM yuktAnapyuttamairguNaiH
shlokas.16:
kathaM vatsyatha durgeShu vaneShvRRiddhivinAkRRitAH |
vIryasattvabalotsAhatejobhirakRRishAH kRRishAH
shlokas.17:
yadyetadahamaj~nAsyaM vanavAso hi vo dhruvam |
shatashRRi~NgAnmRRite pANDau nAgamiShyaM gajAhvayam
shlokas.18:
dhanyaM vaH pitaraM manye tapomedhAnvitaM tathA |
yaH putrAdhimasamprApya svargechChAmakarotpriyAm
shlokas.19:
dhanyAM chAtIndriyaj~nAnAmimAM prAptAM parAM gatim |
manye.adya mAdrIM dharmaj~nAM kalyANIM sarvathaiva hi
shlokas.20:
ratyA matyA cha gatyA cha yayAhamabhisandhitA |
jIvitapriyatAM mahyaM dhigimAM kleshabhAginIm
shlokas.21:
evaM vilapatIM kuntImabhisAntvya praNamya cha |
pANDavA vigatAnandA vanAyaiva pravavrajuH
shlokas.22:
vidurAdayashcha tAmArtAM kuntImAshvAsya hetubhiH |
prAveshayangRRihaM kShattuH svayamArtatarAH shanaiH
shlokas.23:
rAjA cha dhRRitarAShTraH sa shokAkulitachetanaH |
kShattuH sampreShayAmAsa shIghramAgamyatAmiti
shlokas.24:
tato jagAma viduro dhRRitarAShTraniveshanam |
taM paryapRRichChatsa.nvigno dhRRitarAShTro narAdhipaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM gachChati kaunteyo dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenaH savyasAchI mAdrIputrau cha tAvubhau
shlokas.2:
dhaumyashchaiva kathaM kShattardraupadI vA tapasvinI |
shrotumichChAmyahaM sarvaM teShAma~NgavicheShTitam
shlokas.3:
vidura uvAcha||
vastreNa sa.nvRRitya mukhaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bAhU vishAlau kRRitvA tu bhImo gachChati pANDavaH
shlokas.4:
sikatA vapansavyasAchI rAjAnamanugachChati |
mAdrIputraH sahadevo mukhamAlipya gachChati
shlokas.5:
pA.nsUpaliptasarvA~Ngo nakulashchittavihvalaH |
darshanIyatamo loke rAjAnamanugachChati
shlokas.6:
kRRiShNA keshaiH pratichChAdya mukhamAyatalochanA |
darshanIyA prarudatI rAjAnamanugachChati
shlokas.7:
dhaumyo yAmyAni sAmAni raudrANi cha vishAM pate |
gAyangachChati mArgeShu kushAnAdAya pANinA
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
vividhAnIha rUpANi kRRitvA gachChanti pANDavAH |
tanmamAchakShva vidura kasmAdevaM vrajanti te
shlokas.9:
vidura uvAcha||
nikRRitasyApi te putrairhRRite rAjye dhaneShu cha |
na dharmAchchalate buddhirdharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.10:
yo.asau rAjA ghRRiNI nityaM dhArtarAShTreShu bhArata |
nikRRityA krodhasantapto nonmIlayati lochane
shlokas.11:
nAhaM janaM nirdaheyaM dRRiShTvA ghoreNa chakShuShA |
sa pidhAya mukhaM rAjA tasmAdgachChati pANDavaH
shlokas.12:
yathA cha bhImo vrajati tanme nigadataH shRRiNu |
bAhvorbale nAsti samo mameti bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
bAhU vishAlau kRRitvA tu tena bhImo.api gachChati |
bAhU darshayamAno hi bAhudraviNadarpitaH
chikIrShankarma shatrubhyo bAhudravyAnurUpataH
shlokas.14:
pradisha~nsharasampAtAnkuntIputro.arjunastadA |
sikatA vapansavyasAchI rAjAnamanugachChati
shlokas.15:
asaktAH sikatAstasya yathA samprati bhArata |
asaktaM sharavarShANi tathA mokShyati shatruShu
shlokas.16:
na me kashchidvijAnIyAnmukhamadyeti bhArata |
mukhamAlipya tenAsau sahadevo.api gachChati
shlokas.17:
nAhaM manA.nsyAdadeyaM mArge strINAmiti prabho |
pA.nsUpachitasarvA~Ngo nakulastena gachChati
shlokas.18:
ekavastrA tu rudatI muktakeshI rajasvalA |
shoNitAktArdravasanA draupadI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.19:
yatkRRite.ahamimAM prAptA teShAM varShe chaturdashe |
hatapatyo hatasutA hatabandhujanapriyAH
shlokas.20:
bandhushoNitadigdhA~Ngyo muktakeshyo rajasvalAH |
evaM kRRitodakA nAryaH pravekShyanti gajAhvayam
shlokas.21:
kRRitvA tu nairRRitAndarbhAndhIro dhaumyaH purohitaH |
sAmAni gAyanyAmyAni purato yAti bhArata
shlokas.22:
hateShu bhArateShvAjau kurUNAM guravastadA |
evaM sAmAni gAsyantItyuktvA dhaumyo.api gachChati
shlokas.23:
hA hA gachChanti no nAthAH samavekShadhvamIdRRisham |
iti paurAH suduHkhArtAH kroshanti sma samantataH
shlokas.24:
evamAkArali~Ngaiste vyavasAyaM manogatam |
kathayantaH sma kaunteyA vanaM jagmurmanasvinaH
shlokas.25:
evaM teShu narAgryeShu niryatsu gajasAhvayAt |
anabhre vidyutashchAsanbhUmishcha samakampata
shlokas.26:
rAhuragrasadAdityamaparvaNi vishAM pate |
ulkA chApyapasavyaM tu puraM kRRitvA vyashIryata
shlokas.27:
pravyAharanti kravyAdA gRRidhragomAyuvAyasAH |
devAyatanachaityeShu prAkArATTAlakeShu cha
shlokas.28:
evamete mahotpAtA vanaM gachChati pANDave |
bhAratAnAmabhAvAya rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.29:
nAradashcha sabhAmadhye kurUNAmagrataH sthitaH |
maharShibhiH parivRRito raudraM vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.30:
itashchaturdashe varShe vina~NkShyantIha kauravAH |
duryodhanAparAdhena bhImArjunabalena cha
shlokas.31:
ityuktvA divamAkramya kShipramantaradhIyata |
brAhmIM shriyaM suvipulAM bibhraddevarShisattamaH
shlokas.32:
tato duryodhanaH karNaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
droNaM dvIpamamanyanta rAjyaM chAsmai nyavedayan
shlokas.33:
athAbravIttato droNo duryodhanamamarShaNam |
duHshAsanaM cha karNaM cha sarvAneva cha bhAratAn
shlokas.34:
avadhyAnpANDavAnAhurdevaputrAndvijAtayaH |
ahaM tu sharaNaM prAptAnvartamAno yathAbalam
shlokas.35:
gatAnsarvAtmanA bhaktyA dhArtarAShTrAnsarAjakAn |
notsahe samabhityaktuM daivamUlamataH param
shlokas.36:
dharmataH pANDuputrA vai vanaM gachChanti nirjitAH |
te cha dvAdasha varShANi vane vatsyanti kauravAH
shlokas.37:
charitabrahmacharyAshcha krodhAmarShavashAnugAH |
vairaM pratyAnayiShyanti mama duHkhAya pANDavAH
shlokas.38:
mayA tu bhra.nshito rAjyAddrupadaH sakhivigrahe |
putrArthamayajatkrodhAdvadhAya mama bhArata
shlokas.39:
yAjopayAjatapasA putraM lebhe sa pAvakAt |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM draupadIM cha vedImadhyAtsumadhyamAm
shlokas.40:
jvAlAvarNo devadatto dhanuShmAnkavachI sharI |
martyadharmatayA tasmAditi mAM bhayamAvishat
shlokas.41:
gato hi pakShatAM teShAM pArShataH puruSharShabhaH |
sRRiShTaprANo bhRRishataraM tasmAdyotsye tavAribhiH
shlokas.42:
madvadhAya shruto hyeSha loke chApyativishrutaH |
nUnaM so.ayamanuprAptastvatkRRite kAlaparyayaH
shlokas.43:
tvaritAH kuruta shreyo naitadetAvatA kRRitam |
muhUrtaM sukhamevaitattAlachChAyeva haimanI
shlokas.44:
yajadhvaM cha mahAyaj~nairbhogAnashnIta datta cha |
itashchaturdashe varShe mahatprApsyatha vaishasam
shlokas.45:
duryodhana nishamyaitatpratipadya yathechChasi |
sAma vA pANDaveyeShu prayu~NkShva yadi manyase
shlokas.46:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
droNasya vachanaM shrutvA dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam |
samyagAha guruH kShattarupAvartaya pANDavAn
shlokas.47:
yadi vA na nivartante satkRRitA yAntu pANDavAH |
sashastrarathapAdAtA bhogavantashcha putrakAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vanaM gateShu pArtheShu nirjiteShu durodare |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahArAja tadA chintA samAvishat
shlokas.2:
taM chintayAnamAsInaM dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
niHshvasantamanekAgramiti hovAcha sa~njayaH
shlokas.3:
avApya vasusampUrNAM vasudhAM vasudhAdhipa |
pravrAjya pANDavAnrAjyAdrAjankimanushochasi
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ashochyaM tu kutasteShAM yeShAM vairaM bhaviShyati |
pANDavairyuddhashauNDairhi mitravadbhirmahArathaiH
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tavedaM sukRRitaM rAjanmahadvairaM bhaviShyati |
vinAshaH sarvalokasya sAnubandho bhaviShyati
shlokas.6:
vAryamANo.api bhIShmeNa droNena vidureNa cha |
pANDavAnAM priyAM bhAryAM draupadIM dharmachAriNIm
shlokas.7:
prAhiNodAnayeheti putro duryodhanastava |
sUtaputraM sumandAtmA nirlajjaH prAtikAminam
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yasmai devAH prayachChanti puruShAya parAbhavam |
buddhiM tasyApakarShanti so.apAchInAni pashyati
shlokas.9:
buddhau kaluShabhUtAyAM vinAshe pratyupasthite |
anayo nayasa~NkAsho hRRidayAnnApasarpati
shlokas.10:
anarthAshchArtharUpeNa arthAshchAnartharUpiNaH |
uttiShThanti vinAshAnte naraM tachchAsya rochate
shlokas.11:
na kAlo daNDamudyamya shiraH kRRintati kasyachit |
kAlasya balametAvadviparItArthadarshanam
shlokas.12:
AsAditamidaM ghoraM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
pA~nchAlImapakarShadbhiH sabhAmadhye tapasvinIm
shlokas.13:
ayonijAM rUpavatIM kule jAtAM vibhAvarIm |
ko nu tAM sarvadharmaj~nAM paribhUya yashasvinIm
shlokas.14:
paryAnayetsabhAmadhyamRRite durdyUtadevinam |
strIdharmiNIM varArohAM shoNitena samukShitAm
shlokas.15:
ekavastrAM cha pA~nchAlIM pANDavAnabhyavekShatIm |
hRRitasvAnbhraShTachittA.nstAnhRRitadArAnhRRitashriyaH
shlokas.16:
vihInAnsarvakAmebhyo dAsabhAvavashaM gatAn |
dharmapAshaparikShiptAnashaktAniva vikrame
shlokas.17:
kruddhAmamarShitAM kRRiShNAM duHkhitAM kurusa.nsadi |
duryodhanashcha karNashcha kaTukAnyabhyabhAShatAm
shlokas.18:
tasyAH kRRipaNachakShurbhyAM pradahyetApi medinI |
api sheShaM bhavedadya putrANAM mama sa~njaya
shlokas.19:
bhAratAnAM striyaH sarvA gAndhAryA saha sa~NgatAH |
prAkroshanbhairavaM tatra dRRiShTvA kRRiShNAM sabhAgatAm
shlokas.20:
agnihotrANi sAyAhne na chAhUyanta sarvashaH |
brAhmaNAH kupitAshchAsandraupadyAH parikarShaNe
shlokas.21:
AsInniShTAnako ghoro nirghAtashcha mahAnabhUt |
divolkAshchApatanghorA rAhushchArkamupAgrasat
aparvaNi mahAghoraM prajAnAM janayanbhayam
shlokas.22:
tathaiva rathashAlAsu prAdurAsIddhutAshanaH |
dhvajAshcha vyavashIryanta bharatAnAmabhUtaye
shlokas.23:
duryodhanasyAgnihotre prAkroshanbhairavaM shivAH |
tAstadA pratyabhAShanta rAsabhAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.24:
prAtiShThata tato bhIShmo droNena saha sa~njaya |
kRRipashcha somadattashcha bAhlIkashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.25:
tato.ahamabruvaM tatra vidureNa prachoditaH |
varaM dadAni kRRiShNAyai kA~NkShitaM yadyadichChati
shlokas.26:
avRRiNottatra pA~nchAlI pANDavAnamitaujasaH |
sarathAnsadhanuShkA.nshchApyanuj~nAsiShamapyaham
shlokas.27:
athAbravInmahAprAj~no viduraH sarvadharmavit |
etadantAH stha bharatA yadvaH kRRiShNA sabhAM gatA
shlokas.28:
eShA pA~nchAlarAjasya sutaiShA shrIranuttamA |
pA~nchAlI pANDavAnetAndaivasRRiShTopasarpati
shlokas.29:
tasyAH pArthAH parikleshaM na kSha.nsyante.atyamarShaNAH |
vRRiShNayo vA maheShvAsAH pA~nchAlA vA mahaujasaH
shlokas.30:
tena satyAbhisandhena vAsudevena rakShitAH |
AgamiShyati bIbhatsuH pA~nchAlairabhirakShitaH
shlokas.31:
teShAM madhye maheShvAso bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
AgamiShyati dhunvAno gadAM daNDamivAntakaH
shlokas.32:
tato gANDIvanirghoShaM shrutvA pArthasya dhImataH |
gadAvegaM cha bhImasya nAlaM soDhuM narAdhipAH
shlokas.33:
tatra me rochate nityaM pArthaiH sArdhaM na vigrahaH |
kurubhyo hi sadA manye pANDavA~nshaktimattarAn
shlokas.34:
tathA hi balavAnrAjA jarAsandho mahAdyutiH |
bAhupraharaNenaiva bhImena nihato yudhi
shlokas.35:
tasya te shama evAstu pANDavairbharatarShabha |
ubhayoH pakShayoryuktaM kriyatAmavisha~NkayA
shlokas.36:
evaM gAvalgaNe kShattA dharmArthasahitaM vachaH |
uktavAnna gRRihItaM cha mayA putrahitepsayA
